summary:
A fast-paced sci-fi space survival shooter where you blast through relentless enemies, upgrade your ship, and climb the global leader-board.

Step into the retro-futuristic chaos of Meteor Mania, a sci-fi arena shoot-’em-up where quick reflexes and strategic upgrades are your only hope for survival. Inspired by classic arcade action, this pixel-art survival game drops you into an ever-escalating battle against waves of alien enemies and powerful boss ships.

The mission? Survive as long as you can, rack up points, and climb the global leaderboards.

Each wave brings tougher enemies, faster attacks, and chaotic mayhem. Defeated foes drop power-ups that transform your ship and change your strategy on the fly:

Shotgun Core – unleash wide, devastating blasts at close range.

Dual Gunner – fire from both wings for double the destruction.

Plasma Cannon – melt enemies with a continuous piercing beam.

Life Boosts – restore lost health to stay in the fight.

Fire Rate Boosters – shoot faster and overwhelm swarms.

Speed Enhancers – zip around the arena with lightning-fast movement.

Face down boss encounters, each with unique mechanics and attack patterns that will test your reflexes and choices.

With intuitive controls, a nostalgic art style, and endlessly re-playable gameplay, Meteor Mania is perfect for short bursts or long high-score runs. Compete with friends or take on the world—can you survive the storm and become a leaderboard legend?

Use your natural attack, as permitted

Play cards that represent Units, Abilities, or Effects

Units, once deployed, act on their own and use their own attacks and abilities

You retain all your deck

name: 孟德尔模拟器
summary:
《孟德尔模拟器》（Mendel Simulator）是一款轻松治愈、略带烧脑的植物基因重组模拟游戏。在这里，你将化身科学一派的花艺匠人，利用经典的孟德尔遗传学规律，通过不断的杂交与培育，解开大自然最美丽的基因密码。

你的终极目标：解锁 8 种梦幻色彩与 12 种独特花型，收集全部 96 种绝美花卉！

核心游戏玩法
种花与悉心栽培： 从一粒平凡的种子开始，浇水、静待花开。感受生命在指尖绽放的治愈过程。

市场交易赚取点数： 将你培育出的美丽花卉售卖给顾客，换取丰厚的游戏点数。

种子盲盒的未知心跳： 消耗点数抽取高阶“种子盲盒”！每次拆盲盒都是一场豪赌，因为里面可能隐藏着拥有稀有、复杂隐性基因的绝赞母本。

独具特色的基因机制
这不只是一款简单的种花游戏，更是一场显性与隐性基因的博弈！

每一株花朵背后都有一串的遗传代码。想要调配出那抹最罕见的紫色？想要培育出传说中的花型？你必须像真正的遗传学家一样，观察子代性状，推算基因组合，利用科学的杂交手段将那些沉睡的隐性基因完美显现！

游戏特色
全收集挑战： 8 种颜色， 12 种花型 = 96 种完全不同的图鉴收藏，满足你的收集强迫症。

轻量级无压力体验： 精准的游戏体量，总游戏时长在 10小时以内。适合在午后或睡前轻松通关。

摸鱼挂机的不二之选： 极简的音效设计与悠闲的游戏节奏，让它成为了绝佳的“副屏/后台神器”。它完全不占精力，最适合在上班、上课或多任务处理时挂在后台。一边听着你最爱的歌或播客，一边顺手把绝美花卉培育出来！

开发者的话：

科学原理也可以很好玩！无论你是生物学爱好者，还是单纯喜欢收集与模拟经营的休闲玩家，《孟德尔模拟器》都将带给你一段既烧脑又解压的花香之旅。现在就购买，开启你的基因育种工坊吧！

另外，还有隐藏关卡等你来发现！

Mavors is a multiplayer tile strategy game with an emphasis on city building. Resources are drawn from tiles and refined by buildings the player places. Materials travel from building to building via roads. The ultimate goal being to create armaments for units in order to defeat other players in the session.

This game, my first game, was conceived as a criticism of other tile based strategy games. Perhaps my friend group is different, but the best part of a session was always warfare. An aspect of strategy games that has been continually discounted in recent years. 

Here, warfare takes center stage. The entirety of the city building and population dynamics is a means for the player to create a military industrial complex. Additionally, rather than a bland linear progression of units, the player must balance the resource cost and effectiveness of a given unit in a given situation. 

For example:

Units can be equipped with one of four melee weapons: swords, axes, maces, or spears. Swords get and extra attack upon a successful attack indefinitely, but have low armor penetration. Making them excellent for trash killing, but horrific against heavily armored units. Maces just sport high armor penetration, and nothing else. Axes ignore the effects of shields. While spears determine their armor penetration via speed and allow for denser units.

So, you can see how a unit's effectiveness depends on the opposing unit's composition.

summary:
Welcome to Forward Green, Dave, we hope you're excited. Project Lagoon Breeze is a great opportunity to make connections, oversee construction, and manage community relations on an international scale. This role requires resilience, but we know you're up for it. Are you ready to make a difference?

202x, England. Forward Green, an entirely unsuspicious NGO, has started a new project: Lagoon Breeze. And guess who's lucky enough to get to manage this exciting new development? That's right: you. 

Your responsibilities are simple:

Oversee the construction: Do whatever it takes to get these turbines turning: finalize a site, manage marketing, navigate public relations, handle complaints...not that there will be many of those, I'm sure.

Manage your team: A happy workforce is a happy profit margin! That's why we've implemented our Green Office initiative—engage enthusiastically to boost morale. Please note participation is mandatory. 

Please your boss: Tell flatteries, lies, and half-truths, or even, if you're particularly unwise, attempt honesty. When the tendrils close in around you, what sort of person will you prove to be?

Pay your bills: That's what this is all for, after all, isn't it Dave? The chatter of the commute, the tedium of the office, the thrum of your fan in your tiny flat as you toss and turn. Today's bills are paid, but tomorrow's? 

So, are you ready to make an impact?

But something isn't right. The voices of the lagoon whisper through your monitor, faraway tongues speaking doom. Bitter words leak from the cracks in the project like so much black oil and drip like cursed rain upon once-fertile land. But don't fear, a whisper can be covered by a catchy jingle, and a crack by so many posters.

Dare you look, eyes uncovered, at what you unleash upon the world? Or shall the Hydra subsume you into its writhing flesh? 

It's time to get to work, Dave.

summary:
A first-person co-op horror game where you raid cursed buildings, grab what you can and get back to the train before it leaves. You need to sell enough loot to keep travelling. The Conductor makes sure you always owe more.

Four passengers. One train. A very bad deal.

In Dead Haul, you and up to three friends are trying to escape Brimstone by train. The problem is that the train is not free and the Conductor keeps raising the price.

At each stop, you break into old estates, crypts, mines and manor houses to steal whatever is worth carrying. 

You have a short window before the train leaves. Go deeper and you might find better loot, stranger rooms and answers to what is really happening. Stay too long and you may not make it back.

Dead Haul is built around pressure, memory and risk. 

Not everything is marked. Not every system explains itself. You learn by paying attention, trying things, surviving and telling the others what you found.

Key Features

Co-op raids 

Play solo or with up to three friends. Split up, search faster, get greedy, panic and decide whether the extra loot is worth the walk back.

The train does not wait 

Each stop gives you limited time. The deeper you go, the harder it is to return. You need to make the call before the train doors close.

Cursed places worth searching 

Explore decaying estates, crypts, mines and old houses filled with hidden rooms, locked mechanisms, strange rituals, and routes that are easy to miss.

More to do than loot 

Not everyone has to go deep inside. Players can ferry items, sort supplies, brew useful things, manage the haul and keep the expedition moving.

The Conductor

The Conductor is your guide, merchant and jailer. He keeps the train moving, but never for free.

Chess pieces are bombs. The board grows. Cascades decide everything.

Crown & Conquest is a tactical deck-building territory game that fuses Reversi, chess, and chain reactions into something new. The board isn't fixed — it grows as you play. Drop a Disk and flip your opponent's pieces with the classic Reversi sandwich. But the real game is in the chess pieces: each one is a primed bomb. Flip a Knight, Rook, or Bishop and it fires its movement pattern, flipping everything in its path — which can flip more pieces, which fire again. One placement can unravel into a board-spanning cascade. 

 You don't gamble on it blind: hover any placement to see the full cascade before you commit. Plan three flips ahead, or bait your opponent into detonating their own wall.

 Every turn you play from a hand drawn from your deck — Disks, chess bombs, and special cards like Shield and Convert. Manage your draw, read the board, and time your Queen's charge for an automatic strike. Anchor your territory with the King — the one piece that can never be flipped or destroyed (well... almost — a Knight will leap right over its wall).

 Take it through an 18-match campaign against 8 named AI opponents, each with their own personality and play style, building to 4 multi-phase boss encounters. Swap the whole look with data-driven theme packs. Then watch the Border Decay endgame close in and force the killing blow.

Chain-reaction board game — chess pieces detonate cascades across a dynamically growing Reversi board.

Rolling In Gears is an engaging puzzle physics platformer game where you control a ball navigating through a series of mechanical challenges. The game’s main mechanic revolves around rotating gears and moving platforms to guide the ball towards its target destination. Players need to carefully maneuver through the levels, using precision and timing to overcome obstacles and reach the end of each stage.

How to Play Rolling in Gears

In Rolling in Gears, your goal is to guide a small ball through a series of intricate levels filled with mechanical obstacles and clever puzzles. Use the arrow keys to control the ball's movement, all with just two moves: forward and backward.

Your challenge is to roll the ball forward and backward with precision as you navigate ramps, gears, and spinning hazards. Each level introduces new challenges, like gravity beams or suction mechanics, keeping you on your toes with emerging gameplay.

Your timing and precision are key, especially when avoiding dangerous traps or timing your movements to perfection. The key is to watch out for platforms that shift or spin and think strategically to overcome trickier sections. If you get stuck, analyze the mechanics at play—sometimes, it’s about patience and letting the environment do the work for you; other times, it’s all on you. There are 40 levels to master, each more difficult than the next.

summary:
A Retro RPG adventure with multiple endings. The Last Chronomancer guides six main heroes on a Quest to save Etheros!

Objective

   I set out to create an homage to the Classic RPGs of the 90's.  Heavily inspired by the games that I still enjoy playing to this day such as Final Fantasy, ChronoTrigger, Lufia, and Suikoden, while combining them with elements of Game of Thrones, World of Warcraft, The Dark Crystal, and Dungeons and Dragons.

   I also wanted to provide a touch of realism and subversion to the fantasy tropes of the classic games. The story will take many twists and turns, blurring the lines between "Good and Evil".

Synopsis

   The Last Chronomancer travels through the River of Time. Recently she has discovered that a tragic event is coming that will destroy not just the planet, but Time itself. She seeks to aid Six Heroes in their Journey to stop the oncoming Great Evil.

   The Heroes begin their Journey in the Mountain Town of Pentam, and have come together to participate in the annual Kobold Hunt. The event attracts visitors, warriors, and adventures from all over Etheros. However, this particular Kobold Hunt will have a very unusual outcome.

   The Heroes will grow, develop, and change as the story progresses. Relationships will be formed, and blood will be spilled. Will you be able to lead the Heroes to their destiny? Will you be able to change fate itself?

summary:
Grab, throw, eat, and UTTERLY WRECK everything using a mind-controlled spork in this quirky, story-driven, console-styled platforming dramedy. With an emphasis on variety and a grand sense of adventure, Psycutlery offers a surprising full-course meal, despite all unassuming appearances...

What... IS this?

It's a spoon. And yet, it's also a fork. Or is it either? It's a video game-type thing developed by Skye June (a.k.a. "Thunder Dragon").  A console-styled platformer with an action-adventure feel, complete with an expansive storyline featuring multifaceted characters across a widely varied world.

Each new level is completely unique from the last. 

With an emphasis on variety through the constant introduction of new gimmicks and ways to play, Psycutlery is a game that prompts the question: "what's next?!"

Take control of Lillian the Alien and her mind-controlled spork (that YOU can name).  Grab things.  Throw things.  Eat things.  Jump in mid-air up to five times!  Bring down an incomprehensible abomination of evil with a single piece of silverware (plus around 30 different power-ups!), and witness copious craziness unfold across Planet Geozaic!

Some things to note...

For best results, playing with a controller is recommended (as this is a console-style platformer designed and tested with a controller in mind).  Keyboard controls are supported, but not preferred.  But hey.  Options!  Whatever you use, all controls are rebindable to custom user specifications.

Note that this game, though more or less family friendly, may contain some scary parts and dark storytelling moments that might not be suitable for small children.

Around a decade in development, and... it's free??

Yep.  All I want is to share my work and keep enjoying my game development hobby (without any of the stresses that come from the business side of things)!

This is the full, completed game.  I would like to think of it having ample length and quality comparable to that of a commercial game.

Play as any of the 4 unique characters, and complete optional side quests for unique rewards and secret party members, and experience multiple distinct endings to the game. Experience challenging but winnable turn based combat and bosses in the 5 different dungeons, each with their own strategy to learn. Included in the program files is a PDF Walkthrough with information on the Main Story Quest, Side Quests, and Boss Battles.

All content in this game is created using RPG Maker Event Processing, as an experiment in the capabilities of the program, and does NOT feature any Generative AI or AI assisted content. I hope you enjoy!

If you want, you can now kill your enemies. Try engaging in a massacre against multiple foes.

summary:
Pixel Transit is a game where you construct a transit system in an infinitely vast, tile-based world. Your goal is to design efficient transportation networks that enable people to reach their destinations as quickly as possible.

WHAT IS THIS GAME?

Pixel Transit is a game where you construct a transit system in an infinitely vast, tile-based world. Each tile serves a distinct function - for example, sidewalk tiles allow pedestrians to walk, train track tiles guide trains, and road tiles accommodate cars.

TRANSIT MECHANICS

When a new person is introduced to the world, they begin by randomly searching for a building on the map. If they locate one, they will attempt to reach it as fast as possible using the network of sidewalks, trains, or cars built by the player. So, people like to choose to get on trains even when the train route is longer than the walking path if they think it's more efficient.

HEALTH AND RECOVERY

Every person has a health meter that, if it falls below zero, results in death. Reaching a building fully restores their health. Additionally, resting rooms can help recover health, though their capacity is limited. Since walking rapidly decreases health, it is advisable to keep people on trains or cars - or to build plenty of resting rooms to ensure their survival.

summary:
Nihongo Daily is an educational Japanese word remembering game that can be played everyday to help you remember more words than just straight cramming, alone.

About The Game!

I build Nihongo Daily to help me learn new words in Japanese.  I found that this was simpler and easier than using other, more complicated programs like Anki.  I thought someone else might like it and here we are!

How to Play

The heart of the game is the daily quiz, which you can do more than once per day if you feel like it.

Using a spaced repetition model you are shown a Japanese word in Romaji and are given both the Hiragana and Katakana of this word.
(Both Hiragana and Katakana are shown for all words and not just words that are traditionally Hiragana or Katakana only)

You have ten seconds before to remember what this word means.

After the ten second has expired, you are shown the English answer.
Did you get the word correct?  Press the, now active, buttons.
Nihongo Daily will keep a track of which words you got correct and which you didn't and will show you these words at different intervals to make sure you're remembering.

Use Nihongo Daily everyday and build a day learning streak.

As you progress, earn in-game achievements.

The Future

I'll be doing monthly maintenance updates on Nihongo Daily, adding new words and maybe new features as and when I need them myself.  If people like this I'll continue to add more and more.

If you have a suggestion and maybe a feature you'd like added, reach out and I'll see about putting that in.

Thanks very much for getting this far!!

またね!

summary:
A surreal, story-driven puzzle game set on a train caught in a time loop. Solve narrative-driven puzzles, battle psychic bosses, and uncover the truth about memory, grief, and a girl named Ripley—before the day resets again.

Time always runs out. But what if you could try again?

In Ripley , you play as Sage, a barista trapped in a looping day aboard a train bound for nowhere. Each loop brings new puzzles to solve, strange characters to meet, and unsettling truths to uncover. The passengers don’t know they’re repeating the same day. But you do.

To break the cycle, you'll need to:

Solve puzzles that persist through loops – Keep key items and knowledge across runs to open new paths and dialogue.

Decipher NPC routines – Timed events and tightly interwoven schedules create a reactive world that changes based on your actions.

Face psychological boss fights – Each fight is a manifestation of trauma, grief, or guilt, brought to life through surreal mechanics.

Unravel a deeply personal story – Themes of memory, loss, and perception are woven into every puzzle, fail state, and hidden file.

Dig deeper... if you dare – Some truths aren’t visible in-game...

This is a game about letting go, and the terrible beauty of holding on.
Some loops can’t be broken. But some can.

Features:

Interaction-Based Puzzle Gameplay – Every interaction moves the clock forward, forcing players to plan their actions wisely.

Bullet Hell Boss Fights – Intense, rhythmic battles reward players with new inventory items.

Psychological Narrative – A mystery about memory, loss, and identity unfolds with each loop.

Persistent Items & Progression – Certain items carry over between loops, unlocking new paths and possibilities.

Train Setting – A dreamlike train environment filled with unique NPCs hiding secrets.

summary:
Getting Goopy is a puzzle platformer where you can slide, jump, and shoot goo to solve various puzzles.

Collect goo to grow, or shoot goo to shrink in this collection of small but tightly designed puzzles! Manipulate your way through a selection of rooms that will test both your brain and your platforming skill.

How to Play

Using arrow keys to move and a mouse to aim shoot, move from level to level flipping switching, opening doors, and bouncing off of anti-goo barriers to find your way to the exit.

Puzzles, Pipes, and Platforming

Abstractly themed worlds are connected by a series of strange pipes that will take you from puzzle to puzzle, introducing new ideas and expanding on them in unexpected ways. Once a concept is mastered, it's swiftly ditched in favor of a fresh new idea! While finding your way through worlds, be ready to adapt to new scenarios and experience twists on established concepts.

More About Goo

Experiment with a variety of goo types with unexpected properties. Each world focuses on a different type of goo with it's own set of rules to discover. Whether sticky, bouncy, or with other strange effects, learn through trial and error how to utilize the potential of your goo! Finding surprising interactions is the key to moving forward.

GMTK 2024

Getting Goopy originated as an entry for GMTK Game Jam 2024, where game developers were challenged to create a game in 96 hours with the theme "Built to Scale". Created by developers SilverGold and Flargin with music by Starpiercer_ and Mafti, the game received much acclaim for it's tight design and satisfying movement. Among over 7,000 games, Getting Goopy was selected as a winner by Jam host and renowned game analyst Mark Brown.

summary: Childhood's End is a 1953 science fiction novel by British author Arthur C. Clarke. The story follows the peaceful alien invasion of Earth by the mysterious Overlords, whose arrival ends all war, helps form a world government, and turns the planet into a near-utopia. Many questions are asked about the origins and mission of the aliens, but they avoid answering, preferring to remain in their ships, governing through indirect rule. Decades later, the Overlords eventually show themselves, and their impact on human culture leads to a Golden Age. However, the last generation of children on Earth begin to display powerful psychic abilities, heralding their evolution into a group mind, a transcendent form of life.

summary:
The Ghost of Alcantra is a free kinetic romance/mystery vn that alternates between two perspectives, one focusing on a blossoming romantic relationship, and another focused on unraveling a murder mystery.

Features: 

Free

Around 175,000 words

Sprites and CGs done by YuukiPudding + Rhealess (14 Sets of Character sprites, plus 26 CGs)

Classical music soundtrack

Edited photo backgrounds of the Upper Peninsula of Michigan (the setting for the visual novel)

Kinetic with a complete ending

Takes place in the Midwest

The Ghost of Alcantra is a passion project made by four people. It is a free kinetic romance/mystery vn that alternates between two perspectives, one taking place in 1987 and one taking place in 1997. In 1987, Nick Fox meets the mysterious Alexandria (who seems to know more than she lets on) at the Summer Festival of Alcantra. They become closer, but at the same time, Alcantra finds itself the center for a series of murders. In 1997, an unknown narrator gets hit by a motorcycle and ends up in the hospital with amnesia. A detective, Scarlet Storm, informs him that a murder has just occurred and gives him a note found with his belongings that says: “Her blood is on your hands.” He joins Detective Storm to assist in the case in hopes that doing so will help him recover his memories. She tells him that the townspeople think the murder was done for The Ghost of Alcantra. As the events progress, it becomes clear that the events of 1997 are connected to those of 1987.

If you’re looking for a fairly lengthy visual novel focused around a central romance and mystery, consider The Ghost of Alcantra. There are many great visual novels that involve different routes or dating sim elements, but if you’re wanting to experience a narrative that emphasizes a singular, fleshed-out story, consider checking out The Ghost of Alcantra.

Content Advisory: Profanity, Violence, Gore, Suicide

summary:
Recruit Heroes, gear up and face the threats of the Pixel Frontier! This engine-building, dice-rolling, turn-based strategy game has 36 Hero classes to choose from – each with their own sets of abilities, upgrades, synergies and strategies for near endless possibilities.

Pixel Frontier: Tactics is a turn-based strategy game with a difference. Instead of action points and cool-downs, your Heroes will roll dice every turn and spend the values they roll to use their abilities.

Victory in battle will require careful planning, both setting up your Heroes for success in the base with powerful equipment and upgrades; and preparing to defeat dangerous enemies with clever tactics and strategies on the battlefield itself.

Heroes come in 36 unique classes; Knights are experts in defence, using heavy armour and their rigorous martial training in battle, whereas Alchemists brew powerful and dangerous potions, but can have explosive accidents if they lose control of their experimental craft.

Each Hero class has access to 13+ unique abilities, with their own dice costs, effects and strategies. With over 450 abilities in total there is an incredible variety and depth of options to discover and master.

Each Hero will start with a few basic abilities and then unlock more as they increase in level. As they level up, you’ll also upgrade these abilities, changing their effects, costs and more, as well as upgrading your Hero’s dice to fit your new abilities. Each Hero is their own puzzle, and finding the right combinations of dice, abilities and Heroes will be your key to victory.

Gameplay in Pixel Frontier: Tactics is split into two main sections: the Base and Missions. Missions are fast-paced, high-stakes encounters with your enemies. Your Heroes may survive one or two defeats in combat, but in the Frontier, death is an ever-present danger.

Between missions, you’ll recruit more Heroes, level up after a successful mission, equip loot and buy equipment or upgrade your facilities.

Gameplay

Monster Pod Quest is a party-based creature collecting RPG, but with unlimited possibilities for the monsters you may encounter and create.

Breed new powerful species.

Show off and trade your creatures online.

About the AI

All the pixel art training data was either free to use commercially (Creative Commons license), or assets which I bought. A huge thank you to all the artists involved - see in-game credits for names.

MPQ is not about replacing human art with AI-made images - it is a new type of game entirely, with creatures and worlds generated during gameplay based on player choices. This isn't possible without AI, and has not been done before.

The images are generated on your computer while you play, so you will need a decent (but not necessarily high-end) GPU or generation will be slow.

Queen's Court: A Duel of Dignitaries is an online competitive card game with layers of strategy for all skill levels. Each player has two piles of cards, the player with the lowest count between cards at the end of the round wins the round! It takes two round wins to win the game!

START OF THE GAME

Each player receiving two face up cards and three cards in hand. The remaining cards are the draw deck in the center. There is also a glove card for each player.

ROUND MECHANICS

Each round starts with the next player in clockwise order. A round is won by having the lowest spread of numbers between your two piles. ie the difference between the shown numbers on your piles. 

For example, the left pile shows 5 and the right pile shows 2, the spread is 3. Or, if both cards show 9 and 9, the spread is 0 (a zero sum spread).

QUEEN CARDS

The Queen cards are wild, when played on any pile, they are equal to the number shown on the adjacent pile. Making a Zero sum spread. (The best possible hand) 

If both piles have Queens, this is the highest possible spread. (The worst possible hand) If this hand is showing at the end of the round, it is an automatic loss for that player, regardless of any other players spread. 

GAME PLAY: FIRST HALF OF ROUND

Each player takes turns in clockwise order. On their turn, a player places one card from their hand onto any of the player piles, including their own. This may change the spread for that player.

After playing a card, the player receives one card from the center deck. If a player plays a card resulting in a zero sum spread between two piles, they draw two cards from the center pile, instead of one.

Play continues until all cards from the center deck have been drawn, completing the first half of the round.

After years of hiding your magical powers, you’ve been accepted into Peridot Pines University—as well as its secret society of magicians! Better still, you’ve got a sweet job as a barista at Witch’s Brew, the cafe where Hecate Society meetings take place. The catch? Witch’s Brew is struggling: even on a college campus, it’s hard to keep a coffee shop open. They need all the help they can get to keep it open—especially yours. The other catch? Magic is supposed to be secret—and the new university chancellor suspects that something is up. 

Can you make the grade in both your mundane and magical classes, while still putting your best effort towards making your customers happy at the coffee shop?  What will you do when specters start appearing all over campus? Or when spells go awry and the chancellor gets suspicious, how will you cover it up: with quick-talking persuasion, more magic, or with the combined effort of all of your friends? 

Or, maybe you’re starting to fall for one of those friends? Pierced, punk, red-headed Rowan has hard-to-control magic that crackles with electricity—but when that same magic leaves a trail of daisies behind, it shows that Rowan has a softer side, too. Explore a scientifically grounded version of our solar system in this 2D space adventure. Mine asteroids, fight hostile ships, navigate the cold silence between worlds, and choose your place among rival factions.

Explore, mine, fight, and survive in a scientifically inspired 2D space adventure set in a fully explorable version of our own solar system, with distances modeled to real-world astronomical scale.

Jump Drive Travel
Engage your jump drive to traverse massive distances across the solar system in seconds. Perfect for reaching distant planets, moons, or deep-space stations across a to-scale map of our solar system.

NASA, 1969

You did it! You finally landed an internship at NASA, the National Aeronautics and Space ... Association? Agency? Authority? You're not really sure what the last "A" stands for, but it's only your first day. You're pretty certain you'll figure it out soon enough.

MoonShot is a modern text adventure game, where you interact with the story through your choices. Whether or not you remember the old Infocom games, this should be fun and playable.

Each day in the game, your boss gives you a checklist to complete to make the mission a success.  Your tasks are well-reasoned and appropriate to your skill level as an intern.  The Apollo team are all competent professionals.  Everything goes very well, and you have no difficulties at all!  ?

Be creative and explore 24 achievements and 9 endings!

Don't like to type?  Auto-complete makes suggestions of verbs and nouns that make sense in context.  It also works on a touch screen!

Born before 1990?  Try "Infocom mode", a dark, monospaced interface more similar to classic text adventures.

Amazd is a 2D fast-paced, pixel-art roguelike dungeon crawler where every second counts! Battle through procedurally generated mazes, slay monsters and powerful bosses, and collect loot to power up and increase your score.

Tutorial

There is a short tutorial that can be accessed from the main menu, which teaches players the ropes of Amazd. You will learn how to fight, move through mazes and beat the game!

Main Game - 8 Levels

There is a series of 8 levels in Amazd, each one contains a procedurally generated maze, with the 8th level being a boss fight! The mazes get increasingly more difficult as you progress. Each maze contains:

-Coins to collect

-Monster to slay

-Powerups and Potions to use

-A portal to the next level

Your score goes down every second! so slay monsters and collect coins to increase your score.

Don't Die!

-You only have 7 hearts, so careful not to die in combat, otherwise game over!

-You have a stamina bar, so careful when sprinting so save stamina!

The aim is to beat all 8 levels as fast as possible, and get a highest score!

Now you can play the classic turn-based strategy board game Dragons of 1066 online.

In Dragons of 1066 each player controls one of four warring kingdoms of Mythic Europe.

summary:
The consul has been brutally murdered and you are the quaestor, a detective who must find the murderer! Interrogate suspects in this challenging, yet lively, dialogue-based adventure. Become a detective of days-old in this Ancient Roman Whodunit Tale.

A Dialogue Based Mystery-Adventure!

Swords and Suspicion is a short, fun detective game set in Ancient Rome. The consul was just assassinated last evening. You play as a quaestor, a Roman detective, who must interrogate a roster of five suspects to determine the criminal. Was it staged? Was the death faked? Was he really killed by a sword? Put on your thinking cap and figure out who did it and how, all through the power of words.

The game displays dynamic, engaging dialogue and dialogue options. The suspects have a variety of personalities, some serious, some timid, and some over-the-top goofy. At the end of the day, it's your call to decide which one is the killer.

Skill Checks: Variety by Chance!

In Swords and Suspicion, the player can roll on certain skill checks to change up each playthrough. This feature adds an element of RANDOMNESS and can lead to some very interesting, revealing dialogue (or sometimes very funny...) Each playthrough will bring a different piece to the puzzle of solving this murder! The first time you might crack it, but there might be details you missed by failing checks along the way. That's why we encourage you to try playing the game through more than once (especially since it is not too long either).

YOU!

So, what're you waiting for? This game is for those who are interested in fun dialogue, challenging puzzle-like thinking, murder-mysteries, detective work, Ancient Rome, and an overall light-hearted (yet grave and mysterious) adventure! summary:
Mine, fight and grow stronger while the World Eater devours everything behind you faster and faster.

In each journey, you push through a chain of procedurally generated worlds. You mine resources, fight armies, and grow stronger. Decisions you make shape your journey.

The World Eater devours worlds behind you at ever-increasing speed. When it reaches you, your journey ends, but the permanent upgrades carry forward, making each run stronger than the last.

World Perks

World perks are obtained through leveling and winning battles. They provide progression within a single world. Perks are not only passive bonuses, but also entities that you can craft, buy, obtain, or lose. 

Permanent Perks

Permanent perks persist between journeys and apply universally. They provide minor bonuses and serve as the game’s primary form of meta-progression.

Bonus Board

The bonus board is built using tiles and allows players to customise their active universal bonuses. Bonus board progression persists between journeys.

Crystals

Crystals function as the game’s equipment system. They are randomly generated across multiple tiers, providing bonuses and sometimes altering core mechanics. Crystals persist between journeys.

A battle between teams is a sequence of duels. In each round, a random soldier from each side is selected to fight. The team with the last soldier standing is the winner.

The winning probability between soldiers is determined by their weakness and offence values.

Soldiers can also have modifiers that alter the normal flow of combat. Here are some examples:

Suicide - When killed, also kills the killer.

Trickster - When fighting, reverses the outcome probability.

Initiate - Will always fight if possible. 

The game offers approximately 20–40 hours of gameplay in Standard mode and features high replayability due to procedural generation.

The gameplay is active and involves planning and strategic thinking. 

Multiple game modes are available, including a Relaxed mode

summary:
A realistic paranormal simulator

Almost 100 unique cryptids — coming to the full game

Realism

Cryptid Engine is a slow-burn paranormal investigation sim built for players who'd rather wait in the dark for three minutes than get jump-scared every thirty seconds. There are no puzzles. No objectives ticking down in the corner of your screen. Just you, a camera, and something in the environment that may or may not be aware you're there yet.

Adjust the behavior of creatures.

Change the texture/sound/model for almost any visual asset used in a map.

The game uses morph keys for variety. Creating a creature is as simple as making a few random poses in Blender and  then letting the game randomly pick the values.

Use Creds to complete the mission but save enough for a ticket to Mars. Five difficulty levels to hone your skills. Variable Assignment editor for fun.

3096. The last year anyone lived on Earth. The Martians stripped the surface bare. Air, water, plants and animals, packed-up and shipped off to Mars.

The last structure left was the giant hexagonal entrance to the HHI preservation. Hector and his company took refuge underground. Earth, as a named place, was now contained entirely in the underground Preservation. The surface was renamed 3096, a sterile number befitting a dead rock.

But now it is getting even worse. The Martians are making war on the EL:ONE system.

"Elle", the polystellar metallian superform, built the EL:ONE stations in an attempt to save humanity. Now, many of those she once protected join the Martians and rise against her.

She collects debris from the war, gathering it from across the Sol system with her salvage bots. The material is taken back to 3096 for reprocessing. Elle doesn't want the Martians getting their hands on her parts, even after they are blown up.

Her barges dump scrap constantly, threatening to bury the HHI entrance building. Hector has designed tech that will speed the disintegration of the debris. Mycogrid is a hybrid ionizing semi-emergent fungellian. It packs a powerful charge that vaporizes the scrap. If enough Mycogrid is started in an area it will become self-sustaining.

To help program the autotanks that build the Mycogrid machine, a contest is being held. Successful mission data is added to the algorithm and the players energy Creds are used to bid for a seat on a rocket to Mars.

Good Luck!

name: 永夜协奏曲
summary:
《永夜协奏曲》是一款关于黑夜、羁绊与救赎的文字冒险游戏。在见不到太阳的世界里，两位少女同行，感受她们之间逐渐建立的信任，探索永夜背后的秘密，并见证属于她们的最终答案。

黑夜降临，与你的意志何干？但若有人愿意为你点亮微光，那便足以成为继续前行的理由。

一百年前，世界陷入永恒的黑夜。陆地逐渐被黑色的潮水淹没，生灵在暗影中发生变异。幸存的人类蜷缩在残存的高地之上，日复一日，等待着一个或许永远不会再来的黎明。

独自流浪的少女辛芙拉不知道自己该去往何方，直到她遇见了玛丽。

两个身处永夜之中的少女，因为一次偶然的相遇，踏上了一段未知的旅程。穿越被黑暗侵蚀的森林，探索危机四伏的世界，她们逐渐接近那座隐藏于远方的高塔，也逐渐发现这个世界的黑夜并不像传闻中那般简单。

古老的种族、被掩埋的过去，以及隐藏在两人身上的秘密，都将在旅途中逐渐揭开。

而当真相终于浮现时，她们必须面对一个关乎命运的选择。

Balloon Chess is a roguelite take on chess, where you fight through waves of enemies and challenging boss matches as you ride an elevator to the top floor. Get powerful new abilities, imbue your balloons with passive effects, and build up a 'deck' of backup balloons to take on higher challenges.

Chess as a roguelite "elevator battle"

In standard chess, a pawn may move two spaces on its first move. In Balloon Chess, rocket boots can propel a pawn straight to the back row for a promotion. You'll need advantages like that (and like your on-call sniper balloon) to fight through seemingly endless waves of enemies and take on the higher difficulties, where the enemies come in greater numbers and have their own unique effects.

No need for chess knowledge

Legal moves are visualized for the player, and typical chess strategies are useless.

Gain power through active abilities, passive effects, and king upgrades

Earn daBloons in the elevator to spend on upgrades. Spend these on powerful activated abilities, or expand your "balloon box" - a backup set of pieces that can be imbued with powerful passive effects.

For each elevator difficulty you finish, you'll unlock a unique boss battle. Victory here will grant a new king, each with their own starting board and 'ultimate' skill.

Permanent Progression

Win or lose, you'll come out of each fight with currency for upgrades.

summary:
In this addictive free physics game, help Mimi clean nature by throwing abandoned masks into dumpsters while mastering rebounds, precision and chaos.

In Pick Up Your Masks, nature is slowly being overwhelmed by the waste left behind by humans. Forests, walking trails, roadsides and natural areas are now covered with discarded FFP masks abandoned without any respect for the environment. Faced with a situation that has sadly become a real problem across the world, Mimi refuses to look away.

During his walks, this brave little cat collects abandoned masks in an attempt to clean nature and make the environment safer again for both animals and people. Your mission is to help him throw all these wastes into wooden dumpsters through a physics-based game that is both accessible and highly addictive.

But behind its simple and relaxing appearance, Pick Up Your Masks hides a real challenge built around precision, rebounds, timing and controlled chaos. Every mask you throw can completely change the situation inside the dumpster. Some masks get stuck between wastes, others bounce unpredictably, while unstable piles become harder and harder to manage as the levels progress. You will need to learn how to use physics to your advantage in order to avoid disaster.

Because here, a single mistake can end everything. If one mask touches the ground, the game is immediately over. This constant tension turns every throw into a critical moment where strategy, speed and precision must work together.

The game features two unique throwing mechanics that make every match dynamic and different. The first paw allows you to release masks exactly where you want in order to create precise stacks or unblock difficult situations. The second paw constantly moves from left to right across the screen and requires perfect timing to achieve the most difficult throws. The further you progress, the harder the dumpsters become to fill and the more the wastes inside them interfere with your strategy.

summary:
Tears of Viceroy is a multiplayer strategy game of interstellar conquest, diplomacy and resource control. Form alliances, forge suzerainties, and outmaneuver rivals in a week-long battle of wits and ambition. For the homeworld!

ToV is a slow real-time / turn-based hybrid game, where turns (called ticks) end automatically. A typical game (called a campaign) takes a week or longer.

ATWAR (Advance Tick When All Ready) mode allows to advance ticks faster, making possible to play the whole campaign in one evening.

Rule-based diplomacy:

Defense pacts with defensive wars auto-join

Alliances with shared scan range

Inter-bloc diplomacy (joins, expulsions, war declarations, peace proposals) resolved by vote

Suzerainties with tributes and, well... vassals!

Campaign event notifications are sent to your mobile device (currently Android only), so you don’t need to check the game constantly or keep it running in the background.

No cheating – each client receives only the information it’s allowed to see.

Co-participation info shows which players in your campaign have played (or are playing) other campaigns together – helps detect multi-boxers.

Local tick control lets you review past ticks and preview future (predicted) ones – useful for analysis and planning.

I am just an ordinary person, no different from anyone else. But I won’t let the people I care about disappear just like that. The elders in our village have never allowed anyone to go into that forest, because those who do never come back.

I can’t see what others can with a sixth sense. I used to believe that the unseen never existed here—but I think I was wrong. I’ve heard things that shouldn’t be there. They exist, even if I’ve never seen them. I didn’t believe it, but now I have to.

You play as someone who is forced to enter the forbidden forest in search of his missing sister. Within the forest, many dangerous creatures lurk, but you can’t see them. All you have is a flashlight to help you explore. The flashlight’s battery can run out, so you must search for batteries to keep seeing in the dark.

With limited vision and the darkness of night, the atmosphere in this game becomes even more intense. You have to run when you hear something that isn’t coming from you—but you can’t run forever, as your stamina is limited.

There are objectives in the form of breakers for you to turn on, and most of them require a key. These keys are scattered in various places on the map. You need to find the key from the clue given by the ghost of a creature that only you can hear

After each battle, you collect enemy remains, bones, blood vials and tears, that go straight into your inventory. summary:
Tape Us Out is an asymmetric, online co-op puzzle game. Players are sucked into a VHS tape and must face challenges of logic, coordination, and communication within the universe of old movies to find their way back to reality.

Important: Tape Us Out is a fully online cooperative experience. To play, two players are required, each with their own copy of the game and a a way to communicate with one another.

Narrative

It all begins when two friends, passionate about antiques, stumble upon a garage sale. Curious, they explore the place in search of relics until they come across a box full of VHS tapes. Among familiar and worn-out titles, one tape stands out: Tape Us Out — a name neither of them had ever heard before.

Excited, they decide to have a surprise movie session that afternoon. Little did they know that by pressing play, they were about to dive into something far beyond a simple film…

In the blink of an eye, the two are pulled into the TV.

Now trapped, they must journey through worlds inspired by different cinematic genres: from epic high-fantasy adventures, to the tension of a crime thriller where every second counts to defuse a bomb, and even the horror of being hunted by a monster.

List of Features

Two players, each with their own unique perspective.

Mandatory online cooperative experience.

Environments based on six films from distinct genres.

Immersive narrative with a nostalgic VHS-inspired aesthetic.

Gameplay focused on communication and coordination between players.

No maps, hints, or in-game tutorials — everything depends on cooperation.

Solve Together

You have no maps. No hints.

All you have is each other’s mind — and your voices.

Don’t forget: the only way out is by working together.

Stratum Defence Team is a local co-op base defense game for up to 4 players, set on hostile worlds. Defend your mineral extraction outpost. Build walls and turrets, fight on the front lines, and adapt through evolving upgrades to withstand intensifying assaults.

Stratum Defence Team is a local co-op base defense game for up to 4 players, set on hostile worlds. Your squad is deployed to defend mineral extraction outposts in contested territory.

Each mission follows a cycle of building, defending, and upgrading as enemy pressure increases.

BUILD

Begin with limited resources and a vulnerable extraction site. Construct walls, deploy turrets, and shape the battlefield to control enemy movement and establish defensible positions. Strong layouts create breathing room. Weak ones expose the base.

DEFEND

When the assault begins, players fight alongside their fortifications. Reinforce weak points, repair damage, and respond to shifting threats in real time. Turrets provide sustained firepower, but survival depends on coordination and positioning.

Enemy forces vary by world, requiring adjustments in tactics and structure placement.

UPGRADE

Between assaults, the team returns to the dropship to invest in new structures, stronger defenses, and improved weapons. Upgrade decisions shape the next phase and allow strategies to evolve over the course of a run.

LOCAL CO-OP

Designed for shared-screen play, Stratum Defence Team is built around the classic couch co-op experience. Sitting side by side, players coordinate roles, share resources, and adapt together as the defense is tested.

The game rewards communication, collaboration, and quick decision-making — whether playing solo or with a full team locally.

HOSTILE WORLDS

Defend extraction outposts across distinct planetary environments, each with its own enemy forces and battlefield layouts that require different defensive approaches.

Success comes from understanding both the terrain and the threats it presents.

summary:
Writer Mark heads to a prestigious literary gathering, but a storm, blocked bridges, and a wrecked truck trap him on the road. Desperate, he turns onto a rural path—only to enter something no book ever prepared him for.

You are Mark — a writer and photographer searching for inspiration.
A nighttime road through endless fields leads you to a private estate deep within a dying forest. A sudden storm, a deer in the headlights, a crash, a stalled engine — and a single house glowing in the darkness. With no signal, no help, and nowhere else to go, you step inside. The gate slams shut behind you. That’s when everything goes wrong.

This abandoned refuge feels almost inviting at first. But soon the air shifts, the house decays, memories twist, and reality fractures. Rot blooms beneath the wallpaper. Bodies appear where no one should be. Flowers whisper through the walls, intoxicating the air with confusion and terror. Something in this place is alive, hungry — and waiting.

The further you go, the less the world resembles itself.
Rooms rearrange. Hallways stretch. Visions crawl out of the dark. What started as a search for creative spark becomes a struggle for survival, sanity, and truth. In the depths of the estate lies the source — a presence feeding on minds and turning flesh into roots. To escape, Mark must uncover its origin, create an antidote, and decide how the story ends: extinguish the house, or let it consume him.

Gameplay Features:

— Atmospheric psychological horror
— Exploration, tension, and narrative discovery
— Reality distortion, hallucinations, shifting environments
— Environmental puzzles and item-based progression
— A final choice with consequences

A house forgotten by the world.
A forest suffocated by silence.
A writer who came looking for inspiration — and found something far worse.

summary:
Soar higher in Flying Up, a 3D platformer game with unique mechanics! Fly across platforms, but be careful there are no checkpoints! Never give up, always rise up. Can you reach the top?

Fly Up is a single-player 3D platformer where you play as a bird trying to reach the top. There are no checkpoints, no shortcuts, and no climbing. Just platforms floating in the sky and your ability to move between them using precise timing and limited flight.

Instead of classical platformer mechanics like wall jumps, climbing or grabbing edges, the game challenges you to navigate using controlled flying. Your energy bar depletes as you fly and only recharges while grounded, making every second in the air count. A poorly timed jump or misjudged dash can send you falling back down, result you to start from the beginning.

The level is long and continuous, with gradually increasing difficulty the higher you go. Early sections allow you to get comfortable with the controls, while later areas test your mastery of movement and flight management.

Key Features

Skill-based vertical platforming with a focus on movement and different mechanics 

Flight system with limited energy, requiring careful flight and landings

Single, uninterrupted level designed to offer a steady challenge from start to finish

Cartoon-like 3D visual design, focused entirely on gameplay without distractions

Solo experience that rewards persistence, learning, and improvement over time

Fly Up is built for players who enjoy mastering movement-based challenges and pushing themselves to reach just a little bit higher with each run. If you appreciate platformers that demand focus, consistency, and a bit of patience, this game offers a straightforward but satisfying journey upward—one that’s as much about the climb as it is about the destination.

Earn a quadrillion dollars before time expires in this intense strategy game. Click pachinko balls and get paid when they bounce or when they land in multiplier slots at the top of each level. Pause and plan before buying payout upgrades, and consider how each purchase changes the other prices.

WHAT UPGRADE SHOULD YOU BUY NEXT?

Pause the timer, compare your options, and commit to one target stat instead of buying randomly.

Each purchase changes the prices of other upgrades, so your best move is usually to discount your target stat first, then buy it.

SHOULD YOU PRESTIGE NOW OR PUSH FOR MORE MONEY?

If your earnings stall, prestige to reset your money while keeping your stats so you can buy more upgrades and scale faster.

If you are close to victory, keep your money and finish the level.

HOW SHOULD YOU SPEND YOUR METAPROGRESSION XP?

Use metaprogression to boost the stat path you want to focus on during runs.

If you specialize, your upgrades become more powerful when that stat appears, but your run is riskier if the randomized shop does not offer the stat you want to buy.

If you want safer runs, spread your metaprogression XP across multiple stats.

summary:
Quantum Dogfight is a 2-player guessing strategy game where players must correctly locate all of their opponent's planes on a hexagonal grid. Inspired by the principles of quantum mechanics, Quantum Dogfght is a fun and interactive way to learn about superposition and measurement collapse.

Superposition

Quantum Dogfight is a guessing strategy game centered around the quantum mechanical principle of superposition.  At the beginning of each game both players place their planes in two distinct locations, as shown below.

Guessing Locations

The core gameplay of Quantum Dogfight is turn-based guessing of each player's plane locations. While in superposition, both locations of a plane can be 'attacked', with the goal of successfully attacking all locations of either locations.  

Measurement Collapse

While attacking your opponent's hex tiles is the way to win, players must also monitor their own board and strategically choose when to invoke a 'measurement collapse'.  This action begins a measurement like shown below, which probabilistically chooses one of the two superposition locations to be final location of the plane.  Players will want to utilize measurement collapses to confuse their opponent, but be warned, just like in quantum machanics you can't control probability!

Learning Quantum Mechanics

Quantum Dogfight was designed with young STEM-oriented students in mind, providing a fun and interactive way to learn about elements of quantum mechanics.  Found within Quantum Dogfight is a learning module which helps students understand how principles of quantum mechanics are woven into the mechanics of the game.

Ways to Play

Quantum Dogfight v1.0.0 features two ways for players to enjoy the game.

     Local - Players take turns sharing a single computer

   Online - Players can connect from two computers over the internet

summary:
In a world, where fighting games require 15 years of practice to memorize the combos, inputs, and characters, don't you wish you could just... Bonk them? That's where Bonk-A-Donk comes in! A 2D platformer fighter turned bumper-cars, there is no need to memorize tech! Just hit them!

A 2D platformer fighter turned bumper-cars, there is no need to memorize tech! Just hit them!

I didnt like how input-complex games like SSBU, or for better examples, Street fighter or guilty gear get. their controls are fundamnetally non-intuitive to the average joe, which creates the ever present phenomena of button mashing to win in a party setting.

I thought, whats a simple character controller method that would be intuitive to pick up quickly, but has a very high skill ceiling? Pure movement.

hence, the idea for this game was born, several years ago.

that is to say, with 8 maps and 7 unique and selectable abilities upon playtesters release, Bonk-a-donk was born! 
This game is meant to be super smash brothers, but WAY less complex controls. I eventually have plans for many updates, but for now, this is the bare essentials!

4 players max in a match, with local play and rollback-based multiplayer over LAN or steam servers. You can change your sprites color or add a hat out of 21 options for your lil guy. There are different types of surfaces, ones that are bouncy like you are, ones that are sticky (heh), and regular ol' platforms. 

Along with 4 ability slots to mix and match the abilities however you want, you can customize your input binds however you'd like. this will be updated in the future.

Join the discord and find people to play with, or just play with friends locally or using steam lobby codes. 

The creation of this game was supposed to just be a tertiary hobby for a year during 3rd year engineering university. then it turned into my entire free time. then i payed 100$ to get it on steam, then im creating official steam page art (with the help of TreeGuy, hes a cool guy)

summary:
Explore a fog-choked, twisted version of UCSC in this 2D puzzle horror game, where cryptic clues and buried memories reveal the disturbing truth behind one man's obsession...

Welcome to UCSC—well, kind of.

This isn’t the sunny college campus you remember. In this 2D puzzle horror game, you're dropped into a fog-drenched, twisted version of UC Santa Cruz where nothing feels quite right. Familiar landmarks are warped, the silence is heavy, and the mist hides more than just bad weather.

You’ll explore eerie paths and unsettling buildings as you piece together the story behind Markus—a guy with a past so dark, it’s bleeding into reality. Solve creepy puzzles, uncover buried memories, and try not to get too lost in the fog (literally and emotionally). 

Key Features:

? Puzzle-Based Exploration: Navigate through haunted versions of labs, libraries, and forest trails. Solve logic puzzles to unlock new areas and piece together fragments of Markus’s mind.

?️ Atmospheric Horror: Inspired by Silent Hill and Mad Father, this game focuses on slow-building dread, psychological unease, and eerie sound design—not some cheap jump scares.

?️ A Twisted UCSC Campus: Iconic locations like the Quarry Plaza and Porter Meadow are reimagined in a surreal nightmare. Expect familiar spaces, distorted by guilt and memory.

? Narrative-Driven Gameplay: Dive into a branching, emotionally charged story with themes of trauma, regret, and identity. Your choices affect how much of Markus’s truth you uncover.

? Estimated Playtime: 1–2 hours

Inspired by spooky favorites like Mad Father and the chilling vibes of Silent Hill, this game mixes emotional storytelling with mind-bending mystery. It’s not about cheap scares—it’s about slowly realizing that something’s really wrong here...

On a side note...all characters, locations, and events in this game are entirely fictional. While the setting draws inspiration from the real UC Santa Cruz campus, this is not a reflection of the actual university.

压抑住喜欢的心情，持续和副教授发生关系的奈月。只跟男人当床友，下定决心不认真谈恋爱的樱井。在情伤的阴影下，对恋爱裹足不前的绫乃。忘不了死去的男友，却和任教的高中男学生发生关系的夏芽。邂逅为情所困的女性，四篇既心酸又甜蜜的〝密约〞。

　　フラれた傷心で参加した合コン。そこで出会ったバツイチの男と、一夜を共にした。それで終わるはずだった。しかし彼はなんと、自分の担当教授だった！お互い、「もう恋愛はこりごり」という合意の元、教授室で身体だけの関係を続けることに。でも、身体を重ねる度に心が引き裂かれていくのは何故…！？表題作「官能密約」をはじめ、男性不信の女が上司と“身体だけ”の契約を結んでしまう「真夜中に誓いはいらない」、亡き恋人を心に秘めた人に惹かれてしまった悲恋を描く「君の涙を抱きしめて」などなど、官能的なものから感涙必至なストーリーまで、読みごたえたっぷりな読みきり集となっています。

summary:
公元22世纪，人类开始殖民太阳系。就像历史上英国与美洲殖民地产生了矛盾一样，地球与她的殖民地之间，也因为资源的问题产生了矛盾，整个太阳系被划分为两派，一边是母星地球与卫星月球，另一边则是其他行星结成的联盟，战争即将爆发。
此时，地球当局发现，月球上的科研基地里，有人一直在偷偷泄露情报。于是，反间谍专家萨德勒临危领命，伪装成审计员，前往月球。
在荒凉的月球表面，来自地球的光芒一直照拂着大地。没有人知道，月球表面之下到底隐藏着什么样的秘密。随着萨德勒的调查逐渐深入，他发现，间谍所使用的手段，是他怎么也想不到的……

name: God Bless You, Dr. Kevorkian
summary: In God Bless You, Dr. Kevorkian, Kurt Vonnegut skips back and forth between life and afterlife as if the difference between them were rather slight.This fictional adventure, that began as a series of 90-second interludes for WNYC, New York City's public radio station, has evolved over the past year as a strange and lasting work of the imagination. God Bless You, Dr. Kevorkian follows on Vonnegut's three previous works, the bestselling novel Timequake, Bagombo Snuff Box: Uncollected Short Fiction and, with Lee Stringer, Like Shaking Hands with God (Seven Stories Press).

name: Sucker's Portfolio
summary:
Available to readers for the first time, Sucker’s Portfolio showcases a collection of seven never before published works from Kurt Vonnegut, one of the greatest writers of the 20th century. Short, sardonic, and dark, these six brief fiction stories and one non-fiction piece are consummate Vonnegut with piercing satire and an eye for life’s obscene inanity. Also available for the first time is an unfinished science-fiction short story, included in the appendix.

These stories trace trivial human lives and mundane desires, which is precisely where Vonnegut’s inimitable perspective as a humanist shines, illuminating his alternating hopeful and dismal outlook, although undoubtedly focusing on the latter. Here as in his greatest novels, Vonnegut’s writing takes us to the darkest corners of the human soul and with wit and humor, manages to remind us of our potential to be something greater.

这是一个第三人称动作游戏，在游戏中你将扮演一位武士，面对强大的敌人，你的技巧和反应将会得到考验。
玩法介绍：

 你将操控一位武士，进行闯关并击杀敌人，或者在特定地图里击杀敌人，升级变得更加强大，当然也可以在试炼中生存的更久来证明自己。
操作介绍：

 游戏操作简单易懂，没有复杂的键位，除了基础的WASD移动和鼠标轴视觉，还有以下操作键位（此为初次运行默认键位，可以在游戏中更改）：
 轻攻击——鼠标左键
 派生攻击/格挡——鼠标右键
 上挑攻击——键盘Q键
 跳跃/闪避——键盘空格
 视野距离——键盘C键
 同时角色操作也支持手柄输入（注：游戏开发时期采用xbox360手柄调试，因为我只有这一个游戏手柄）；

 派生攻击可以在轻攻击以后一定时间内触发，派生攻击有单点式攻击，也有按住无限连打，玩家可以按照自己的想法创造连击；
 玩家闲置状态下无法进行派生攻击，而是触发格挡状态，格挡可以有效的抵消敌人造成的伤害，并同时向后跳跃攻击;
 上挑攻击可以在跳跃攻击的同时将敌人击飞，然后输入轻攻击或者派生攻击后可以追加伤害;
 玩家闲置状态或者移动状态下跳跃可以让玩家移动到高处，在空中再次按下跳跃可以实现二连跳;
 玩家攻击状态下按下跳跃键可以进行向后移动的闪避动作，之后可以输入轻功击向前突进，或是输入派生攻击向后进行跳跃攻击，闪避动作没有冷却时间，可以无限次使用，也可以在任何情况下使用，当然挨揍时和死了是不行的~
游戏地图

 游戏共用6个地图，4个闯关地图，1个可以成长的RPG地图，1个无限循环的试炼地图。闯关地图通关后有几率获得武器和角色皮肤；成长的RPG地图boss也有几率获得一个专属武器皮肤和专属角色皮肤；试炼地图则可以无限循环直到死亡，最好的成绩将会显示在游戏主界面上。

summary:
Silencer is a bureaucratic simulation game about censorship and misinformation in journalism and politics. As a low-level news censor employed by the authoritarian government, Ogalia, the player will interpret censorship protocols, read news articles, and decide if an article should be taken down.

Overview

The oppressive regime has been overthrown, but the new government is just as bad, if not worse… And you are a low-level news censor recently employed by the new Ogalian regime. While journalism and politics are full of censorship and misinformation, you will wrestle with the ultimate choice: Should you censor dissenting voices for the government or let the people be heard?

Key features

 You read and take down articles that violate rules. That's it. 

 Who doesn’t make mistakes? Your job is still safe, but you have to write an apology to the government every time you slip. 

 Government employees, including YOU, must drink tea, or you get fired. Where does the tea come from? You buy it from a government-owned shop. 

 And you might find yourself running out of money quickly, thanks to all the mandatory tea purchases. Maybe you should consider taking a bribe? 

 And long live Ogalia. Never forget to say it. Long live Ogalia.

summary:
Ender pearl speedrunning game. A 3D Platformer based around teleportation, with hand drawn animated cutscenes. Solo dev passion project.

(if you're fast enough)

ENDER is a game about going fast, but doesn't punish you for taking your time. 
In essence, it is a 3D platformer focused on teleportation. The reason so few platformers have straight up teleport mechanics is cause they usually break every platforming game design principle known to man when introduced. But this game and its levels are made from the ground up to support this break in convention. Use them to get to places you wouldn't reach. Use them as a makeshift checkpoint to teleport back to. Hell, use them to get 2 meters forwards slightly faster than by walking.

There are timed bronze/silver/gold medals, these are not needed to advance in the game, their main purpose is to let you know that level you are fast in... well... you are REALLY fast in that one. Good job.

While not the focus, there are also some some light, open-ended puzzles, and a smidge of combat (that will be expanded upon on the full release).
There is also an optional collectathon element with a heart hidden on every level, as a little easter egg hunt.

ENDER has hand drawn animated cutscenes, but the story itself is rather unconventional. It's a way for me to express some questions I don't know the answers to.

This game is in public alpha so a lot of things (including Steam integration and controller support) are still in the works.
The alpha is playable as the "Demo" here on Steam. Upon full release this game will have a free demo too, but for now I'm using it for you to play it early access for free without any hassle. This game will not be monetized until it is actually done.

In Project Lexa, you take on the role of Lex Kelza, a communications specialist aboard the Galactic Naval Vessel Chanticleer. As your knowledge and understanding of the language improves, you’ll unlock new areas to traverse. summary:
Online Client for the Iso-RPG ECG, Kyoukai! Become an Entrant and battle for victory on the field. No mana resource, a shared field where position matters, story-rich art, and visual novel story missions.

Welcome to Kyoukai ECG Online, the online client for the IsoRPG-inspired TCG! Kyoukai is designed to be a printed Card Game, has no mana resource, and no AI of any kind. 

You are an Entrant in a fighting tournament, run by the mysterious Carnation Society. Called through the Gate into a mysterious new world, you build a deck of 40 Cards (or Gates), and up to 15 Spirits, and battle other Entrants in various online lobbies! You can also learn more about the lore and world of Kyoukai through single player visual novels.

Unique diagonal Gates are played on a diamond 5x5 grid, and familiar mechanics lie at the heart of fast-paced card battles. Each turn, each of your Units has a standard action - they can first move, then either Attack or use their Skill. You can also build your field presence by Opening Gates from your hand - but you can only Open them next to your Ready Gates already on the field. Use your on-field Units, and Normal and Fast Gates from your hand, to approach your opponent's Entrant and deal 20 damage to them!

Choose from 5 Entrants, each with their own unique card pool and deck types! Find your own unique take on your favorite Entrant, or get started with one of each Entrant's multiple pre-build starter decks.

All playable Gates will be available as soon as you download Kyoukai! There will be no unlocks or in-game currency.

summary:
I paid more artists to hide dogs and bones in 15 pieces of artwork. Can you find them all? Warning: Relaxing.

A hidden object game where you must find all the dogs to complete each level.

Key features:

Context:

The brief was simple. I commissioned artists to create a fantasy world, and hide as many dogs and bones as they can inside it. Now it’s your job to find them all! With 15 art pieces to choose from, and 1500+ hidden objects, you will have a lot of searching to do. 

Controls:

Use your mouse to move around the image and zoom in / out. When you find a hidden object, click it and it will disappear. You can also use WASD to move and the arrow keys to zoom. 

Difficulty:

All levels start unlocked, your progress is saved as you play, and you can use hints if you get stuck. 

Get immersed:

Each painting has its own music to help you connect with the world, as you search for everything.

Replayable

You can restore a small number of hidden objects back into a painting so you can find them again! It’s much harder when there are only a few hidden objects left (especially randomly). You can also use up to 3 save slots so you can replay without progress loss. Alternatively, you can reset your progress for the entire game if you’d like to start over.

The Road Diner prologue tells the story of the very beginning of the old diner on Route 66 before the events of the game Road Diner. Unlike the full game, this is the original old diner before the rebuild and you get to run it for a few days on your own.

On first look the old diner is a well frequented business ran by the original owner. Looking closer however it is struggling. The normal folks, the families and travelling salesmen are in decline and the cook left.

It is up to you to take care of the old diner and making it work while taking a closer look at all aspects of the business and introduce changes in order to improve the situation.

Seat patrons at their tables, take their order, serve coffee, take care of refills and eventually handle the check. And looking after them in between is probably a good idea, too. 
Make sure to not overdo it. Too many customers and you might get in trouble serving them in a timely fashion. Nobody likes to wait too long.

Collect empty plates, bring them to the dish washer and clean them. Before doing that, it might be a good idea to wipe the tables and take a look at the floor if nothing has been spilled that might need a clean up. Nobody likes visiting a dirty diner. 

Grill multiple grilled dishes and use the stove to cook more regular ones. Maintain control of the orders and special requests and make sure they not only go out to the customers quick, but also in a good quality. Nobody likes undercooked or overcooked food and mistakes made will be reflected in customer satisfaction and tips.

Getting orders, cooking and serving is just a part of your job. There are many more tasks that have to be taken care of in order to run a successful diner. You obviously have to take care of the pantry and make sure you stock all the ingredients and goods you need.

summary:
Do you ever feel like life is slipping away, with too many dreams left unfulfilled? Like you're trapped in wanting to do so much, but never quite getting to any of it? Doesn't that thought scare you—looking back on a life that accomplished nothing, fading without leaving a mark? It scares me too.

Regrets is a visual coming-of-age story that guides you through the life of an ambitious young person. If you're like me, you still remember all the dreams and ideas you had when you were younger. I created this game as a reminder to always keep pursuing your dreams, and not let the passing of time take them away from you.

Interact with different objects inside the world to learn and master four core skills: sports, science, arts and music. As you grow, unlock new dreams for the future that that you can collect and inspect inside your bedroom. The path you choose affects your future, leading to new sights and activities later in life.

Moving right from room to room in this game is synonymous to moving forward in time. Moving left means reflecting on the past. As you advance, the player goes to different life stages, starting as a baby and ending as an elderly. Every stage unlocks new potential dreams, and leaves some others unattainable.   

Features:

Engaging minigames to improve your skills

Handcrafted pixel-art backgrounds and assets

Developed with passion by a solo creator

One hidden ending in addition to the main one 

The ability to reflect on your past

The inability to change it...

The sun is gone. In a world trapped in eternal moonlight, guide Liora and her companions through the Arcadia dungeons in a story driven JRPG about sacrifice and the bonds formed when the world is already broken.

Story

The sun is gone.

Long ago, a hero sealed the dragons within the Arcadia dungeons to save the world. His victory came at a terrible cost. The sun vanished, leaving Eldoria trapped in eternal moonlight.

As darkness spreads and hope fades, a young orphan named Liora is drawn toward the very dungeons that ended the age of light. With her companions Elysia, Thalia, and Borin, she descends into Arcadia, chasing a fragile hope: that the sun can be restored, and the world given a second dawn.

But some truths are buried deeper than the dungeons themselves.

Key Features

A Persistent Dungeon System

Resources found in one dungeon can be used across others, shaping progression, unlocking paths, and rewarding careful planning. Every decision matters: spend now, or save for what lies ahead.

A Character Focused Journey
Build bonds between party members, uncover their pasts, and see how relationships shape both the story and the road ahead.

Strategic Turn-Based Combat
Classic JRPG combat enhanced by elemental interactions, status effects, and party synergy. Adapt your strategy as enemies evolve.

Deep Crafting and Progression
Gather materials from your journey and craft potions, gear, and powerful equipment essential to surviving the depths of Arcadia.

The Arcadia Dungeons
Navigate interconnected dungeons filled with environmental challenges, hidden routes, and meaningful choices. From frozen caverns to ancient castles, each area builds on the last.

 The sun once saved the world.

Now it’s your turn to decide what it will cost to bring it back.

Wishlist now to stay updated and be among the first to unravel the mysteries of Eldoria.

summary:
The day awaits. Whether it ends with you going to visit family, taking a breath in the park, or hiding inside your apartment, it all can be taken away without you having a say in the matter. Regardless of all the chances that life might provide, one truth persists: carpe diem.

When a crisis occurs, instinct dictates that someone else will take responsibility. 

What happens when crisis befalls you, and all people will do is watch your plight, and go about their day?

Sometimes they can survive to see the end of the day. Other times, they might not. 

Sometimes the choice is in their hands. Other times, they are at the mercy of chance. 

What end is within your reach?

Broad Daylight is a game created by Vagus Truman that subverts common horror tropes found in games, where the horror lies in a lack of identity and agency, and the setting is in a brightly lit area. The player adopts the role of a character that just happens to be the victim of a random killing on their way to whatever the day may take them. Each ending, each insight into their character and being, is up for the player to learn and pick up on as their avatar navigates the world. 

Play Time

The game should take about 10 to 45 minutes to finish. 

Options

The basic setup of volume and graphics settings are dictated by the engine's base settings, from Low to Ultra graphics, and a slider to control master audio.

Gameplay

It is a basic walking simulator, with a dialogue system in place to have the player assume the mentality of the player's avatar as they navigate the small world.

As you explore, you will find puzzle pieces.  if you collect all the pieces for a particular puzzle, they will magically interlock and once activated, will open a portal to a boss fight!  Also sometimes you will find minimalist looking dungeon levels that end in a boss fight too.

When you need a respite from battle, you can teleport to town, where there are a variety of NPCs to help you, from selling and buying gear, resting, healing, hiring mercenaries to aid you your battle.

As you collect experience and level up, not only will you get more health and mana, but you will gain a combat bonus, get points you can spend on increasing your stats, and even get multiple attacks per turn.   The game is a balance between survivability (health), which constitution will help with, combat (strength and dexterity), and spell casting (mana), which intelligence helps with.  You might want to spend some points on luck, as this causes improved drops from chests and monsters; wisdom, which helps with some saving throws, and charisma, which increases the number of mercenaries you can hire.

The game is turn based, with a mixture of text and lots of high-quality images.  It's pretty look at, yet still maintains the feel of a dungeon crawler

A block-based sandbox game where you explore and build freely in infinite procedural worlds. No rules, no restrictions — just you and the world. Shape it however you want.
Build. Explore. Go Further.

Far Horizons is a sandbox game built from the ground up. Explore infinite procedurally generated worlds filled with sprawling cave systems, diverse biomes, and towering terrain — then reshape them block by block.
Features

Infinite Procedural Worlds
Terrain generated with layered noise produces plains, deserts, tundra, and mountains. Branching cave networks carve through the underground, with large caverns waiting to be discovered.

Block Building
Place and break from a selection of 29 block types — natural stone, ores, wood, glass, glowing blocks, and more. Every world is persistent and saved automatically.

Dynamic Lighting
A dual lighting system combines natural sky light with colored block light from sources like glowstone, bringing depth to caves and builds alike.

Your World, Your Rules
Far Horizons will never enforce rules on how you play, what you build, or how you run your servers. Your world belongs to you — not us.
Early Access

Far Horizons is in early development. The core of exploration and building is here, with much more planned. Expect rough edges — and expect them to get polished over time.
