summary:
The Margot Collapse is an incremental game wrapped inside an unsettling mystery. Part workplace simulator, part optimization game, and part surreal short story, it blends methodical progression with a growing sense that something behind the walls of TOPTECH Industries is deeply, profoundly wrong.

You are the newest employee assigned to Project M, an ambitious scientific initiative dedicated to advancing humanity's future through measurable output, operational efficiency, and profitability.

Your workstation awaits.

From the safety of your private research cubicle, you'll conduct experiments using a state-of-the-art Atomisure Portable BioScope 9000 XT. Fire charged isotopes into living cell cultures, collect the resulting compounds, and ship your findings directly to TOPTECH through the pneumatic delivery network. Every successful experiment earns credits. Every credit funds bigger experiments.

Unlock a sprawling web of upgrades that transform simple science into biological chain reactions. Discover new cell types, engineer cascading interactions, and continuously push the limits of scientific output in a deeply satisfying incremental progression system.

But as your research advances, questions begin to emerge.

And who is Margot from HR?

Your performance is being monitored. Please continue your research.

About the Game

ImmoRally is a retro-arcade 2d top down racing game. Collect all checkpoints and head for the start/finish tile to complete a timed lap. Find the most efficient route through all checkpoints. Checkpoints and laps

DYNAMIC TURN ORDER / ACTION ECONOMY

Forget "One action per turn". Turn Order and Action Economy are dynamic, based on Stamina usage. 

Stamina regenerates outside of turns. When your Stamina is full, it’s your turn -> This pauses all Stamina regeneration.

Perform actions as long as you have Stamina. End your turn at any point -> This resumes all Stamina regeneration

If you spend less Stamina, your next turn comes sooner

If you spend more Stamina, your next turn comes later

GREED IS THE DIFFICULTY SLIDER

As you accumulate Echoes, stronger enemies spawn, and gain damage multipliers.

Characters gain Agony when they fail actions. Agony reduces their stats, but multiplies drop rates. 

Reduce your Agony, Tactically outwit your enemies, or just Overwhelm them once you gain more Power.

CHOOSE YOUR RISK, REAP THE REWARDS

Choose from a list of premade Levels when progressing. Do you want easy layouts, or easy modifiers?

Extract your Echoes at the mid-point of Levels, if you please. But you are taxed for your cowardice.

summary:
Hock is a class-based top down hockey game. Select your car from a roster of over 20 classes and use its unique abilities to gain the upper hand against your opponent. Each specific matchup brings a whole new set of challenges to the table making Hock easy to learn but hard to master.

Choose from over 20 classes to push, pull, grab, shoot, shove, slice, and explode your way to victory. Use the classes' unique abilities and nuances to control the puck and dominate your opponent.

The Gunner

Although the Gunner has below average speed and power, it uses its bullet to supplement its mobility and force. With the lowest ability cool-down in the game it is able to use its bullet for a wide range of applications, like using the recoil for speed, shooting the other car to disrupt its movement, or just shooting the puck for a shot on goal.

The Pillbug

The Pillbug is the mascot of Hock. It makes up for its lack of an ability with its excellent power and shape. The Pillbug is able to power through just about every class and can use its rounded shape to hit extremely precise shots with the right player behind the controls.

The Blimp

The Blimp is an extremely light and floaty class that can drop a massive wall into the arena. Since the blimp struggles to push or block classes on its own, it deploys its wall to help out. The usage of the wall greatly depends on the type of Blimp player. Many Blimp players opt for a more defensive strategy, using the wall to block any openings, while many others use it offensively, hurling it at their opponent and the puck like a projectile.

Overall, the gameplay and strategy of Hock greatly is decided by the player! With the wide range of classes and play styles, there is something for every type of person in Hock. What will you play?

summary:
A fast-paced roguelike space shooter where every credit counts. Fight through dangerous sectors, upgrade your ship mid-battle, and convert your earnings into permanent power. Because when you die, you keep what matters.

Fight. Convert. Die. Go back stronger.

Project AionIX is a top-down roguelike space shooter built around a time travel loop. Every run you push through alien-infested sectors, build your ship mid-battle, and collect what you can before the timeline resets. Death is not the end. It is the reset point.

Wave Survival

Already live and ready to play. Wave Survival is a pure arcade mode built around one question: how long can you last?

Endless mode throws infinite scaling waves at you with no endpoint. The only goal is to push further than last time.

Normal mode gives you a fixed gauntlet of waves and a boss waiting at the end. The Drone Master. Beat it and the run is yours.

Online leaderboards are live. Your score is on the board the moment the run ends. This is the competitive backbone of the game, and it is available right now in the free demo.

Two resources. One brutal choice.

Materials are collected during combat and spent in a mid-battle upgrade shop. With a wide range of systems to build and customize, including movement, weapons, defenses, and utility modules, every run offers new strategic possibilities. Upgrade your thrusters, firing patterns, armor, shields, repair systems, and more to adapt to the fight. But when the timeline resets, every upgrade is lost.

Arc Energy is different. At the end of each sector, convert Materials into Arc Energy and store it in your ship's core. Arc Energy persists across timelines. It is the one thing death cannot take from you. Spend it at the Meta Shop on permanent upgrades that carry into every future run.

The choice is always the same: push harder now and spend everything, or pull back, bank your Arc Energy, and come back from the next timeline with more power than before.

Athena

You are not alone

summary:
A short first-person horror game where you wander through an eerie forest using the dials of a microwave.

Midnight Snack is a short and surreal first-person horror game where you wander through an eerie forest using the dials of a microwave.

FEATURES

Alternative and experimental control scheme.

Retro/Pixelart 3D visuals.

Short and sweet, the game takes about 30 minutes to complete.

THE GAMEPLAY

The controls are integrated into the interface itself, modeled after the dials of a conventional microwave. The bottom dial controls the camera direction, while the top dial determines how long the player moves. Once the time has been set, the controls are locked until the top dial stops turning, so be careful.

To interact with the dials, only the mouse is required.

The player must use these unconventional controls to navigate a strange environment in search of a snack, avoiding various obstacles.

THE STORY

The game takes place in the protagonist's recurring nightmare. 

In this nightmare, the protagonist wakes up hungry in the middle of the night, viewing the world from the perspective of a microwave. 

Before reaching the kitchen, he must navigate through a dark and eerie setting, even being attacked within the dream manifestations of his guilt. 

Finally, upon reaching the kitchen and opening the microwave on the table, he will find an unpleasant surprise.

summary:
Fly with a flock of birds in this cozy game with several single and multi-player modes. The game is meant to be pretty, relaxing, and dare we say meditative? Well, you can shoot some birds, too, if you want. So there's that.

Pop It (single player and local multi player modes): you fly one on the birds in the flock - pulling the birds along with you - as you pop balloons.  A balloon scores more points based on how many birds you've drawn near the balloon.  With local multi player, you work together cooperatively.

Hunt It (local multi player mode): one player is the hunter while the other players are birds hidden in the flock.  The players who control the birds must covertly figure out which bird they are controlling, and then tap balloons without the hunter figuring out who they are.  The hunter has a limited number of bullet to shoot birds, with the goal of shooting down all of the birds controlled by players.

Hunt it (single player mode): you progress through stage after stage as you hit the number of targets required to continue on to the next round.  Enjoy some peaceful bonus rounds between the harder and harder stages as you shoot your way to a high score.

Capture It (local multi player mode): each player controls a different colored bird.  Flying over any flocking bird (other than a player-controlled one) will turn that bird to your color, and will increase your bird's influence over the flock.  Turn as many birds possible to your color to win.

Local multiplayer requires the use of game controllers.

More modes are on the way!  We are planning a longer, single-player journey mode where you take the flock on a longer quest while keeping your flock intact.

Please let us know your ideas for more!

Combat

NOT YOUR TYPICAL TURN BASED COMBAT

Destiny Spire features an active time battle system. While battles operate much in the way standard turn based games do, there are no turns. Enemies will continuously attack whenever they are able to (when their speed bar fills up). You can take actions with your party members whenever their speed bar is full, too. Each character can attack with their weapon, special skills, or use items as soon as their speed bar fills up. You can attack with any character at any time as long as their speed bar is full, or you can leave them on standby to take emergency action, like performing a heal, when needed.

WARNING: THE BATTLE WON'T PAUSE SO YOU CAN SELECT AN ACTION!

Be careful! Enemies won’t wait for you and will continue to attack as soon as their speed gauge is full. You’ll need your wits and reflexes to survive! Make sure to make good use of your skills as well!

Light is dark, highs are lows, the pendulum swings one way and then the next. Face the dormant dragons that lie within your emotional and psychological caverns through the power of sound, perception, and energy.

I Dream of Demons. Remix your mind!

A Living Soundscape 

Using a unique combination of music and reactivity, this world lives and breathes - a projection of the player’s mind. See the beat as the environment pulsates and shines in time with this captivating soundtrack.

 Lose energy and the music grows slow and lethargic, as the surrounding world darkens. Likewise, absorb too much energy and the bright lights bloom with impossible colour, as speed suddenly becomes your enemy. Within this dream-like world, the soundscape reacts to your every move.

Remix YOUR Mind 

Discover new depths of your own subconscious as you journey through numerous captivating realms while the world tries to thwart your progress. 

Feel the rhythm as you grapple across nodes and discover what truly lurks in the depths of your mind, with powerful energy pulses that illuminate the world around you.

With hostile threats lurking in the shadows of your mind you must balance light and dark if you want to survive.

Do you dream of demons too?

Sydney and the Cicadas were a punk rock band from Vermont in the early 1990's, consisting of friends and lovers Sydney Wickstrom (lead guitarist/vocalist), Ruby Goodbrey (bassist), and Natalia 'Tally' Disston (drummer). They largely performed as a cover band until the summer of 1992, when they went on an excursion to an abandoned citadel to explore an original album. Only Sydney returned, finishing the band's first and only album Immanentize on September 21, 1993, with the help of Ruby's brother, Reuben.

This adaptation explores the events of the three weeks inside the citadel as told by Sydney and the album, relayed through each of the album's tracks (with music inspired by the track it's played in). Tracks can be played in any order, and can be skipped. Collect and use items, solve puzzles, carry conversation, and play your heart away.

Features include:

Eight engrossing levels and a "B-side" epilogue (2+ hours expected play time)

Casual yet challenging puzzles and minigames

Riotous story about love, chaos, and cycles of violence

Unique gameplay mechanic: play the right chords on your guitar to change the world around you

Computer keyboard and MIDI keyboard controls

Score-attack, combo-centric arcade gameplay with progressing difficulty

Colorful, retro-inspired graphics and soundtrack

一款让声音化为魔法的合作奇幻冒险。 扮演猫咪魔法师，对着麦克风喊出法术，探索童话世界、对抗怪物，并带着满载的战利品返回热气球。

成为猫咪魔法师
扮演可爱、笨拙、难以预测且表情丰富的魔法猫咪。按照自己的喜好自定义猫咪外观。

语音驱动的魔法
用麦克风施放法术。学习新法术，并与猫咪伙伴一起练习。发射火球，让任意物体漂浮，或召唤巨大的龙卷风。

自定义你的法术
为魔法武器库中的每个法术设定独一无二的名称。单词、音节、疯狂组合——给朋友一个惊喜，打造完全属于你的法术套装！

混乱合作玩法
魔法会影响所有人。点燃朋友的尾巴，用漂浮术互相抬过障碍，喵叫复活队友，并一起发现令人捧腹的法术互动。

战利品与撤离
在探险中收集珍贵战利品，一路战斗返回热气球，同时保护你的收获免受怪物侵袭。

童话氛围
探索风格化的漂浮岛屿、奇幻地下城和色彩鲜艳的地点，感受轻松的童话氛围。

summary:
Experience this new take on reactor and factory idle style game! More heat management, more building, more explosions! Hope you have fun!

From the creator of reactor idle, factory idle and city idle! 

Your mission is simple: HEAT UP THE PLANET, Yes, really. 

You’ll start with clean technologies like solar panels that barely produce any heat, but soon begin to research less clean methods to produce even more heat. Who knows—you might 
actually succeed in overheating the planet. 

Managing excessive heat, however, is not an easy task. Be prepared for challenges and, yes, explosions. MANY EXPLOSIONS. In your defense, explosions also help heat up the planet. Explosions cause financial losses and can bankrupt you though...

This game introduces new features gradually. At first, you’ll see only the basics to help you get started, but as you progress, more advanced technologies and mechanics will 
unlock. It is a long journey with plenty to explore. 

Disclaimer: This game is HARD. 
It is also a form of a puzzle game, requiring you to figure out efficient strategies to improve your setup and boost your income. 
Keep in mind that perfection isn’t the goal—you’ll need to focus on specific areas and make trade-offs. 

Are you ready for the challenge?

summary:
Time loop puzzle horror, where you're stuck in a failed experiment and must escape or face being eaten for eternity.

10 Seconds is a game that hinges on its innovative design . You are trapped in a failed time loop experiment, where you have 10 seconds to scramble for supplies and safety before a monster is released to hunt you down. Crawl through vents, scour walls, find tools and twist valves. Doing everything you can to escape being eaten alive. When you die, you wake up back at the start. Though you may notice that not everything has gone back to normal. Perhaps the experiment was not perfected before things went awry? This game is designed to be completed in one sitting, only taking about 30 minutes for a single run, so there is no save feature. Make use of the physics system that allows you to pick up and throw items. It may be more useful than you think!

name: A Sister's Journey
summary:
A Sister's Journey is a challenging, fast paced action-metroidvania in a lovingly created and hand-drawn pixel art world! Experience a packed story full of adventure, dangers, secrets and mysteries!

Follow Violet on her adventure trying to find Rena, her beloved sister, who seems to have disappeared mysteriously right before their long anticipated reunion. And if that's not enough, starting with Rena's sudden disappearance, mysterious and dangerous events start to happen all around.

With her world suddenly turned upside down, help Violet find out what dangers are lurking in the shadows, and where her sister might have disappeared to. Embark on an epic journey, in a both dangerous and wonderful world!

Gameplay
Expect heavy run 'n gun action, tough boss battles and challenging precision platforming while trying to uncover the mysteries of your missing sister, its sinister circumstances, and beyond.

Experience a rich and emotional story, and explore this huge and charmingly beautiful open world. Meet unique characters, make new friends, and unlock more and more paths, possibilities, skills, weapons and upgrades throughout the game, aiding you in your exploration and on your dangerous quest. And always be on the lookout for secrets!

Combat
Combat in A Sister's Journey delivers an action packed and tight experience! Blast your way through hordes of enemies, and brave the game's many deadly and dangerous boss encounters. Unleash your powerful weapons, dodge your foes' devastating attacks, and maneuver through all the traps they have laid out, and you might emerge victorious!

To stand a chance, acquire, utilize and master all of the mighty weapons found throughout the world. Each will offer distinct, unique mechanics and gameplay, two special fire modes, and many many ways to upgrade and improve them even further throughout the game.

Collect Power Crystals from defeated enemies to quickly increase your weapon’s firepower on the fly, and search the world for special Components used to unlock your weapons' true potential at the workbench. And there might even be more things to find!

Difficulty
You will find many obstacles in your path, and not all of them can be blasted to bits. Treacherous traps and environmental hazards await behind every corner, and your precise movement and decisive, quick actions might be the only way to save you from certain death!

A Sister's Journey is designed to be a challenging experience at its core, brutally trying to ensure that your death counter will rise up, and quickly - but always in a fair and beatable way. Learn, adapt, and master its trials - and if you remain steadfast, that delightful, rewarding feeling of accomplishment will be sure to accompany you throughout the game.

If you're simply looking for a more relaxed experience though, and just want to focus more on enjoying the story and exploring the world, A Sister's Journey got you covered. The game will feature a special Spiritual Guidance Mode - which you can turn on anytime.

Doing so will allow you to enable various helpful boons, giving you a much easier time in many different ways, be it while battling enemies, evading traps or during platforming; and allowing you to enjoy the game at a much more relaxed pace - while still providing a meaningful challenge.

summary:
A remake of the 2015 visual novel The Way We All Go. A yandere story with over 20 endings set in the sleepy Japanese countryside. Can you reconnect with your old friends, or will you meet a grisly ending?

Note: This game is a remake of the 2015 visual novel The Way We All Go by ebi-hime. This remake contains entirely new character sprites and backgrounds, over forty new event CGs, and an entirely new soundtrack. The game has also been remastered in 1080p. There is one new route and several bonus extra scenes to unlock which were not present in the original visual novel.

The year is 1980, and it's been two years since Atsushi, affectionately nicknamed as Atcchan, left his hometown: a small village deep in the Japanese countryside. Now, after all of this time, he is returning for a scant three days during the summer, which will be spent with his grandparents. 

During these two years, Atcchan failed to keep in contact with his two childhood friends: the shy artist Noelle and the cheerful tomboy Amu. Will he be able to reconnect with his old friends, or will his brief stay in the countryside result in tragedy? 

That is up for the player to decide, in this heavily branching horror/romance visual novel with over 20 different endings. Whether Atcchan will be able to reconcile with his friends is entirely up to you. 

Over 300,000 words of text (approx 20 hours of reading) 

Numerous choices to make

Over 20 endings

A large cast of eccentric characters 

Entirely original character and background art

Two adorable childhood friends you can date (and one you can't)

summary:
A lesbian romance set in England shortly after WWI. The story centres around Dot, a young maid who begins to work in the crumbling stately home of Bly, and her young mistress: the devious, devilish Patience.

Set in England in 1919, Bittersweet Blossoms is a slowly developing romance story between a working class girl and her mistress.

Our protagonist, Dot Graves, is a working class girl from Manchester. When Dot's father and older brother both die in World War I, Dot takes it upon herself to find work, in the hopes of supporting herself and her mother. A disastrous stint in a factory, however, encourages Dot to leave the city behind her, to seek employment elsewhere.

Dot finds employment as a maid in Bly: a tumbledown mansion deep in the countryside which has fallen into decline. With the old master of the mansion dead, the house is being barely kept together by the harried, harassed Fran, who is struggling to keep her head above the water.

Dot forms an unlikely bond with Fran's daughter, Patience, but the other maids warn Dot to keep her distance. Patience's moods are known to be mercurial, her temperament poor, and she fails to live up to her (rather optimistic) name in every regard.

Dot hears these warnings, yet she pays them little heed. She can't help but pity her mistress, who is consigned to her bedroom day in, day out: left immobile after an accident as a child. Dot wants to console Patience, if she can - but how will Patience react to the kindness of a girl whose status is so far beneath her own?

100k words of text (around 4-6 hours of reading)

A cute lesbian love story

A linear storyline with no choices/branches

Detailed backgrounds and CGs

1080p display

A continuation of Blackberry Honey

Even more maids!

summary:
A short horror game of a few minutes, with elements of combat and fear. You play as a streamer known as "Gargamelovo let's play šílenství" He always felt like an outsider, whether at school or at work. So he started talking to chat.

Warning: This game is not intended for people with photosensitive epilepsy.

Is Chat Real?

You play as a streamer known as "Gargamelovo let's play šílenství"

He always felt like an outsider, whether at school or at work. Words like "friend" or "company" were more abstract concepts to him than real experiences. He remained alone, often in the silence of his room, where his thoughts were his only companions. Continued story below....

Chat Is Real is a short horror game of a few minutes, with elements of combat and fear.

--Combat--

The fight is not so simple, instead of just attacking, you have to stun the chat when it attacks and then to attack, simply press the right button when the chat's outline is green and the left button when it is red, don't confuse it with the color of the whole character, it's random.

--Stamina--

The game also has a stamina system, running is limited, but its regeneration is quickly restored only if you stand, if you find a weapon in the game, full stamina is required for it, although the weapon will take all your stamina, but maybe it will save your ass.

--Story--

Then came the online world. At first, it was just something to distract him. He started streaming. It wasn't so much about having fun, but rather a way to briefly connect with someone who might listen. And people started to come. A few comments here and there, occasionally some laughter or encouragement. It was like a welcome breeze in an otherwise empty world.

But then it changed. It happened in a small, subtle way. The chat, that usual stream of text appearing during his broadcasts, began to be more than just a stream of random words. Some messages lingered longer, even responding to his quiet behavior or what he said during break

name: Money Under the Bed
summary:
在向路边的一座奇怪雕像抱怨零用钱太少后，第二天你真的在床下发现了一罐钱！
你打算怎么处理这些来路不明的钱？
当然，你完全可以挥霍掉，如果你能活到明天…… 

你很久都没这么倒霉过了，但是在你习惯性地抱怨后好事发生了——
你的床下出现了一罐零钱！如果不追究这罐钱可能是谁给你的情况的话。

探索处理钱的办法
钱就在你手里，你拥有处置它的绝对权力——
当然，这也意味着你需要独自承担全部后果。

游戏内提供了多种处理钱的办法，
你的每一个选择都将重塑剧情走向，并最终推导至截然不同的结局。

探索另一个公寓楼
在动用这笔钱后，你居住的公寓开始表现出某种“不稳定性”。

房间的拓扑结构开始混乱，甚至多出了一些奇怪的邻居。
你需要在这些混乱的空间中寻找出路，并试图找出这罐钱的真正主人。

或者你也许需要帮助？

幸好，你还有一帮朋友愿意在这种情况下帮你一把。
如果你开口，他们中的其中一个会给你提供建议和帮助，
让你快点从这个倒霉的事件中脱身。大概。

向不同的朋友寻求建议吧！他们的建议会影响你在冒险中的判断。

Metamorph is a 3D story-driven dating sim with a horror theme, about growing up in a body that quickly becomes foreign to you. You play as a high-school girl who has begun to slowly, but steadily, turn into a twisted cockroach monster. Our precious sunlight… taken by that… thing.

The Pale Abyss, they call it. A wound in the earth, an accursed maw that swallows all it touches. And from its depths spills that pale, unholy light. Lay your eyes upon it… Our warm and golden sunlight has been dragged down into that darkness, twisted and defiled. Mocking us with what was taken!

Immersive First-Person "King's Field-Like" Exploration

Let the Abyss change your very being with the unique Otherworldly Influence System  

In the Pale Abyss the otherworldly beings seem to clash and influence whatever mortal beings dare to descend its vast depths. Your actions in battle and during exploration shape your mind and body as you drift towards either the Abyssal or the Occult. Many secrets and powers are connected to the otherworldly, but when trifling with the eldritch, you might discover unheard of dangers as well... 

Beautiful Old-School Aesthetics

Harken back to a simpler time in gaming where the few polygons we had jittered and shifted away as we were in awe of the first instances of 3D on our CRT screens. Pale Abyss combines its more modern gameplay with this nostalgic aesthetic to bring a whole new experience in a familiar form.

From Humble Origins to Stalwart Explorer

summary:
“A story about cat girls … with bite.” Nekos have evolved in the shadows of human society. Beautiful. Mysterious. Chaotic. And now, three of them live with you. Will you be able to get past the stigma and grow closer to them? OmOneko is a tale of cat and mouse... and rats.

When our main character finds himself as the owner of three nekos – cat girls – his quiet world is suddenly beset with the conjoined problems that having three cats and girls in the house can bring.

Overcoming both everyday and not-so-common difficulties, will our main character finally find peace and stability again—and maybe something more?

OmOneko is a bishoujo-style game made by fans like you. It uses a text and sprite-based visual novel model with a NVL styled text box.

This game was inspired by other passion projects such as Katawa Shoujo and Doki Doki Literature Club; since those games are free, so is this one!

A unique and more cinematic presentation of the choice-driven Visual Novel medium.

Three unique routes and ten possible endings.

An engaging tale told by unusual characters containing over 260,000 words. Several deep and nuanced stand-alone stories woven together means 20+ hours of story-rich gaming.

Original soundtrack of more than 50 songs and variations.

Several hundred environmental and character images, and over 200 backgrounds.

No AI was used in the making of this game.

Extras area including a “Library” to view all manga, graphic novels, and comics that you unlock along the way, including: SinKitty, Nyako Maids, Red Rocket, Cat’n a Rat, and more!

summary:
Step into Beat Garden, a cozy puzzle game where your beats help plants bloom. Experiment with rhythms to shape their growth, from towering stems to delicate leaves. Explore vibrant worlds, solve creative puzzles, and unwind in a harmonious blend of music and nature.

? Make Beats, Grow Plants, Solve Puzzles

Welcome to Beat Garden, where music and nature grow in harmony! In this cozy puzzle game, your beats aren’t just sounds—they’re the lifeblood of a thriving garden. Each instrument you use shapes the plants in unique ways:

Red - Kicks: Fuel vertical growth, making plants stretch taller.

Blue - Snares: Spark branching patterns, creating intricate structures.

Green - Hi-Hats: Sprout delicate leaves, adding a touch of elegance.

Orange - Bass: Clone plants, creating duplicates to fill your garden.

Purple - Pipa: Add an exotic flourish, inspired by traditional Asian melodies.

As you experiment with sounds, your plants respond to the rhythm, creating a symphony of sight and sound. Solve inventive puzzles to bring your garden to life, explore enchanting worlds, and discover the joy of creativity at your own pace. Each world introduces new mechanics, musical styles, and plant varieties to keep your experience fresh and exciting.

Demo Features

Get a taste of the Beat Garden experience with our demo, featuring:

12 unique puzzles to challenge your creativity.

2 distinct worlds, each with its own plants, sounds, mechanics, and aesthetics.

Around 30 minutes of relaxing and engaging gameplay, perfect for a cozy gaming session. 

Let your creativity bloom and immerse yourself in the soothing, musical world of Beat Garden. Your garden awaits!

summary:
Ardent: Rise is a fantasy real-time action RPG with strong tank / damage / healing roles, and multiplayer CO-OP PVE focus.

Summary

Ardent: Rise is a fantasy real-time action RPG with primarily tab-target, ability-driven combat, strong tank / damage / healing roles, and a multiplayer CO-OP PVE focus.

What are the core tenets of the game? 

Implement the "holy trinity" (Tank, Heals, Damage) archetypes in a narrative rich environment,

Create fun, thematic, and customizable RPG classes,

Focus on an exciting PVE CO-OP experience

Game Play 

3D semi-open world with real-time combat

Combat is primarily tab-target with growing hybrid action elements (directional attacks, dodges, and positional play) in tougher encounters.

PVE CO-OP - 5 Players

There are Towns and Dungeons with NPCs and enemies/bosses

Dungeons will provide varied enemy encounters that can be increased in difficulty for more challenging play

Characters can be leveled by gaining experience through exploration, quests, and interactions such as combat

There are loot items that you can equip, which can be gained as rewards from quests and combat, or through crafting

Abilities, Skills, Talents, and Professions can all be applied to customize your character capabilities

Mild narrative choices during story progression and world exploration

The game is currently a limited-slice prototype and is entirely self-funded. Many of the details above are already implemented in the prototype but the full game vision as described above will depend on additional funding.

Visit our website to see information about Discord and sign up for the newsletter!

Set in a mid-1900's insane asylum, Mindbreak is a thrilling story of an attempted escape. Use your puzzle solving skills along with the unique abilities of each character to navigate the vast asylum and disrupt the Warden’s malevolent scheme. Combining tile-based puzzle solving with the thrill of exploration and ability building, Mindbreak is sure to leave you both puzzled and intrigued.

Whether it’s the ability to teleport or to temporarily enter a separate dimension, the different characters are not only equipped with unique personalities. As you venture further to unlock your characters, more powerful abilities are needed to advance. 

Puzzles are primarily made by color coded tiles. Each character matches a color and can only walk along tiles of that color. Black is impassable to all, while white can be used by anyone. Players use the unique abilities of the characters, to help them navigate the puzzles and master the vast interconnected asylum.

Watch out! Guards are always patrolling the corridors, and the greatest advances are often guarded by more powerful enemies with supernatural abilities of their own. It is encounters such as these that truly test the skill and knowledge of players.

Tight movement and shooting in an isometric prospective

4 levels to fight your way though 

3 special ammo types to discover and leverage

Focus-encouraging gameplay with manual reloading and a reload combo system

This game was developed as a student project at DigiPen Institute of Technology and was created for educational purposes only. Please check out our publisher page for more information.

果たしてドラえもんとのび太たちは、ロンドンを舞台にどのような冒険を繰り広げるのか――。
多くの謎に包まれた『映画ドラえもん のび太の蒸気時間車』。
2027 年春の公開に向けて、今後の続報にぜひご期待ください！

summary:
a silly free endless runner depicting the 1:1 experience of a hamster

Introducing a new type of endless runner...

         ...the (very real) endless struggle hamsters experience on a day-to-day basis.

Jump from platform to platform, nimbly avoiding lava as you try to survive as long as possible to reach a new high score! A surprising amount of depth is found in its simple mechanics, making it a game all about mastery. Learn the tech, become the hamster, and reach the top of the leaderboards!

It's a singleplayer game, but it's a very social game too. Compete against your friends and family, flaunt your scores, and share tips as you go.

Features

Take your shot at the DAILY HAMSTERDLE—a new gauntlet generated every day. Here, you compete against players across the globe for the top spot of the day, however you only get 3 attempts so make sure they count!

Complete ACHIEVEMENTS to unlock silly SKINS and colorful PALETTES to mix up the gameplay and impress your friends who don't even know how to unlock them. (More skins coming soon...)

Personal Note from the Creator

Apologies if this is cheesy or pretentious but hey this is my game I do what I want...

This game has taught me what it means to create. The value of art, I feel, comes when you can feel the presence of a soul within. When you create art, you impart your identity into it simply by virtue of you creating it, meaning in effect, it becomes an extension of yourself. Therefore, to reach down and express yourself to the fullest extent into your creation you must also understand yourself to know what there is to express. For me this has meant working on my habits, my connections, my worldview, and everything I can possibly do to be happy, because only by thoroughly enjoying the creation process will that joy be reflected on the other side. Roll your numbered cube through vegetable-themed worlds in this brain-teasing mathematical puzzle game. Navigate through increasingly complex challenges as you add, multiply, divide and more to reach your goal!

half-a-cado is a puzzle game where you control a numbered cube rolling through grid-based levels filled with mathematical operations. Princess Shall Prevail is a pseudo 8-bit, top-down hack-and-slash game that takes heavy influence from the genre’s third-person contemporaries and a bit of influence from scrolling shoot-em-ups. summary:
They were made to entertain. But now they want to smash and kill.

Have you long wanted to dive into a crazy shooter where you have to kill animatronics?

JohnJohnson: REMNANT — a game made especially for you.

You are a mercenary. Weapon in hand, grim task: to clear out an entire network of entertainment complexes from crazed animatronics that clearly have something wrong with them.

They don’t just malfunction — they laugh, jump, sing, and try to tear you apart.

What went wrong? Why does it smell like rot?

Why do these wind-up freaks… suffer?

Each level is a new insane location.

Genre? An arcade-style adrenaline-fueled trash shooter with elements of platforming, mini-games, and even dark humor.

Gameplay? Shoot, smash, finish.

You can:

Shoot enemies with various types of weapons

Perform executions — brutal, cartoonish, but very impressive ways to tear animatronics to pieces

Play mini-games (from arcade machines to rhythm games and races)

The enemies aren’t boring either:

? Bob — a powerful berserker who rushes into melee

? Rob — a guitarist with ranged sound attacks

? Alice — summons mini-robot “cupcakes”

? Frank — a fast hunter who leaps from afar

And several more enemy types with unique mechanics that will surprise you.

All of this — under brutal, sometimes experimental music and neon lights.

The animatronics are already waiting for you...

summary:
Sereno is a free relaxing puzzle played on a 4x4 board. A player uses arrow keys to move all the tiles in one of 4 directions. Sometimes a pair of tiles will combine into a new one. Listen to immersive smooth jazz music, lean back, unwind, and give yourself a break you deserve.

Sereno is a classic puzzle with the simple goal of creating a tile with a purple drink out of tiles with glasses, bottles and ices of various colors. Move all your tiles around the board with the arrow keys. When two tiles of the same color and with the same picture touch, they merge into a new one with the same picture but of the next color of the rainbow. If tiles with a bottle and ices of the same color touch they merge into a tile with a drink of the same color.

Features:

Soft relaxing music that enables player to unwind, rest, and recharge.

Classic tile mechanics: press an arrow to move all the tiles in the direction of the arrow.

Simple intuitive rules: it takes less than a minute to master the rules, but the strategic challenges are limitless.

Smooth design: clean and satisfying visuals for an enjoyable puzzle experience.

Sereno is perfect for quick relaxing sessions.

You’re a young man, fresh out of juvenile detention, sent to a halfway house to rebuild your life. Over the next six months, you'll forge lasting friendships, heal old wounds, and define your own future.

Meet a cast of vibrant characters:

Samantha: a caring but strict house matron with an uninhibited side.

Emily: a fiery redhead with a soft heart hidden beneath a sharp temper.

Ashley: a brash, magnetic presence who hides more than she lets on.

Halfway House is a story rich, character driven visual novel blending humor, heart, and mature themes.

Use your wits and savvy to save the city of Split from unreasonable housing prices! Find the best deals, evade angry sports fans, survive your part-time job and vanquish your inner demons in this short but intense experience.

Synopsis

You have been personally selected by the mayor to save the city of Split from unreasonable housing prices! Over the course of the following year, and on a tight budget, you'll have to use all the tools at your disposition to buy as many houses in the name of the city as you can so that they may be rented for cheap. That being said, there are a lot of people who would rather you fail in your mission... And besides, grandma ain't gonna visit herself, right?

Gameplay

The game is mostly played with the mouse, but it also uses the keyboard a little. Most of the game is reading the local newspaper and using your knowledge to find the best deals on a map. Once there, you will have to gauge if the price is too high, low, or if you want to try and haggle with the owner of the property. Manage your turns well and you will be victorious! 

There are also RIVETING bossfights to break the pace by testing your skills on the keyboard through challenges, or testing your wits with mind boggling questions and choices.

What to expect

A short, simple game made as a hobby. Nothing very ambitious, but made with a lot of heart.

The game isn't too long, one play-through takes somewhere between 15 and 30 min. That being said, it is unlikely you will beat the game on your first try.

The game is filled with jokes and memes.

Even though the game is singleplayer, it is also a very enjoyable experience with friends. Sharing the joke is always a good time.

A fun, satirical take on life in the Balkans. Try to spot the references and just have a good time overall.

A culturally inspired horror game where you play as a janitor cleaning an eerie theater, day by day. Strange things begin to unfold—and your subtle actions shape how the story ends. Cleaning has never been this terrifying.

Ashuk and Mashuk
The curtains rise on an old stage... but this time, horror takes the spotlight.

Ashuk and Mashuk is an atmospheric horror game inspired by cultural folklore. You play as a janitor working in a once-grand theater where the legendary characters Ashuk and Mashuk once performed. What begins as a simple cleaning job slowly turns into a descent into something far more unsettling.

The game unfolds day by day. Each day, you clean a different part of the theater. Each day, something new and strange happens. But cleaning is not your only task—the theater has secrets, and your choices shape the story.

A culturally inspired horror experience

A day-by-day story progression that blends routine with dread

Decision-making through gameplay, not dialogue choices

Multiple endings and high replay value

Cleaning has never felt so disturbing

Our little Xolo may be small, but his courage is boundless. Enter his world as he tries to rescue his master from the grip of ruthless Spanish conquistadors. Navigating treacherous terrain, battling sinister forces, and challenging enemies that seek to destroy all he holds dear.

 However, he does not fight alone in his journey. Gameplay

Xolo is an action-Metroidvania with a strong emphasis on fast-paced melee combat similar to Hollow Knight or Nine Sols, as well as traversing the vibrant, beautiful Mesoamerican world in search of new abilities. Even without any special shapeshifting abilities, Xolo is quite a fighter! Dodge enemy attacks, lift them into the air with your unique dash attack, and lay into them with simple but intuitive melee combos. However, things get much more interesting as you explore the world and are blessed by Cozana with unique, chimeric alebrije forms. Channel the healing power of an axolotl, the crushing strength of a jaguar's pounce, and the exhilarating grappling hook abilities of a...snake?

Additionally, as you explore, you'll encounter curious little villagers who can help guide you around the map or provide insight into the lore of Xolo's world.

商业精英＆考古学家
“我愿平东海，身沉心不改。”
强强，搞事业成年人的爱情，循序渐进。
不愿标签化人物，人设从缺，性格及经历随故事发展逐步展现。概括来说，是互宠互攻，双双沦陷于温柔的两个人。
当尧之时，水逆行，泛滥于中国，蛇龙居之，民无所定，下者为巢，上者为营窟……使禹治之。禹掘地而注之海，驱蛇龙而放之菹；水由地中行，江淮河汉是也。险阻既远，鸟兽之害人者消，然后人得平土而居之。——《孟子·滕文公章句下》
本文情节纯属虚构，背景架空，与现实无关。

In Bloodfront, each run is a single, escalating survival challenge. During the day, you gather resources, construct buildings, and position defenses. At night, demonic hordes attack your settlement from all sides, pushing your preparation to its limits.

Day: Explore, gather resources, recruit villagers, and expand your settlement.

Village building under pressure — Every structure matters when night falls.

Escalating enemy hordes — Enemies grow stronger and more numerous with each night survived.

Top-down combat — Fight alongside your defenses using a variety of weapons and abilities.

Day / night cycle — Calm, limited preparation followed by intense survival combat.

Multiple enemy types and bosses — New threats force adaptation as the run continues.

summary:
Dicey Heroes is a Monopoly-based roguelike deck-building casual game. Actions such as attack, reinforcement, and defense are determined according to the squares stopped by rolling dice. Units have only one parameter, a number. The objective of the game is to strengthen this number. Simple, isn't it?

“Dicey Heroes” is a casual deck-building game that combines Monopoly and roguelike.

Units move by rolling dice, and actions are triggered by the squares they stop on.

As a breakthrough, your army units have only one parameter: a number. This number serves as both attack power and life force; if it reaches 0, the unit dies. Simple, isn't it?

The objective of the game is to strengthen this number and defeat the enemy.

When a unit stops on a square, its effect is activated.

An “attacking square” attacks the enemy, an “adding square” increases the unit's number, and a “multiplying square” doubles the unit's number.

There are various types of squares, and by combining and strengthening them, you can defeat stronger enemies.

In addition, you can use items to strengthen your units and items to change the roll of the dice to whatever you want.

Of course, enemies will also attack you. Pay attention to the number of chains you have left; if it reaches zero, they will attack you.

Select and strengthen your squares to be able to cross with strong enemies.

We invite you to experience a game that blends luck and strategy at a high level!

Jack is looking for his sister Layla. Following clues, he soon finds himself in a secluded forest. Before long, it becomes clear that Jack is not alone. And whoever — or whatever — is in there with him has no intention of letting him leave.

Inspired by the works of writers like H. P. Lovecraft and Stephen King, Awaken is a short side scroller horror game with emphasis on environmental storytelling and narrative-driven gameplay.

Exploration in Awaken is highly encouraged. Through character dialogues, item descriptions and environmental cues, you can shed light on what is truly going on in this forest.

Gameplay consists mostly of laid back exploration with a few instances of combat and shocking revelations. In Awaken, every encounter means something.

Disturbing moments and difficult moral dilemmas will test your resolve. It becomes clear that what we consider good or bad is relative. There are no right choices in this game.

Awaken features classic pixel art style utilizing some modern techniques, an original acoustic guitar soundtrack, a troubling story and an eerie atmosphere!

As a Marchwarden, you travel the southern roads to protect pilgrims and travelers. You will fight multi-phased bosses, shape the storylines of characters, and explore an interconnected world.

I was inspired by the minimalism of 1990's action-adventure games on the Game Boy & Game Boy Color. I felt there was more to explore within the constraints of those early handheld games. Pact Warden features top-down exploration and combat as well as side view platforming and combat. It also includes dynamic characters, with their own narratives that intertwine with your journey.

Exploration

The world is a mystery with new lore revealed through exploration. Explore the world to find new environments, new characters, and new mechanics.

Choices Matter

Dialogue with characters will often involve binary choices along the conversation. These choices will impact the character moving forward, changing their fate as well as their disposition towards you. It's important to be mindful of how a choice will alter a character's life, as their life is important to your survival.

Relationships Affect Gameplay

When you are defeated in combat, many nearby characters will attempt to save you. Whether or not a character can save you will, sometimes, depend on whether or not you have helped them. If no character can save you, then you will have to restart the game.

Combat

Combat is very simple, but the environment will sometimes complicate things. For instance, an enemy's attack might ignite a brazier and you can then attack that brazier to throw fire back at the enemy.

Helina say's it's not safe outside and to never leave--but she doesn't say why. All exiting doors are always securely locked; never once has Lorry seen one open.

For days, weeks, months and maybe even for years, both girls live day-to-day repeating the same activities: eating the same meals, enjoying the same books, living their own small solitary version of groundhog day--that both of them are aware of. It's as if time were standing still... or perhaps it never existed in the first place? Even the hands from the clocks are oddly missing, and the calendar only shows one month. But what does it matter, since Lorry has never understood the meaning of time anyway?

If it weren't for a mysterious, reoccurring nightmare plaguing her dreams every night then perhaps this life would be easy to accept, but this dream leads Lorry to question her existence and her curiosity drives her to understand the world beyond the cabin. Each time you play, new Brainrot animals need rescuing. New paths, new panic, new escape strategies. Will you sneak, run, or... cry a little in a corner?

Do you have what it takes to outsmart Tung Tung, dodge bombs, and free the Brainrot before it’s too late?

You better hope so.

Gameplay 

Rescue the Brainrot Animals!

Scattered across the map are 3 cages, each holding a Brainrot animal in need of rescue. To unlock a cage, you must find the missing words from the poem engraved on it, but beware! Some words are decoys meant to throw you off.

Dodge the bombs dropped by Bombardino Crocodilo and watch out for Tung Tung Sahur, if they catch you, it’s game over!

Every run is unique.The cage locations, the Brainrot animals inside, and the placement of words across the map change every time you play.

Chill: No enemies. Take your time, explore the map, find the cages, and piece together the poems to save your Brainrot friends.

Normal:One B

summary:
Part incremental game, part art project. You buy upgrades which alter the hypnotic progression of the circles in the simulation. It's kind of a screen saver that you progress through. The whole process is only a few hours.

Falling sand idle is an incremental game powered by a little physics simulation.  Your progression is determined by the interactions of lots of little circles that run into each other.  You can make them bigger, smaller, or hotter.  You can change the environment they move around in.  Eventually, they can eat each other.

Content

Level 1:  You start out moving grains of sand through an hourglass.  Each time a grain hits the bottom, you get it back, and can drop it again from the top.  You also get a tiny moment of time, that you can use to buy upgrades.  Eventually, you'll have thousands of grains on screen at once.

Level 2: The next level is a forest.  You start out placing leaves, which costs nothing but a click.  You get a tiny adaptation of evolution for every particle you create, which lets you research upgrades.  Eventually, your leaf dies, leaving behind a dead leaf particle.  Once you teach the leaves to reproduce, you'll eventually have too many dead leaves to make new live ones.  Luckily, bugs love to eat dead leaves...

Gabriel, a middle-aged man isolated in the depths of his own mind, awakens in a strange and desolate world. To escape, he must confront powerful entities—manifestations of his fear, guilt, and painful memories.

This atmospheric action game challenges players with intense, one-on-one encounters against symbolic bosses. With minimalist mechanics and a focus on timing, observation, and precision, every fight is a test of both skill and understanding.

Explore a haunting landscape shaped by emotion and memory. Piece together fragments of Gabriel’s past as you uncover the reasons behind his solitude—and whether there is a way out.

Features:

Tight, focused combat with high-stakes encounters

Symbolic bosses representing psychological themes

A solitary journey through surreal, emotional environments

Minimal UI and storytelling through the world itself

Atmospheric soundtrack and visual style

Prepare to confront the monsters within — and discover whether redemption lies at the end of the mind’s labyrinth.

A cute, chaotic game about biting your friends! Multiplayer tag with your teeth!

Friends And Fangs is a chaotic, colourful multiplayer survival escape game, played in fast-paced 8-10 minute rounds, based on the idea of a playground game of tag. Rush to escape the island with your fellow ‘fluffies’ or hunt them down as the scary ‘mutant’!

Fluffies have 3 objectives; food, fuel and wood. All one needs to make a an escape from the island—and the enemy lurking there. The fluffies may have less tools at their disposal but the in-game mechanics give them plenty of warning when a mutant is nearby.

THE MUTANT

Your adversary? One of your own friends, gone mad with hunger and the urge to bite—the mutant. Demolish hiding spots and leap over obstacles in your hunt to consume every last fluffy.

While fluffies only have the means to run and hide, the mutant has a number of other abilities; destroy bushes that the fluffies use to hide, force the fluffies to reveal themselves with mutant breath, use the mutant vision ability to see them from a distance, and bite them to injure and eventually take them out.

8-10 minute rounds

More in-depth description__

You will have two main places to look: your monitor and your console. On your monitor, you can access the work tab, where you click on drones to upgrade them and send them to work at substations, and substations, which you can click on to purchase and read their resource yields and tasks. Substation stability, which you can see in the console, affects your chances of successfully performing a work cycle. Stability can be restored by rebooting the substation. You are given an allowance of energy, and have to spend 75% of it and, if applicable, meet the resource requirements to end the day. summary:
Pretty Buttons makes the buttons on your keyboard do pretty things. Its a visual sensory experience to engage any who need a little engagement.

A few months before I published this game, my infant daughter began discovering computers. She loved pushing the buttons on the keyboard and biting the mouse. My wife remarked that it would be nice if there was a program that would simply do things when she pushed the buttons, so that it was a more engaging activity. That idea grew into Pretty buttons, a visual sensory experience ideal for any sensory seeking individuals, not just children. See all 50 different effects in the default mode, or make each button push select a random effect in random mode. Or, sit back and watch the show with auto mode. Enjoy this casual interactive experience I made for my daughter, and now share with you.

This game is in a beta state, with content updates planned in the future. The coming soon button on the homepage will be replaced with a learning mode that will help teach the buttons on the keyboard and their names.

Set in 1744, against the backdrop of the English gin craze, you must unravel Oakshaw's mysteries and grapple with the true face of evil.

"Do monsters lurk in the darkness, or do they lurk within us?"

The Tūn-Gāst of Oakshaw is a top down 2D pixel art horror-adventure game with Metroidvania-inspired gameplay, interweaved with a rich and flowing episodic narrative.

Imbued in history, steeped in layered mysteries

The Tūn-Gāst of Oakshaw is set against the historically-accurate backdrop of 1744 Georgian England - a time of fear, disease, war - and gin.

Playing as the Faceless, a monster hunter who roams the land in search of supernatural threats to extinguish, you must investigate a series of strange disturbances and unexplained deaths in the rural town of Oakshaw, Cumbria.

But the desperate and destitute people are at the mercy of the parasitic gin craze ravaging the nation - and they don't take kindly to a masked outsider shining a light on secrets that have long been buried.

An episodic approach to storytelling

As you build your investigation throughout this semi-open world environment and use wits to solve puzzles, you must also wrestle with forces that lurk in the darkness - and battle the demons that lurk within.

Chapter One of The Tūn-Gāst of Oakshaw will launch in 2025. This will be followed with additional chapters in future updates.

Block Basher 3D is a minimalist, single-player brick-breaking game set in a modern 3D environment. Inspired by classics like Arkanoid, it brings simple block-bouncing gameplay into a sleek, clean, block-based world, without unnecessary fluff.

Smash your way through increasingly tough block formations using a range of power-ups: go-through balls, laser shots, bigger paddles, and more. THEN WHAT IS THE CATCH?

The sequel will be free for everyone who owns this game and is expected to include:

A fully 3D playfield, where blocks aren’t limited to a flat surface—some will float, wrap around walls, or hang above the paddle.

New game modes like campaign, endless, co-op, and multiplayer.

Expanded block types, physics-based interactions, leaderboards, and more.

An immersive story experience has never been seen before in an arcade-style game.

Classic Gameplay, 3D World – A block-breaking twist in a minimalistic modern setting.

Switchable Views – Play from top-down, angled, or right behind the paddle.

Power-Ups – Use go-through balls, paddle extenders, and laser shots to gain an edge.

Block Variety – Standard bricks (1–6 hits) and explosive blocks that damage nearby tiles.

No Grind – Jump in and break stuff. Fast, focused gameplay with rising difficulty.

summary:
A physics-based 2D platform puzzle game where you bounce parcels through challenging layouts to deliver them efficiently and rack up high scores.

Welcome to Rebound Express Inc.!
As Warehouse Distribution Manager, it’s your job to ensure that every wrapped and packaged parcel makes it to its designated shipping facility — by any (bouncy) means necessary.

 Rebound Express is a 2D physics puzzle game where parcels are launched from fixed emitters and must reach specific receivers scattered across the board. To guide them, you’ll place and rotate a variety of modular platforms across a grid-based warehouse environment. Some platforms are simple walls, others are perfectly elastic bouncers, and some are high-powered boosters that add extra speed to the mix.

Once your layout is in place, you can fine-tune the launch speed of the parcels to optimize their trajectory. When you're satisfied with your setup, hit submit — then watch as your plan comes to life.

Your performance is evaluated based on how quickly you complete the delivery, how many parcels you lose along the way, and the precision of your setup. Bonus stars are scattered across some levels for those who like to push for perfection — collect them for extra points and bragging rights.

Rebound Express was created as an entry for a one-week game jam among friends.

The company's going under, and corporate has made you the office manager to turn it around. It's a tall order but someone has to step up, and they've decided it's you. The office is yours to run now, and maybe — just maybe — things can be turned around!

Before the workday kicks off, the office is yours to arrange. Buy the appliances you need, set them down, rotate them, and shuffle the layout until it works. Power through the day by hand, or set up some automation. Every workday is a fresh chance to rethink the space!

summary:
Meme-fueled rhythm duel. 1v1 couch battle, slap-perfect beats, party chaos. Five brainrot mascots. If you like local VS rhythm games, wishlist now.

Tum Tum Tum: Dance Party — Timing? Never Heard of Her

 Hey, welcome to Tum Tum Tum: Dance Party – basically a dumb little rhythm game I threw together because memes are life and who has time for epic quests anyway? It's short, stupid, and full of Italian brainrot vibes. You press arrows to beats while controlling idiots like Tung Tung Tung Sahur, Brrbrr Patapim, Tralalelotralala, Bombardillo Crocodillo, or Chimpanzini Bananini. Play alone, or drag a friend into a local duel and laugh at how bad you both are. No deep meaning here, just vibes. 

Core Gameplay Mechanics 

Rhythmic Precision: Arrows fly at you, hit 'em on time or your dance looks like a drunk uncle at a wedding. Get it right, and chain some combos for points – big whoop. 

Bombardillo Time Combo System: Nail 10 in a row, and boom, bonus mode with particles and breakdance flips. It's flashy, but don't pretend it's revolutionary. 

1v1 Local Multiplayer: Split-screen battle on one PC with controllers or keyboard. Trash-talk your buddy while you both flail. 

Single-Player Challenge: Fight an AI that's probably smarter than me. It gets harder, good for wasting a few minutes. 

Free Mode Vibes: Hang out in a fake club with oriental backdrops and graffiti walls. Practice moves, mess around, no pressure – like the game itself. 

Visual and Audio Spectacle

 Cartoon stages covered in colorful crap, animations that pop when you don't suck, and tunes mixed with meme garbage to keep it mildly addictive. Particles explode, breakdances happen – it's cute, but let's not act like it's art. Perfect for a quick laugh before you get bored and play something else. Brainrot incoming, enjoy the nothing.

Are you an old CRT monitor with a penchant for picking up boxes? Do you long for the days when you could place those boxes in an exit portal and engage your jetpacks early because you're impatient? If you answered yes to any of these questions, you're really weird! But try Workplace Hazard anyway!

Workplace Hazard is a fast-paced, physics-driven 2D platformer that takes place in a dystopian future, playing the role of CRT-2 — a recycled utility bot — where crates are your life! Moving crates to 'Exit Portals' is your sacred duty, and you were created to obey!

"Dark. Silent. Waiting."

This game is a text-based, turn-based strategy mini-game that runs entirely on the command line.

The player takes on the role of a hunter, exploring a mysterious cave and attempting to hunt down a terrifying man-eating creature known as the "Gurg."

In this game, understanding your surroundings through messages that appear after each action is the key to survival and victory.

The Cave:

The cave consists of several rooms, each assigned a unique number.

While the overall structure of the cave is fixed, the room numbers are randomly assigned in each playthrough.

In addition to the "Gurg," two "giant bats" lurk somewhere in the cave. Yes, two of them.

The Hunter:

Armed only with a bow and three arrows, the hunter bravely challenges the Gurg.

Victory is achieved by striking the Gurg with an arrow.

However, if the hunter is eaten by the Gurg, falls into a pit, or runs out of arrows, the game is over.

Play Time:

Each play session takes approximately 1 to 10 minutes.

Notes:

The introductory game guide can be skipped. For details, please check the “option” menu in-game.

The application relies on the user's command line environment.

There is no audio output.

summary:
"A coin-like (Tejo) throwing game, Rayuela-sim!"

What is Rayuela?

It is a competition where you throw a coin-like object (Tejo) to a box, and whoever gets closer to the line in the box is the winner, but what if we has a twist in this game?... what if the Tejos and Boxes were made of different materials?... well, this is "A Rayuela Game!

Your main objective is to participate in the 9 available tournaments and defeat the opponents in those tournaments to become the world champion. 

You must throw the Tejos as close as possible to the line drawn inside the Box.

But it won’t be easy—the first Tejos you can acquire are made of cheap materials, which will make winning certain tournaments more difficult. However, each Rayuela match grants you "coins" (the in-game currency), which you can use to buy more Tejos made from different materials. This allows you to choose the best option depending on the type of box used in each tournament.

But... What is Rayuela? What are Tejos? And what are Boxes?

Rayuela is the match you play against your opponent—both players take turns throwing a circular object (Tejo), which must land as close as possible to the line drawn inside the box. The player whose Tejo lands closest to the line wins the match.

In a standard Rayuela match, several turns are played. However, in "A Rayuela Game," you only have one chance—you either win or lose.

Tejos are the circular objects used to be thrown onto the surface of a Box, which has a line drawn in the middle.

Boxes are simply... boxes! They are the surfaces where the Tejo must land to determine which player is the winner.

How many Tejos and Boxes are available?

You can acquire up to 12 Tejos and 9 Boxes, each with a behavior similar to the material it is named after.

summary:
In Dungeon CompAInions, choose a class—Mage, Druid, or Ranger—while AI-controlled allies help you survive waves of enemies. Pause to slow the pace at a cost, or push on for higher scores. Earn upgrades after each round as difficulty steadily increases.

In Dungeon CompAInions, the player can choose one of three playable classes: Mage, Druid, and Ranger. Each character comes equipped with a main attack weapon and two powerful abilities, which must be used strategically and wisely. The two remaining classes not chosen by the player will be controlled by agents trained through Reinforcement Learning and will accompany the player throughout their journey.

Together, the player and their AI companions must clear rounds composed of multiple enemy waves. Each round consists of five waves, which are triggered continuously during gameplay—unless the player decides to activate the pause button midway through the round. Pausing the game will damage, potentially even kill, the player. This allows for clearing the remaining enemies and helps with not being overrun by hordes of undead. The player will get score for every initiated wave, stacking up with the number of waves cleared without pausing. Thus, the player should choose wisely between staying safe and pausing the game, or being greedy and trying to clear all enemies without a moment of peace.

After completing a round, the player will be presented with three reward options, from which one may be selected. These rewards include upgrades to Attack Damage or Ability Damage, increases in Max Health, reductions in cooldown times, or boosts to movement speed. These upgrades are essential for survival and success.

summary:
Outsmart zombies and deadly traps using the environment as your weapon in BubonicZ, a third-person horror puzzle of survival in a plague-ravaged prison.

Have wits? You'll need 'em. The BubonicZ plague rages, and you're trapped in a horrific prison, banished by the King after the princess fell under your watch. As a once mighty warrior, now without your trusty bow and arrow, you face not only grotesque zombies but also the King's deadly, cunningly laid traps.

The BubonicZ is a third-person horror puzzle game that challenges you to survive a relentless nightmare where your environment is your only weapon, and every step could be your last. Immerse yourself in a dark, atmospheric prison labyrinth, where the very walls are designed to ensure your demise.

Important Note on Current Build: This build of BubonicZ offers a focused, intense taste of the core gameplay, showcasing the innovative environmental puzzle mechanics and horror atmosphere. Players will experience the initial stages of their escape, requiring them to collect multiple keys and navigate through challenging areas. Currently, the journey concludes after acquiring the third key and passing through a final door, at which point you will return to the main menu. This segment is designed to provide a foundational look at the terrifying world and unique challenges I am building. I am actively developing more content, including fleshing out the world and cleaning up all the bugs and messier segments.

What do you call a group of skeletons is a short comedy adventure where you will experience peak narrative, absolute gameplay, and hats! This game contains two levels and serves as a proof of concept that we want to revisit in the future.

What do You Call a Group of Skeletons is a pilot!

A Pilot? For a video game?

We overestimated how much content we could get done in a year, so we made the decision to turn the game into a pilot. Our team consists entirely of newcomers to the industry, and this has been our first project for the public market. Working on this game has been an invaluable learning experience for us and we are immensely proud of what we have created, but we also want to make sure you know what you are getting in to!

 This game features two levels and serves as a proof of concept of the kind of game we'd like to make in the future. The story is not complete, and ends on a cliffhanger.

If you enjoyed the game, we'd love to hear from you! And if you didn't, we want to hear that too. Feedback is very important for us to be able to make the best possible version of this game when we can revisit it one day. Knowing that there is interest in this game or a game like it helps us when pitching the game to publishers or investors as well.

Arctic Bones isn't going away! There are games we want to make and stories we want to tell, but for now What do You Call a Group of Skeletons will be left here.

What do You Call a Group of Skeletons is a short comedy puzzle adventure featuring a (you guessed it) group of skeletons.

History of Dragosa is a text-based choose your own adventure game where your choices write the lore of the world, choose between different fantasy classes and create characters and explore their stories while making choices to decide where their story goes. Once you complete a story you get to keep those books as you fill the in game library shelves. You can read them again or write new stories with different characters and make different choices to see all the multiple endings and outcomes. 

Choose Your Adventure

The next great story is up to you as you choose between Warrior, Wizard, Thief, or Cleric and decide their path through choices that explore branching narratives. These choices will determine the fates of your protagonists. Just like the adventure fantasy books where you can make choices to discover what happens next, History of Dragosa offers a virtual way to experience those wonderful tales.

Will you lead your protagonist to their untimely demise or will these heroes fulfill their epic quests? The choice is yours to make.

Create The History

Each story you create will be yours to keep, as each book is stored in the Castle Library, allowing you to read the previous adventures you've created. Fill the library shelves with the epic tales of your design. With these stories you can create the History of the fantasy world known as Dragosa.

A dark, emotional RPG set in modern China. Follow Xiao Jun, a rural boy caught in a brutal journey from schoolyard bullying to street violence, love, betrayal, and revenge. A raw story of survival in an unforgiving world.

About This Game
Xiao Jun (English Edition) is a hand-drawn, story-driven 2D RPG set in 1990s China. It tells the full life journey of a rural boy — from bullied schoolchild, to a Bitcoin millionaire, and ultimately a tragic rebel against a corrupt system.

This is a game where story comes first, but it includes light turn-based combat during key moments of tension. Battles are few, but emotionally significant.

? A Life Shaped by Injustice, Greed, and Memory

Childhood: Face bullies, suffer loss, and grow up in a harsh rural society.

Youth: Build friendships, experience betrayal, and dream of escape.

Collapse & Fortune: Discover forgotten Bitcoin and gain sudden wealth.

Rebellion: Build a mining empire — and clash with the village, the system, and yourself.

Final Stand: An explosive ending that confronts the cost of power and resistance.

? Key Features:

Narrative-Focused RPG: A mostly linear experience with occasional turn-based battles.

Hand-Drawn Visuals: Rich illustrations of 1990s China’s rural and urban life.

Emotional Storytelling: A story about pain, memory, and revenge — told over decades.

Cultural Depth: Social realism rarely seen in RPGs, set in contemporary China.

? Playtime:

Around 3 to 4 hours to complete the full story.

If you enjoy games like To the Moon, Detention, or Rakuen, this game will leave a lasting emotional impression — with just enough challenge to feel the stakes.

summary:
A third-person survival horror game where players navigate a dark, nonlinear facility, using light, sound, and limited tools to avoid deadly threats and uncover hidden experimental data.

Dark Cross is a third-person survival horror game set in the decaying corridors of Echo Deep, a sealed military research facility lost to time and tragedy. Sent in to recover classified experimental data, you quickly discover you're not alone—something hostile still roams the dark.

Choose how to survive. Light and sound draw danger, but the choice is yours: sneak past threats, distract them, or use limited tools to create breathing room. Explore a massive nonlinear level, uncover buried secrets, and collect hidden vials to piece together what went wrong—and what Subject H-9 has become.

Key Features

Third-Person Survival Horror
Navigate from a third-person perspective with full control of your camera and surroundings—balance visibility with vulnerability.

Multiple Paths to Survival
Every encounter can be handled in different ways: avoid, distract, or confront with rare, high-risk tools. Adapt your approach to the situation.

Light and Sound Matters
Enemies are drawn to what they can hear and see. Hold your breath, and listen carefully to survive.

Persistent World
All 8 DNA vials must be found to unlock the full truth. Their positions stay constant—even across deaths—but finding them is only part of the challenge.

Atmospheric Minimalism
No HUD. No handholding. Just the sound of your footsteps, flickering lights, and something hunting in the dark.

Dark Cross is an intense, replayable horror experience built around environmental tension, non-linear exploration, and player choice in the face of overwhelming odds.

WHAT IS JMAMC?

JMAMC is a 2D roguelike, hack-n-slash, wave survival shooter, where the gameplay loop is simple and sweet: grab a gun and kill everything that comes at you! Fight alongside your furry little feline friend, get upgrades to augment your build, unlock tons of new goodies as you level up your account, and see if you can survive with just you and your cat against hordes of supernatural horrors!

GAMEPLAY

The game is simple: grab a gun, survive as long as you can. Every run you'll start with no upgrades, only your gun and your cat, and as the game progresses and you survive more waves, you'll be rewarded with a random selection of upgrades to pick from, that offer a whole range of changes such as increased weapon damage, faster attack speed for your cat, cooldown reduction for your abilities, and so much more!

The longer you survive, the higher your score gets, and the higher your score gets, the more you'll be rewarded at the end of the run with account XP, which unlocks more upgrade options, skins, maps, and other goodies as your account levels up, as well as give you in game currency you use to buy new skins and guns!

HOW MUCH CAN I GET OUT OF THIS GAME?

JMAMC offers a lot for what it is. This probably won't be a game you sink 100 hours into, but you can look forward to many many hours of run after run after run as you attempt to beat your high score, collect all the unlockables, and reach the max account level of 80. Guide a neolithic tribe using natural language. Teach hygiene, craft tools, discover agriculture, found religions. Every person is individually simulated — births, deaths, diseases, and famines emerge from 12 interconnected systems. Your words shape civilization.

You woke up 10,000 years in the past. Your tribe is watching. What do you say?

You don't know how it happened. One moment you were checking your phone — the next, you woke up on damp earth, surrounded by people speaking a language that exists in no dictionary.

Months passed. You learned to eat what they ate, sleep where they slept, mimic their gestures until the words started to make sense. But something was wrong — or perhaps, strangely right. The seasons turned. Children grew. The young aged.

You didn't.

When the last elder fell, the tribe's eyes turned to the one who never aged. They placed you beside the central fire. No one voted. You simply were the eldest. The wisest. The leader.

Now, with the knowledge of 10,000 years of civilization trapped inside your head — but no tools, no books, no Google — the only thing you can do is speak. Teach. Guide.

The tribe listens. What you say next changes everything.

A Civilization Simulation Driven By Your Words

CivEconomy: Future Leader is a deep civilization simulation where you guide a neolithic tribe using natural language commands. There are no menus to click, no buttons to press — you type what you want to teach your people, and they listen.

Say "boil drinking water" and they learn to purify water. Say "make rope from bark" and they begin crafting cordage. Say "sacrifice the weak" and... well, they'll do that too — if your religious influence is strong enough.

The game processes your intent through multiple layers — keyword matching, semantic similarity, and AI classification — so you don't need exact phrases. Speak naturally. The system understands.

Introduction:

Soul Astray is a contemplative retro-style platformer that intentionally uproots one of the genre's key assumptions: input consistency! Refresh your expectations as you master the unique challenges introduced by the "Control Switch" mechanic (explained below) in a world filled with groovy music. 

Key Game Mechanic:

Control Switch Mechanic

"Dash" and "Jump" inputs switch with each jump!

Your character's color provides a visual cue for the input orientation.

Other Features:

Foresight: Use the game's Foresight mechanic to plan your route to achieve the unlikely first-try success.

Difficulty: A minimal tutorial followed by learn-as-you-fail levels that demand creativity.

Health Tokens: You're an immortal soul that can survive without health, but the tokens might be useful elsewhere...

Redemption Tokens: If you find yourself stuck due to an earlier misstep, use these limited tokens to restart the level.

Goodness Meter: The purity of your soul is tracked, show them (who?) that you have more than just a good heart.

Lamps: Sacrifice soul fragments to light the lamps in your path, a gift to help guide other lost souls. If you find a lamp already lit, accept the gift for a unique power.

Trinkets: Collect trinkets in hard-to-reach places to remind yourself who you are + alter game outcomes.

Secrets: Unexpected secrets encourage you to make choices that can alter your end-goal.

Story:

A gently implied story of struggling to find direction. Your hesitancy to commit to a path in life has left you abandoned. Work through your indecision as you constantly transition between good and evil to find yourself!
