虚妄、倒错、她所坠入的循环往复的命运。

name: The Rolling Stones
summary:
The rollicking adventures of the Stone Family on a tour of the Solar System. It all statred when the twins, Castor and Pollux Stone, decided that life on the Lunar colony was too dull and decided to buy their own spaceship and go into business for themselves. Their father thought that was a fine, idea, except that he and Grandma Hazel bought the spaceship and the whole Stone Family were on their way out into the far reaches of the Solar System, with stops on Mars(where the twins got a lesson in the interplanetary economics of bicycles and the adorable little critters called flatcats who, it turned out, bred like rabbits; or perhaps, Tribbles....), out to the asteroids, where Mrs. Stone, an M.D., was needed to treat a dangerous outbreak of disease, even further out, to Titan and beyond.

Unforgettable Heinlein characters on an unforgettable adventure.

name: 《ARIE：月咏》游戏原声带
The Primal Urge
summary:
In the long tide of history, the world-famous reticence of the British is a very recent development. Less than a hundred years old in fact. The rakish ways of the regency, the roistering Restoration and the downright rowdyism of the Tudor era are older and more firmlyb rooted traditions among these tough island people that Victorian middle-class morality or latter day neo-Freudianism.

It needed only a gadget – a mechanical marvel – to make the British dispense with polite fol-de-rol and come right out with the view that sex does exist. Once having admitted this, the English Government, always fiercely partisan in their gloriously muddle-headed fashion, refused to permit anybody to be without sex.

name: Hothouse
summary: In the future, when the Sun has expanded and is ready to go nova, few animal species remain while plants have adapted to fill animal niches. One of the few species to survive are humans, but in much-altered forms. It is here where young tribal Gren finds himself captured by an intelligent fungus with plans to colonize humans to control the world! Hothouse tells the story of a remarkable journey of discovery that will alter your perceptions about the true nature of the world today... and the world to come!

name: Earthworks
summary:
Out of Africa comes a dead man walking upon the water – a portent of the political adventures into whichj Knowle Noland, ex-convict, ex-traveller and captain of the 80,000-ton freighter Trieste Star, is about to tumble headlong.
Choked, disease-ridden towns, robots and prison gangs tending the bare, poison drenched countryside are all characteristic of Knowle’s world; only in Africa is the soil still fertile and the people still relatively vital. On the coast of Africa, near Walvis Bay, Knowle runs his freighter aground; and there he meets Justine and the destructive destiny that purges him of guilt and frees him from hallucination.

name: An Age
summary: This splendid piece of psychological science fiction represents a sustained act of imagination. It operates on several different levels, right from the opening scenes on a prehistoric shore, to Buckingham Palace (where, in a moment of black comedy, Bush disappears up Queen Victoria’s skirts, to the alien perspectives of uncreated time.

name: Report on Probability A
summary: “One afternoon in early January, the weather showed a lack of character. There was no frost nor wind: the trees in the garden did not stir.” Within the house moved a woman, the strangely fascinating Mrs. Mary: without, a black and white cat stalked the pigeon known as X. The characters G, S, and C watched from various outbuildings. Others watched tham and yet others watched those watchers. An enigmatic engraving hung in each outbuilding and as the early dusk fell C gazed at a representation of two snakes, each swallowing the other’s tail. Brian Aldiss’s new novel, a tense and engrossing study of relative phenomena, is a dazzling tour-de-force in which his wit, intelligence and invention are displayed at full stretch.

name: The Malacia Tapestry
summary: Jostling through the light and shadow of Malacia’s streets goes a crowd of people; dukes, wealthy merchants, bankrupt families, actresses, priests, courtesans, spongers, soldiers, and down-at-heel showmen. They are seen through the eyes of Perian de Chirolo, actor and man-about-town, whose adventures take him through all strata of Malacian society and into the heart of its darkest secrets, lay and spiritual. Episodes idyllic and chilling follow each other in comic succession . . . . . . This atmospheric novel . . . . . . sets out in dramatic form many of the conflicts and contradictions of our own day and is the most excitingly original story yet told by an author of incomparable vitality and imagination.

name: The Canopy of Time
summary: Aldiss’s subjects are the traditional ones of human love and aspiration – even his class-conscious robots in ‘Who Can Replace a Man?’ are oddly human – his originality lies in the use of time as an active participant in his stories. So here we find lovers defying the Mating Centre, the man who believed himself to be the Messiah, the film director who came too near to a city’s secrets, and – in the last and longest story – a conqueror who found only shadows to greet him.

name: No Time Like Tomorrow
summary:
A monster travels back in time to destroy a race called Man on a planet called Earth...

A mild-mannered husband is stranded centuries ahead in a world of peep-show barbarism...

A jaded sportsman returns to the prehistoric past to hunt a gigantic brontosaurus...

The governor of a penal space settlement makes the supreme sacrifice for the colony he loves...

Here are startling stories of the future – adventures that soar beyond the barriers of time and space, yet remain perilously close to the boundaries of reality.

name: 绯色幻想曲
summary:
活泼好动的西帝国公主希尔娜在年幼时邂逅了来自北方王国的质子拉提奥，两人的心逐渐靠近，而东帝国的少年国王尼亚也在暗中窥视……可惜三国之间只是表面和平，战争一触即发，昔日的青梅竹马也终将面临爱情、责任间的抉择：剑与血，硝烟与眼泪，真心与背叛，共同交织谱写一曲少年少女的绯色乐章。

ゲーム本編中で使用されたビジュアルはもちろん、雑誌や各種グッズ用の描き下ろしも完全収録。スタッフ座談会や声優さんへのインタビュー、藤原々々さんコメント付きのラフ＆デザイン画に、描き下ろしピンナップともりだくさんの内容となっております。

name: 初級魔術マジックアローを極限まで鍛えたら
summary:
初級魔術マジックアロー。多くの魔術師が最初に覚える魔術。
貴族の長男として生まれたアルベルト・リュミナスは優秀な弟と比較される苦しい日々を送っていたが、幼いながらもマジックアローを使うことができた。
自身の才能を信じて魔術学院に進むも、それ以外の魔術を何も習得できなかった。失望した両親に見捨てられたアルベルトだが、諦めずにマジックアローを磨き続ける。
それから十年。学院の入試を受けようとする白髪の少女ローラと出会い、止まっていたアルベルトの運命が動き始める――!

使える魔術の数こそが実力とみなされる世界で常識はずれのマジックアローだけで成り上がっていく英雄の物語。
ここに開幕!

村の自警団で対立する父と子や、癒やしの力を持つユニコーンを狙う悪の商会が巻き起こす騒動の数々。

彼は、現実《リアル》だと、友人も少なく恋人もいないという冴えない男子高校生である。

しかし、『彼女』のプレイヤーである美少女(※超ヤンデレ)と士郎が、現実における同級生であったことをお互いに知ったことで、現実での生活にも変化が。

WEB小説発、ゲームでも現実でも修羅場発生のちょっと過激なラブコメファンタジー!

残念すぎる【落とし穴】スキルを使っているうちに、なぜかスキルがグレードアップして吸い込み系スキル【ブラックホール】をゲットしてしまった最底辺冒険者マグナ・クラウド。
だがそのスキルはブラックホールだけに、何もかもが謎だらけ!

従者の狐耳のキャロル、盾使い令嬢エルザと共に、突如その内部へと吸い込まれてしまった。
マグナたちを待ち受けるものとはいったい!?

「小説家になろう」発、究極の吸い込み系エンターテインメント!?
書きおろし短編「天馬騎士と魔弾の射手、初めての出会い編」「ヴルムVS閃王竜編」2編収録!!

name: 社畜勇者、仕事辞めるってよ (2)
summary:
「俺、勇者をやめるわ」――引退し、まったりとした生活へと突入する予定だった元勇者のもとに、
なぜか転がりこんできてしまった魔王。ハチャメチャではあるものの、
とりあえず始まったスローライフに、今度は魔王の部下達が押しかけてきて……。
引退した勇者&魔王が織りなす、とっても不思議なご隠居ものがたり!?

name: 社畜勇者、仕事辞めるってよ (3)
summary:
何やら魔王軍の中に不穏な動きがある――。

親衛隊のファントムとイレーラから報告を受け、魔王イスベルは元勇者アデルを連れて、魔王城へと向かう。だがそこにはイスベルの帰還を快く思わない魔王軍の二番隊サドールだけではなく、かつてアデルと共に戦ってきた騎士の姿があった……。
現役から退いた魔王と勇者に最強の敵が襲い掛かる!!

引退勇者&魔王が織りなす、とっても不思議なご隠居ものがたり完結巻!

summary:
Collects Dark X-Men (2023) #1-5 And Material From Marvel's Voices: Pride (2023).

Welcome to the Dark X-Men…hope the world survives the experience! Following the explosive events of the Hellfire Gala, Madelyne Pryor realizes that the world needs X-Men now more than ever. Havok and Gambit have served on the team before, but never one that looks like this! And how does young mutant Carmen Cruz, A.K.A. Gimmick, fall under the Goblin Queen's sway? The Dark X-Men's first "rescue mission" ends in blood and flame, with the team at each other's throats - and the fallen rising against them! But will Chasm, the villainous Spider-Man clone held prisoner in Limbo, join the fight? Or will he become Madelyne's ultimate downfall? And when Orchis' shocking secret weapon is revealed, who will emerge as the one true Goblin Queen? Find out in the most horrific X-Men saga yet!

summary:
Collects Dark Wolverine #78-81.

The costume may fit, but Wolverine's son is far from a hero. And when Daken slaughters a pair of masked assailants in front of witnesses, the world starts to wonder what happened to the Wolverine they knew. Norman Osborn, desperate to spin the attack, decides to stage another assault to prove once and for all that the Wolverine he handpicked for his team of Avengers is on the level, enlisting a gang of C-list villains to serve as punching bags for Daken. But when the villains learn Osborn's plan, they devise a plan of their own - for revenge. Soon, Daken finds himself the hunted instead of the hunter. Does he have the raw survival instincts to muscle through? He'd better hope so. Because even if he fights his way out of this mess, he still has to answer to Osborn. And his father.

name: The Dreaming Jewels
summary:
Retro Hugo-nominated Novella

Theodore Sturgeon's stunning debut novel, about a young boy who is drawn into a dangerous conspiracy when he leaves home to join a circus of shadows

Though only eight years old, little Horton "Horty" Bluett has known a lifetime of sadness. Tormented and abused by his adoptive family, he's had enough—and with a beloved broken toy he calls "Junky" as his sole companion, the desperate little boy runs away to join a carnival. There, among the fortune tellers, fire-eaters, sideshow freaks, and assorted "strange people," Horty hopes to find acceptance and, at long last, a real home.

But disgraced doctor Pierre "Maneater" Monetre's traveling show is no ordinary entertainment, and its performers are not what they appear to be. The Maneater has sinister plans for the world that go far beyond fleecing unsuspecting rubes and other easy marks—a dark and terrible scheme that requires unleashing the extraterrestrial power of the dreaming jewels, and the unwitting assistance of a young boy who may be far more remarkable than he's ever imagined.

This ebook features an illustrated biography of Theodore Sturgeon including rare images and never-before-seen documents from the University of Kansas's Kenneth Spencer Research Library and the author's estate, among other sources.

Also published as The Synthetic Man (Pyramid Books, 1957)

With a new armory of supernatural weapons, Frank renews his war on crime! He's caught between heaven and hell, but his soul has a second chance — and if he seizes it, perhaps one day he can see his family again! The Punisher's deadly mission used to be about vengeance — now it's about redemption! But what happens when Frank joins Wolverine to unravel the mystery of a deadly young mutant named Revelation? Bullet-flying, bone-clawing, maybe even world-ending action—that's what! Featuring the work of legendary horror artist Bernie Wrightson!

name: Venus Plus X
summary:
Charlie Johns has been snatched from his home on 61 North 34th Street and delivered to the strange future world of Ledom. Here, violence is a vague and improbable notion. Technology has triumphed over hunger, overpopulation, pollution, even time and space. But there is a change Charlie finds even more shocking: gender is a thing of the past. Venus Plus X is Theodore Sturgeon's brilliant evocation of a civilization for whom tensions between male and female and the human preoccupation with sex no longer exist.

As Charlie Johns explores Ledom and its people, he finds that the human precepts he holds dear are profane in this new world. But has Charlie learned all there is to know about this advanced society? And why are the Ledom so intent on gaining Charlie's approval? Unsettling, compelling, and no less than visionary, here is science fiction at its boldest: a novel whose wisdom and lyricism make it one of the most original and insightful speculations on gender ever produced.

name: Some of Your Blood
summary: Theodore Sturgeon's dark and foreboding look at the vampire myth was an instant classic when originally published in 1956. When George Smith is arrested for assaulting a senior officer, a military psychiatrist is assigned to the case. The secret of George's past is unearthed, and a history of blood lust and murder. Innovatively told through letters, interviews, and traditional narrative, Some of Your Blood effectively portrays the tragic upbringing of George Smith to his attempts at a stable life and the great love of his life to his inevitable downfall.

summary:
Best-selling crime novelist Gregg Hurwitz (The Kill Clause, The Crime Writer) and Laurence Campbell (Punisher Annual: The Hunted) bring you a tale of death, depravity, and revenge south of the border. In black vans and under cover of night, they descend on the little Mexican town of Tierra Rota, abducting its women and returning them days later like broken dolls. And no one can stop them! That is, until one brave soul approaches Frank Castle with his heart in one hand and a bag full of money in the other. Now Frank's no bounty hunter, and definitely no hero, but there are some things the Punisher just can't abide... 

Collects Punisher MAX #61-65 and Punisher Annual: The Hunted.

name: Calamity Cait
summary: Calamity Cait is a visual novel about the wonders and horrors of workplace romance.

name: FragMiner
summary: 用炸弹向深处挖掘，粉碎稀有矿石，触发爽快的连锁反应。在这款严禁使用镐子的渐进式/增量游戏中，用强力炸药将整个矿层夷为平地。

name: Prime Prism
summary: Numbers are light; logic is the lens. "Prime Prism" is a pure logic puzzle game themed around prime numbers and factorization. Construct circuits of light using optical tools like "Prisms" and "Lenses" to decompose and synthesize numbers. Over 140 stages across 11 worlds await your challenge.

name: Birds of War
summary: 你是一只鸟。你有一个巢。其他鸟想抢你的蛋。 Birds of War 是一款团队制空中 PvP 游戏。突袭鸟巢，偷走鸟蛋，在快节奏、混乱的飞行战斗中正面开打。 你的麦克风始终开着。敌人能听见你。请好好计划。

name: 異世界転生したら、なんか詰んでた 精霊に愛されて幸せをつかみます！
summary: 気がつくと、異世界に転生していたミル。ところが家は貧しいし、母親はいないし、父親は暴力をふるってくるしで、かなり厳しい状況。そんな中で味方になってくれるのは、幼いころからなぜか見える精霊たち。どうやら精霊はミルのことが大好きなようで、なにかにつけ手助けしてくれる。とはいえ、このまま父親と一緒にいたらお先真っ暗……。そう思ったミルはこっそり家を出て、ロゼと名前を変えて、冒険者として生きていくことに。時に人に騙され、時に人のやさしさを実感しつつ、ロゼは自分の人生を切り開いていく。底辺スタートの異世界生活譚、ここに開幕!

summary:

Celebrated crime novelist Victor Gischler takes on Marvel’s greatest vigilante! Traveling the Louisiana back roads with something awful stored in his trunk, Frank Castle stops at a service station on the edge of the bayou…and steps into a world of unspeakable horror. Patrolling the depths of hell, the Punisher has crossed paths with plenty of unsavory characters, but nothing has prepared him for the unspeakable depravity of the Geautreauxs. Plus: Vette’s little black book is a treasure chest of dark secrets. Movie stars, politicians, gangsters — they all pay to play. Tonight, she is making a house call — and the Punisher is riding shotgun. Because one of the names in that book is Carlos Ramirez, a powerful Miami drug lord who hides in an impenetrable fortress, and Vette is the Punisher’s best ticket inside. Before the night is through, Vette will learn a thing or two about what really lurks in the hearts of men, about the difference between dogs and wolves.

name: 政略より愛を選んだ結婚。 ～後悔は十年後にやってきた。～
summary: 完璧な女性と称えられる侯爵令嬢との婚約を解消し、恋した下級貴族の娘と結婚した王太子。侯爵令嬢に「どうぞ愛する方と末永く幸せに」と言われた彼は、愛の力で全てを乗り越え、幸せな未来を手に入れられると信じていた。ところが、そうまでして得た妻は教養、品など、王太子妃として求められるものを何一つ身につけてくれず、次々に問題を起こす。そのせいで、王太子夫婦は次第に周囲から冷ややかな目で見られるようになっていった。一方、別れた侯爵令嬢はすぐに有力な公爵と結婚。公爵夫人として夫を支え、ますます輝いていく。王太子妃よりも彼女こそが王族らしいと、臣下にも国民にも言われ続け――!?

name: My Heaven's Dale
summary: Sent by the Moon Goddess, you arrive in Heaven’s Dale to run a carpenter workshop and uncover its former owner’s fate. Mysterious ghosts drift through everywhere! Live a cozy life planting, fishing, mining, and caring for animals while restoring the town at your own pace.

name: Lepidarium
summary: 在这款温馨的放置游戏中放松身心,收集数百种独特的蝴蝶与飞蛾。看着毛毛虫从幼虫到蛹再蜕变为翩翩起舞的精灵,定制郁郁葱葱的温室,发现从帝王蝶到乌桕大蚕蛾的稀有物种。

name: Soulbound
summary: Soulbound is a pixel-art action roguelite with an MMORPG overworld. Run fast-paced bullet-heaven dungeons solo or in 3-player co-op, raid bosses, craft gear from your loot, and build out your personal base. Join thousands of players in the quest to explore, trade, and build a new world.

name: 婚約破棄された不遇令嬢ですが、イケオジ辺境伯と幸せになります！
summary: これまで必死に王妃教育をこなしてきた公爵令嬢のクラウディア。しかし通っていた学園の卒業式典で突然、男爵令嬢を虐めたという謂れのない罪で王太子に婚約を破棄されてしまう。さらに嫌がらせによって、20歳年上の辺境伯に嫁ぐことになってしまった!? ひとまず白い結婚を前提とすることになったものの、彼と出会った瞬間、恋に落ちてしまう。「白い結婚? いえいえ、私は彼と本当の夫婦になってみせますわ!」彼女を待ち構えるのは、辺境伯の悲しい過去やおバカな王太子のさらなる嫌がらせ。クラウディアはそれらを乗り越え、辺境伯の心を掴み取ることができるのか!?

summary: 为了省钱，白予宁搬进凶宅，从此鬼影、淤青、鬼压床轮番上阵。更离谱的是，爬上她床的那只鬼，竟是她死去多年的竹马玩伴何安。何安失忆后一直浑浑噩噩地跟着她，直到她喊出他的名字，尘封的记忆才裂开一道缝——童年里，她是唯一对他好的人。白予宁念及旧情，决定帮何安找回记忆、送他投胎。凶宅里最特别的“同居”开始了。

name: 悪役令嬢に転生したので、すべて無視することにしたのですが……?
summary: 気がついたら見知らぬ豪華な部屋にいて、姿かたちも変わってる。どうやら、乙女ゲームの悪役令嬢、リリアンに生まれ変わったみたい。しかも、転生したのはゲームが始まる学園の入学式前日で、攻略対象から嫌われまくってる!? 同時に今の記憶も思い出した。こうなったら破滅回避は諦めよう。だって身に覚えがあるんだから。それに公の場でいきなり断罪するような婚約者なんてこっちから願い下げだ。他の攻略対象も関係ないのに、一緒に断罪に参加する奴ばっかり! そんな人間の機嫌をとるだけ無駄よ。攻略対象もヒロインもシナリオも全部無視、やりたいことをやらせてもらうわ! そうやって無視していたら、なぜか攻略対象がやたらと近づいてきて……?

In their final battle, either Wilson Fisk or Frank Castle will die - but neither is going down without a hell of a fight.

name: 王女殿下を優先する婚約者に愛想が尽きました もう貴方に未練はありません！
summary: 長年、王女の近衛騎士を務める婚約者に後回しにされ続け様々な悪意ある噂に晒されてきた侯爵令嬢のヴィオラ。それでも相手の家とは友好的な関係を築いていたのだが、17歳の誕生日も婚約者は誕生パーティーを欠席し、王女の隣国訪問に護衛としてついていってしまった。その結果、さすがにもう無理だと婚約を破棄することに……。婚約破棄直後、親友の公爵令嬢がある男性をどうしても紹介したいと言い出し、ヴィオラは渋々会うことを了承する。そこで紹介されたのは、なんと大国の王子殿下! しかも彼は、過去に自分を助けてくれたヴィオラにどうしても結婚を申し込みたいのだと言い出して――!?

name: One More Spin

腕っぷしと料理で村の人を喜ばそう!

腕っぷしと料理の腕で村の人の頼みごとを解決せよ。

15～30分

summary: 精霊を見ることが出来るという能力をもつが故に、家族に虐げられていた王女メアリ。妹に婚約者を奪われた挙句、国外追放となった彼女は『魔の森』と呼ばれる恐ろしい森に一人捨て置かれてしまう。森の奥深くで、悲しみを抱きながらも精一杯生きようとするメアリだが、突如現れた精霊たちの不思議な力のおかげで、森での生活は快適なものに! 木の実を拾ったり精霊たちと遊んだり、満ち足りた日々を送るメアリだったが、ある日森に一人の少年が迷い込んできて――? 予期せぬ出会いが引き寄せたのは、真実の愛と波乱の予感!? 虐げられ令嬢の逆転爽快ファンタジー、開幕!

summary: In a post-apocalyptic world, a young girl and a defective robot called "Mech-ute" band together in order for him to fulfill his mission. Lost in Tandem is a colorful, relaxed-paced, 2D adventure-puzzle game, which can be played by one to two players via couch co-op.

name: Jenny the Witch
summary: Something evil is brewing deep below New York City and Genevieve Marconi has been hired to uncover it. Shoot and slash your way through an army of robots in this standalone story set in the Steel Carnelian universe.

summary:

リケジョがスキルを駆使して異世界を暴れまくります!

努力を認めず自分の都合を押し付けてくる家族、
自分の功績をすべてなかったことにする国王。
その全員を捨てることにしたクリスティーナは、
ランドルフを国王から引きずり下ろすために、国王に並ぶ権力を持つ辺境伯領へ向かうことに。
さて辺境伯領では今までの努力を認められ、順風満帆と思っていたら
ランドルフが必死に追いすがってきて――!?
窮屈な人生から飛び出して、新天地から輝く人生始めます!

最高にスッキリする逆転劇、ここに開幕!

name: ここは私の邸です。そろそろ出て行ってくれます？
summary: 侯爵令嬢・マリッサは九年間婚約していたデリオルから、一方的に婚約を破棄される。聞けば、デリオルはマリッサの義妹・ロクサーヌと浮気をしていて、彼女を運命の人だと思っているらしい。……それって、もしかしてすごく都合が良いのでは? だったら、十八歳のマリッサの誕生日、マリッサを虐待する叔父夫婦と一緒に追い出してしまいましょう! デリオルのことをちっとも好きになれないマリッサは、婚約破棄を歓迎。誕生日での報復計画のため、家や学園でのいじめを耐え忍ぶ。そんな中、日に日にやつれる彼女(虎視眈々と復讐を計画中)を見るに見かねた、美貌の王子・レイドが手を差し伸べて来て……

name: 愛されない王妃は、お飾りでいたい
summary: ロマンス小説の世界に、悪役令嬢として転生してしまったクロア。悪役にならないよう奮闘するも、物語の強制力により何をしても小説の展開どおりになってしまう。結局婚約破棄され、敵対していた隣国の王に嫁がされることに。さらにその夫からも「君を愛することは、ない」と冷たく言い放たれる。が――その一言、待ってました! その台詞でもって小説は完結。クロアは強制力から解放されたのだ。自分の人生を歩めるようになった彼女は、お忍びで街に繰り出し、大食いにチャレンジしたり、街の子供たちと遊んだりと日々を満喫! 一方、夫・クリフォードは、そんなクロアに唖然としつつも、徐々に惹かれていって……

summary: 王太子の婚約者である公爵令嬢エリアナは結婚式をひと月前に控えたある日、突然王太子から愛人に子供ができたと告白される。てっきり婚約破棄されると思っていたけれど、王太子はこのままエリアナと結婚し、愛人を側妃にすると言う。このままではお飾り妃として扱われると悟った彼女は、白い結婚と三年後の円満離婚を企む。王太子妃になるために培ってきた知識や教養を生かし、側妃にうつつを抜かす王太子の分まで政務をこなすエリアナ。仕事に明け暮れていた彼女は、ある時ひょんなことから宰相補佐官であるルイと知り合う。愛されない境遇と過労が募るエリアナに、心の籠った手紙を送るルイ。王太子との離婚が成立した後、いよいよルイは甘くエリアナを口説いてきて……!?

summary: 数年前に没落した元伯爵令嬢エリーゼは市井で逞しく生きていた。彼女には前世の記憶があるため、その知識と特別な魔法“家事魔法”のおかげでなんとか生計を立てていたのだ。ある日、街路の片隅で天使のように可愛い赤ちゃんが捨てられているのを見つける。街の孤児院に連れていくが、その職員には引き取りを拒否された! 「だったら前世でも子育てを経験した私が代わりに育ててやる」と奮起して五年。ある日突然、近衛騎士がすっかり愛らしく育ったティーナを迎えに来た。なんとティーナは隣国に嫁いだ王妹の娘だったらしい。ティーナが引き取られたあとも何かと王弟アルベルトが家に訪ねてきて……!?

當潤星還沒從震驚中回神時，為了取回被潤星吞下的狐珠，夏辰提出兩種選擇。看潤星是要選擇切腹，還是要不斷跟夏辰做「很麻煩的事」……!

——Bomtoon TW(R18)(无修)

summary:
鄭誼宣，出道10年的無名演員，總是盡心盡力消化被賦予的所有角色。
在某個寒冷的秋夜，他一如往常、毫無怨言地完成了艱辛的拍攝，並巧遇了世界級巨星車毅舟。
「對了，你是誼宣吧？」
演員車毅舟，從出道那一刻起就是話題焦點的頂級巨星，雖然同為演員，對誼宣來說卻是另一個世界般的遙遠存在。
本該擦肩而過的相遇…
「方便的話，要不要去喝一杯？」
「我不會耗費時間在沒興趣的人身上。」
在主動出擊的車毅舟影響下，誼宣的世界開始產生了變化。
不需要特別努力，就會主動靠近的溫暖存在；在漫長的無名歲月中，賞識那份從未熄滅的熱情與不懈努力的貴人。
「沒事的，我不會有別的想法。」
然而，不知從何時萌生的情感，逐漸與誼宣的決心背道而馳。

——Bomtoon TW(R18)(无修)

name: 銀河鉄道999
summary:
『銀河鉄道999』
新作劇場アニメーション作品
製作決定

『銀河鉄道999』の新作の劇場アニメーション作品を製作することが決定いたしました。ストーリー原案にりんたろう（代表作に1979年公開『銀河鉄道999』、2001年『メトロポリス』など）、アニメーション制作を今年創立70周年を迎える東映アニメーションが手掛けることが発表されました。

製作発表にあたり、銀河鉄道999の生みの親である漫画家・松本零士さんの設立した会社、零時社の代表取締役で、松本零士さんの長女の松本摩紀子さんからコメントが到着しました。

name: Atomcraft
summary:
Atomcraft 是一款你可以拾取并放置环境中每一个像素的游戏。像素会对周围的一切产生反应，而你可以建造容器和机器来让各种反应发生。

• 升级你的钻头和工具，不断向星球深处挖掘，寻找更好的材料！

• 熔炼矿石，进行化学反应！

• 建造机器来进行化学加工并提取各种元素！

• 并一点一点修复你的宇宙飞船！

元素周期表中的每一种元素都存在于这颗星球的某个地方，不过要从矿石中提取它们，可能需要发挥一些创造力！

你还可以制作各种机械部件，例如：

• 传送带

• 活板门

• 加热与冷却装置

• 用于信号控制机器的线路

• 按钮、开关和传感器

• 甚至还有逻辑门！

硝化甘油等高级材料需要精心设计反应装置，才能在不发生爆炸的情况下完成制造！

不断深入这颗星球的层层地层，直到发现元素周期表中的所有元素，修复坠毁飞船的各个系统，并揭开这个神秘世界的命运！

name: 呪われた女でも愛してくれますか？ ～ブサイクと虐められた伯爵令嬢が義姉の身代わりに嫁がされて公爵に溺愛されるようです～
summary: ローガンズ伯爵家の庶子で、幼い頃から家族に虐げられていたシャーリー。父親の命令で、政略結婚の身代わりとして嫁ぐべく、サリウス公爵家へ向かうことになった。だけど、実家の悪評のせいで公爵家の使用人たちからの視線は冷たく、しかも早々に身代わりだとバレて破談の危機に……。そんな中、『野獣公爵』と呼ばれるガゼルは、シャーリーの境遇を知り、ひとまず婚約者候補として公爵家に置いてくれると言う。メイドが付き、夫人教育も受けられるという好待遇に驚きつつも、シャーリーは一生懸命取り組むことを決意! そうして健気に頑張る姿を見て、ガゼルを筆頭に、メイドや護衛、果ては王女様までもが彼女を愛でるようになり――?

name: 余命宣告を受けたので私を顧みない家族と婚約者に執着するのをやめることにしました
summary: 家族に虐げられ、自分の婚約者と義妹が恋人のように過ごす光景を見せつけられながらも、つらい毎日を必死に耐えてきたアゼリア。そんなある日、余命半年と宣告されてしまう。「どうせなら生まれてきてよかったと思える瞬間を味わいたい!」そう考えたアゼリアは家族と婚約者のために我慢し続けることをやめ、どん底の人生をリセットしようと決心する。精一杯生きようとする彼女に待っていたのは、まぶしいほどに幸せな未来で――!? 絶望の淵からの大逆転ハートフルストーリー、開幕!

name: Mall Together
summary: 告别“社畜”生活，与朋友一起过把“商场老板”的瘾！从第一家门店做起，直到琳琅满目的各类商店塞满你的商场，装修、进货、销售、管理库存，再到与各大品牌签约，你的商场你做主，让客人带着笑容走，把钱留下来！

name: 奈落のキッチン
summary: 一款生存动作游戏，在游戏中，你将扮演一名厨师 Lop，她将陪伴一队冒险者，用食物的力量引导他们。在地牢中喂饱自己，吃掉一切能吃的东西，这样就不会因为饥饿而倒下，然后继续前进。拆解并吞食任何阻碍你前进的东西！

name: 義弟を虐げて殺される運命の悪役令嬢は何故か彼に溺愛される
summary: 前世で読んでいた小説の世界に転生したメルティア。彼女は義弟であるロイを虐め、それが遠因で殺される悪役令嬢キャラだ。この環境からは逃げたいものの、自分がいなくなれば義弟が周囲に虐げられ殺されるかも。そもそもロイは前世の彼女の推し、それ以上に幼い子供を不幸な境遇に追いやりたくない! メルティアは彼を虐めることで、それ以上の酷い扱いを受けないよう庇う。そんなある日、ロイの仲間に誤解から刺され、瀕死状態に陥る。ところがロイが自分の継ぐべき「精霊」を譲り、彼女は一命をとりとめた。そして「精霊継承」のため眠り続けたメルティアは、数年後目覚め、すっかり大人になったロイに求婚され――!?

name: Engineering Infinity
summary:
The universe shifts and changes: suddenly you understand, you get it, and are filled with a sense of wonder. That moment of understanding drives the greatest science-fiction stories and lies at the heart of Engineering Infinity.

Whether it's coming up hard against the speed of light and, with it, the enormity of the universe, realising that terraforming a distant world is harder and more dangerous than you'd ever thought, or simply realizing that a hitchhiker on a starship consumes fuel and oxygen with tragic results, it's hard science-fiction where sense of wonder is most often found and where science-fiction's true heart lies.

The exciting and innovative science-fiction anthology collects together stories by some of the biggest names in the field including Stephen Baxter, Charles Stross and Greg Bear

name: Some of You May Die
summary: 在这款肉鸽自走棋游戏中，你可以升级一切：英雄、属性与技能！但请做好牺牲的准备。召集英雄，踏上单人冒险之旅，或与其他玩家在线对决！

name: 義弟を虐げて殺される運命の悪役令嬢は何故か彼に溺愛される (2)
summary: 前世で読んでいた小説の世界に転生したメルティア。彼女は義弟であるロイを虐め、それが遠因で殺される悪役令嬢キャラだ。ロイを幸せにしたかったメルティアは自分が悪役を演じることで彼を守ろうと決意したものの、その計画はロイ自身にバレていた! 命を賭して自分を庇ってくれた義姉を熱愛しているロイは、メルティアに求愛。逆に彼女を幸せにしようと必死になる。だが、小説の内容に囚われているメルティアは、ロイの態度を演技だと思い込んでしまう。お互いのことを想いすぎた二人がすれ違っているところ、なんと、ロイに心酔しているはずの騎士のマルスまでもが、メルティアに求婚して――!?

name: 冤罪で婚約破棄された公爵令嬢は隣国へ逃亡いたします!
summary:
前世で読んだ小説に異世界転生していると気づいた瞬間、婚約者のエリオットから断罪された公爵令嬢ロザリンダ。死刑もありえると察した彼女は、婚約破棄を受け入れ、なりふり構わず国を脱出する。途中で双子の少年、アダンとエデンを助け、ロザリンダ自身はローザと名を改めて、三人で隣国で暮らすことに。人間ではありえない双子の急成長など、ちょっとしたハプニングはあったものの、支え合い、仲良く暮らしていたローザ達。しかし、ロザリンダ
が冤罪だったと知り苦境に立たされたエリオットが、拉致同然にローザを連れ戻しにやってくる。ローザを助けるため、そしてこれからずっと一緒に生きるため、アダンとエデンは『真の目的』も兼ねたある作戦に出て……

name: Organize my Shop
summary: 为商店带来完美的秩序！在货架之间切换，并在传送带上的堆积物中找到正确的商品。严格按照标签分类起司、肉类珍饈、香气四溢的糕点和甜点。享受完美秩序的瞬间！

name: 私を追放したことを後悔してもらおう ～父上は領地発展が私のポーションのお陰と知らないらしい～
summary: ポーション研究が何より好きな伯爵令嬢アリシアは、自前の研究所でひたすら魔法薬開発に精を出していた。しかし「女は働く必要はない」という父はアリシアのポーション研究を良く思っておらず、研究所を爆破した上、彼女を追放してしまう。途方に暮れるアリシアだが、友人のエリカや旅の途中で助けた亀の精霊・ランドの力を借りながら、ポーションスキルにさらに磨きをかけ、隣国でその腕前を発揮していく。なんとアリシアの持つ【調合EX】は、大陸で二人といない超レアスキルだったのだ! 一方アリシアがいなくなった伯爵領では、領地繁栄がアリシアのおかげだったとは誰も知らず、不穏な出来事が続くようになって――!?

name: 私を追放したことを後悔してもらおう (2) ～父上は領地発展が私のポーションのお陰と知らないらしい～
summary: ポーション研究が何より好きな伯爵令嬢アリシアは、「女は働く必要はない」という父によって領地を追放されてしまう。しかし、アリシアは超レアスキル【調合EX】を使い、他領で薬師として大活躍! 念願のポーション屋も開店し、アリシアを頼るお客さんも増えていく。これまでアリシアを搾取してきた姉のメリダが噂を聞きつけ、店を襲うという事件がありつつも、アリシアを慕う仲間によって華麗に解決。アリシアは順風満帆なチートライフを謳歌する。一方、アリシアがいなくなった伯爵領では、魔物の被害が急増していた。その情報は他領にいるアリシアの耳にも届き――!? 虐げられた令嬢の痛快成長ファンタジー第二弾!

name: Island Beekeeper
summary: 在云层之上的岛屿建立你的养蜂场，骑着 Medocycle 旅行，培育具有独特特性的蜜蜂，并在天空中打造一个温馨的家园。种植植物，探索岛屿，并将具有疗效的蜂蜜送往地球，在那里人们仍然期待你的帮助。

name: Nothing To Declare
summary: 欢迎来到刺激的安检现场！在这里，你将化身安检员，扫描行李、检查身份、搜寻暗袋！那一串串的阴影，是香肠还是雷管？等下，怎么还有假肢？锻炼你的火眼金睛！这里没有枯燥的站岗，只有解压的找茬和意想不到的惊喜。没收违禁品还能变现升级工位，把安检站变成你独属基地。

name: StarShip-DF
summary: 你可以自由建造一艘3D多层结构的巨型星舰，带领殖民者穿梭于整片星系。 你既能派遣舰载机在太空开采资源、打捞宇宙残骸，也能让整艘母舰降落在固态星球，派遣队员登陆地表收集物资。 抵御来袭的敌方战舰与危险异兽，保障殖民者正常起居劳作。随着科技进步，量产自动化机器人，打造独一无二的星际移动基地。

name: Pixel Orbit
summary: 一款关于抵御迫在眉睫的威胁、保卫地球的回合制游戏。通过发展技能树，部署自动炮塔及各种防御设施。

name: Raccoons to Riches

name: 完璧すぎて婚約破棄された人形令嬢は逆行転生の後溺愛される
summary: 所作も学問も容姿も完璧だが、無表情で無感情。「人形令嬢」と揶揄されるクローディアは、王太子ジルベルトに「心がない」と婚約破棄される。必要最低限の文字数でそれを受諾した彼女は、王妃の座を狙うアイシャに諮られ処刑されるが――目を覚ますと二年前に戻っていた!? 今度こそ王太子の婚約者なんかやめて平和に生きようと意気込んだものの、過保護なジルベルトがなぜか離してくれない。運命から逃げれば逃げるほど感情が動き、周囲に愛され、幸せになっていくクローディア。しかし平和も束の間、アイシャの魔の手が迫る。さらにクローディアの封印された感情に、神々を巻き込んだこの世界の秘密が隠されていることがわかり!?

name: 番が見つかったら即離婚！ 王女は自由な平民に憧れる
summary: 第三王女でありながら、義母である王妃や異母姉たちに虐げられていたエリサ。そんな彼女はある日、父王から同盟のため獣人の国の王へ嫁ぐよう命令される。竜人である王、ジークヴァルトは未だ見ぬ番しか愛せない身で、もし番が見つかるか同盟の役割が終われば、その時点でエリサとは離婚だという。しかし、もともと自由な平民になりたかったエリサはかえって自分から白い結婚&別居を提案して、離婚後は自由にしてもらう約束を取り付け、その日を楽しみに過ごすことに。ところがジークヴァルトの番探しが難航したり、王宮内の陰謀に巻き込まれたりと、エリサの身の回りにも不穏な気配が漂って……

name: 悪役令嬢に転生したけど、婚約破棄には興味ありません！ 学園生活を満喫するのに忙しいです
summary: 第一王子の婚約者である公爵令嬢のフランは、頭をぶつけた衝撃で自分が前世プレイした乙女ゲームの悪役令嬢に転生したことを思い出す。しかし序盤でやめてしまったため、肝心のストーリーはほとんど覚えていない! 前世は病弱で学校に通えていなかった彼女は、悩んだ末にゲームシナリオは放置し、憧れていた学園生活を満喫することを決意した。そのために身分を隠して平民クラスにもぐりこんだのに、婚約者のアドルフが乗り込んできてすぐに身分はバレてしまう。その上、ゲームヒロインの聖女はアドルフを狙っているようで、何かとフランにちょっかいをかけてきて――? はちゃめちゃ学園ラブコメディ、開幕!

name: Ore Factory Squad
summary:
《《采矿工厂小队》》 是一款合作型采矿和工厂建设游戏，核心玩法为程序生成的采矿系统！从一个小仓库起步，购买地产，深入挖掘矿产，加工采掘出的矿物，并将其转化为利润。步步为营，逐步扩张，将一个简易的作坊打造成一个功能完备的工厂。

单人游戏或最多支持4人合作。独立经营，或是一起合作加快建设！

以程序化采矿为核心
每处地产的地下资源均为程序化生成，没有固定路线，让你可以自由挖掘，创造属于自己的矿道。

从一把铲子开始，逐步解锁用于挖掘更坚硬岩层的鹤嘴锄，再用炸药清理大面积区域。随着你越挖越深，资源的价值也越高，每一步决策都至关重要。

从仓库到工业生产
你的工厂将从简单的机械和基础资源起步，随着游戏进程解锁新机器与配方，并通过获取执照来不断扩张。

利用托盘和叉车处理物流，用传送带连接机器，打造更高效的生产流程，逐步将你的仓库发展成一个规模更大、效率更强的工业系统。

购买地产，挖掘财富
购入不同类型的地产，每处地产的资源分布与盈利潜力都随机生成。

进行挖掘、采掘、加工，将每一处地产转化为利润，逐步发展壮大，经营更大规模、更高价值的产业。

Contracts, Sales, and Growth
承接来自各公司的合同，按要求生产特定种类与数量的产品，通过谈判达成交易，备货发货，装载卡车以完成订单，赢取更高回报。

管理你的库存，组织发货运输，在快速发展与快速销售库存之间找到平衡。

工具、升级与装备
从简单的工具开始，随着游戏进程解锁并升级更强大的采矿设备。

升级你的工厂，扩展业务，增加市场覆盖率，承接更多合同，改善谈判利润，招聘和管理员工，获得许可证解锁新机器和生产线。

自定义你的角色，选择不同的服装、面容、手套和头盔，并个性化定制你的仓库，添加墙壁、地板、标志和装饰。

单人建设或合作经营
自己独立经营一切，或与团队合作。你可以全权掌控，按自己的节奏推进；也可以分工协作，优化生产，携手实现更快发展。

核心特色：
⦁ 程序生成的地下世界，完全可挖掘的地形，没有固定的采矿路径

⦁ 可解锁和升级的采矿设备，包括铁锹、镐、气动凿岩机和炸药

⦁ 地产系统，包含多种类型，每类地产的矿物分布与盈利潜力均随机生成

⦁ 多阶段生产系统，配备可实现不同加工产出的机器

⦁ 通过解锁机器、获取执照、扩展生产链与升级来推动工厂发展

⦁ 基于传送带的生产系统，集成工厂自动化，包括仓库机器人

⦁ 使用可控车辆（如叉车和卡车）进行物流与运输

⦁ 合同系统，包含生产要求、备货发货、装车及谈判机制

⦁ 角色和工厂自定义

⦁ 完全支持单人游玩或至多4人的合作模式

summary:
「若未將能孕育白虎子嗣的『胎人』奉為王，將會迎來七年的凶年。」

夏國，一個毗鄰怪獸出沒的無知之地的國度。
這個國家長久以來都有一條不成文的規定：一旦出現能孕育守護國家的白虎子嗣的「胎人」，就必須奉其為王。
然而，距離上一次胎人現身已有數十年之久。

就在此時，身為大監府邸奴婢的日午覺醒為胎人，
先王登基僅兩年便讓出王位，而原本的王世子長雲則淪為輔佐在側的右官。

宮中眾人皆知，日午於二十歲誕下子嗣後，便難逃一死。
即使宮中瀰漫著如履薄冰般的緊張氣氛，日午仍將心交給了長雲。
不久後，迎來二十歲的日午為了誕下子嗣，第一次和前來找他的白虎建俞相遇……

一心想擁有子嗣、重獲自由並離開人世的白虎建俞、一旦誕下白虎的子嗣便注定被殺的胎人日午，以及長雲。
三人之間的愛情與執著在美麗又詭異的夏國中展開，最後終將走向何方？

——Bomtoon TW(R18)(无修)

name: 婚約破棄で捨てられ聖女の私の虐げられ実態が知らないところで新聞投稿されてたんだけど ～聖女投稿～
summary: 聖女として王家に仕えていたアイシャは、魔物の大量発生をどうにか鎮圧した直後、婚約者のクーツ王太子に冤罪で糾弾され、聖女の地位を剥奪、更に婚約破棄までされて王宮を追い出されてしまう。行くあてのないアイシャは、王宮の下女マルタのはからいで、彼女の息子であるトオンが営む宿屋に身を寄せることに。突然の事態に感情が制御しきれず無意識に王家を呪ってしまうかもしれないと恐れるアイシャに対し、トオンと彼の友人カズンは、紙に書いてストレス発散をすることを提案する。当初はあくまでそれで終わりのはずだったのだが、アイシャが書き出した過去のあまりのひどさに、トオンはその内容を新聞社に伝えることを決意、新聞の朝刊を介して王太子たちの悪業が暴露されたことで、彼らは窮地に追いやられ……

name: 無能と追放された侯爵令嬢、聖女の力に目覚めました
summary: 魔法の名門に生まれたにもかかわらず、まったく魔法が使えないリリー。父からも妹からも虐げられ、辛い日々を過ごしていた。15歳の誕生日を迎えたその日、突然連れてこられたのは森の中。無能は要らないと、実家を追放されてしまった。行く当てもなく彷徨うリリーは雨に打たれ、空腹のあまり倒れてしまう。けれど次に目を覚ましたのはふかふかのベッドの中、自分を助けてくれた青年エルネストは、すごい魔法使いだった! さらに自分をかばって狼に襲われた彼を助けようとしたとき、眩い光が身体を包み込んで……!? 不器用ながらもまっすぐに生きるリリーと穏やかに見守るエルネストの溺愛ファンタジー!!

summary:
在怪物横行、气候剧变的世界里，唯一维持国家体制的「特别市」，拥有一支恶名昭彰的哨兵部队「白军」。 白军哨兵申花真因出身与能力平庸而饱受轻视，直到某天，他得知身为向导的双胞胎弟弟遭队员迫害致死。 失控暴走的他屠杀整支部队后跳下悬崖，却在失忆后，被隐密村落「图书馆」的统领者坦所救。 憎恨白军的坦，逐渐对失去记忆、被命名为「希玛」的申花真产生感情，随着两人来越亲近，希玛也开始找回原本的力量…

name: 悪役令嬢にオネエが転生したけど何も問題がない件
summary: 『シャンパンは唯一美しく酔える。ポンパドゥール侯爵夫人の言葉だっただろうか? あの女の名言はたいていクソよ』二丁目を飲み歩いていた渡辺和也は酔っ払った挙句、トラックに轢かれ命を散らした……はずだったが、目が覚めると美しき公爵令嬢に転生していた! 名前はマリー・エリザベート・ローズ・アントワネット……って、長いわ! しかも役割は悪役令嬢ですって? 冗談じゃないわよ! そんなことより美の追求、ゴリマッチョな恋人作りでしょ! 緩すぎる世界にツッコミを入れつつ知識チートで無双するエリザベートは何故だかイケメン(ただし細マッチョ)にモテまくり――オネエ様の二度目の人生は超痛快!

因車禍身亡的記者「李周元」，再次睜開眼時，竟發現自己的靈魂附在財閥二代、同時也是娛樂公司理事的「鄭延宇」身上。

熙載毫不猶豫地大步走進屋內，下一秒便強勢地吻了上來…

即使所有人都反對，泰虔仍向他求婚—

summary:
記錄情感的機器—E.T.A在未來的地球上，為了減輕參戰軍人的罪惡感與創傷後壓力症候群，因而製作並導入了這款新型機器。
這項具備劃時代意義的發明E.T.A，在轉眼間便超越了軍用範疇，開始在黑市中作為非法機器被販售流通，更被當作能帶來極致快感的毒品用途使用。
而亞辰與玄，曾將這樣的 E.T.A 當作救贖。
玄認為亞辰拋棄了自己，在抓到逃跑的亞辰後，便利用E.T.A肆意地對他進行凌辱。
在互相傾瀉對彼此潰爛化膿的情感時，兩人才意識到，存在於他們之間的所有矛盾並非因彼此而起，而是由軍方與E.T.A造成的。
於是，他們決定齊心協力，從這個為了利用他們而設下的局中逃脫。

最終，他們在沒有毒品干擾的情況下，完整地感受著彼此，並確認了愛意⋯⋯!
究竟亞辰與玄能否擺脫所有的誘惑與威脅，得到完整的愛呢？

——Bomtoon TW(R18)

name: RIMWING
summary:
# ジャンル
ウェポンコントロールアクション

# 概要
『RIMWING』は、武装の操作を手動で行うアクションゲームです。
攻撃を弾き、弾を装填し、襲い来る機械を迎え撃ちましょう。

# あらすじ
文明は繰り返し滅んだ。しかし人々は生き残り、日々を生きている。
主人公ウィルは文明の瓦礫を探査中、突如として巨大な崩落に巻き込まれた。
しかし大きな好奇心と夢を抱えるウィルにとって、それは確かな吉兆である。
未知が蠢く興奮を抱きながら、崩落によって生み出された大穴へと足を踏み入れていく。

But does this mean that Stephen Strange is about to adopt Frank Castle's lethal ways? Or will the Punisher be learning some new tricks? The Sorcerer Supreme must work on being a little more grounded, while Frank has to expand his worldview in surprising new directions. But with monstrous mobsters on the rampage, this mismatched pair has their work cut out for them! The very different worlds of two of Marvel's most individual characters collide, and the fate of New York is at stake!

name: Colorful Strokes
summary:
"Draw your own color, and we'll become one canvas."
스텔라이브 3기생 클리셰(Cliché)가 오랜 기다림 끝에 각자의 첫 솔로곡을 품에 안고 여러분 앞에 섰다. 첫 EP 「Colorful Strokes」는 네 멤버가 저마다 감춰 두었던 색을 처음으로 꺼내 든, 클리셰의 가장 솔직하고 다채로운 자화상이다.

스텔라이브의 3기생으로 데뷔한 직후부터 지금까지 수많은 팬들을 매료시켜 온 클리셰는, 하나로 뭉쳤을 때 마치 한 사람의 목소리처럼 끈끈하고 아름다운 하모니를 자아내는 유닛이다. 하지만 네 사람의 곡을 나란히 펼쳐 놓는 순간, 저마다의 색이 선명하게 번지는 것을 느낄 수 있다. 이토록 각자의 색이 강렬한데도 멀리서 보면 하나의 작품처럼 어우러지고, 가까이서 보면 저마다의 매력이 살아 숨 쉰다. 4인 4색의 이 개성은 오직 클리셰이기에 그릴 수 있는 그림이다. 그런 클리셰가 각자의 색깔을 어떻게 더 선명히 할지 오랜 고민 끝에 내놓은 이번 앨범은, 여러분에게도 분명 잊을 수 없는 유니크한 매력으로 자리매김할 것이다.

앨범의 시작을 여는 ‘Our Tales’는 클리셰가 팬들과 함께 써 내려온 첫 이야기이자 데뷔곡이다. 평범한 오늘이 특별한 내일로 바뀌는 순간을 노래하며, 네 사람이 한목소리로 그려 온 시간의 밑그림이 되어 이번 앨범에 노스탤지어를 가득 담은 채 수록되었다.

이어지는 네 곡은 각자의 색을 뽐낼 첫 솔로 무대다. 텐코 시부키(Tenko Shibuki)의 ‘Berry Verry Strawberry’는 수많은 딸기 중 오직 ‘너’를 골라낸 마음을 새콤달콤하고 톡톡 튀는 발랄함으로 물들인 곡이다. 아오쿠모 린(Aokumo Rin)의 ‘Maid My Way’는 남들과 똑같은 춤을 거부하고 자신만의 길을 찾아 나서는, 어지러운 세상 속에서 오히려 살짝 미쳐 보는 청량한 반항의 색을 칠한다. 하나코 나나(Hanako Nana)의 ‘Hush Trap’은 고귀한 ‘너’의 마음을 보석에 비유해 손에 넣으려는 스파이의 은밀한 스릴을, 숨소리마저 낮춘 시크한 무드로 그려낸다. 유즈하 리코(Yuzuha Riko)의 ‘악당주의보’는 두근거림 앞에서 어쩔 줄 몰라 하는 소녀의 마음을 새침한 악당의 색으로 묘사해, 귀엽고 짓궂은 설렘을 마구 흩뿌린다.

그리고 앨범의 대미를 장식하는 두 번째 단체곡 ‘유성우’. 데뷔 2주년을 맞아 팬들 앞에서 처음 선보였던 이 곡을 통해 앨범 전체를 하나의 작품으로 완성한다.

홀로 있을 때도 선명했던 색들이 서로를 마주하고 하나의 작품으로 완성되는 이번 앨범은, 앞으로 클리셰가 달려갈 넓은 캔버스이자 다채롭게 칠해져 갈 내일을 예고한다. 클리셰가 펼쳐 나갈 그 찬란한 색채 속에 여러분도 함께하기를 바란다.

summary:
You've awoken deep within a research facility in a new, programmable robot body. You have holes in your memories. At least you no longer have that hole in your head...

Pragma Twice is a dystopian sci-fi programming/puzzle game in which you must augment your character's "kernel" with additional functionality and abilities in order to get through increasingly complex levels.

Craft Your Kernel - Kernels are written in vanilla JavaScript via an in-game editor. Can't move? Register a keyboard event to a movement call! Puzzle seems tedious or repetitive? Automate the tedium in your kernel!

Everything Has An API - Everything from blocks, to switches, to doors has an API. Studying an object's API can give you clues on how to interact with and leverage it for problem solving. 

Make It Autonomous - every level can be beaten autonomously, that is, without any player input from the keyboard. You may even be able to craft a tool that records keyboard inputs in order to generate autonomous, level-solving kernels...

Important Note: While the game introduces each concept required for players to develop their kernels and interact with objects, the game does not teach programming from ground up. The player is expected to already have knowledge of programming and its primary problem-solving constructs: functions, variables, if statements, loops, data manipulation, etc.

summary:
The goal of the game is to connect slimes and score as many points as possible. The game system is intuitive and easy to understand, and the game can be played in short or long periods depending on the goal, making it suitable for a wide range of play styles.

About This Game

In this game, players bounce continuously generated slimes and control their movement to achieve the highest possible score. When two slimes of the same type come into contact, they merge and evolve into a higher-tier slime with a greater base score value. Because the number of times slimes can be generated is limited, careful management is essential. Players must aim to evolve slimes efficiently, using as few generations as possible to create higher-ranked slimes.

Scoring is not determined solely by slime evolution. Once a slime is dropped into a point zone, the final score is calculated based on the slime’s base score multiplied by the multiplier assigned to that specific zone. This means that even the same type of slime can result in vastly different final scores depending on where and when it is dropped. Proper timing and placement are therefore critical elements of high-scoring play.

Players are required to consider multiple factors simultaneously: how to bounce slimes efficiently, how to guide them into contact with identical slimes to trigger evolution, and when to intentionally drop them into high-multiplier zones. Since careless bouncing can waste valuable slime generations, strategic control and planning are vital. The challenge lies in balancing slime growth with scoring opportunities while minimizing unnecessary generation usage.

The game also incorporates mechanics inspired by crane games, introducing physics-based movement and a degree of unpredictability.

Introduction:

Fractals is a two-player co-op puzzle platformer built around mirrored mechanics and teamwork. Play as two characters going through different levels and solve puzzles where actions on one side could affect the other. Push mirrored crates, change gravity, teleport through portals, and manipulate the environment in unique ways. Features:

A Divided World: Each level in Fractals uses mirrors to separate the players into two distinct sides: one of light, the other of dark. However, strangely, each world does not seem to mirror the other perfectly... rather, mirrors act as the sole barrier between light and dark. The players must work together across their respective sides of the mirror in order to complete each level.

Fractal Crates: In this world, the primary interaction between both sides of the mirror will be completed using crates that mimic the movement of another, represented by the color of their central gem. The dark crate will always mirror the movement of its light counterpart, however, the light crate will never move with the dark crate.

Portals: Sometimes, parts of the mirror separating light and dark will destabilize and falter, forming a portal which allows objects from one side to cross and interact with objects of the other side.

There are many other mechanics and features to discover and enjoy!

Find your flow

name: 龙虎派对
summary:
《龙虎派对》是一款以 “龙（Dragon）” 与 “虎（Tiger）” 两大阵营为核心的回合制策略卡牌对战游戏，支持单人（玩家 VS AI） 与双人（玩家 VS 玩家） 两种模式。游戏核心玩法围绕 “翻牌定阵营（龙阵营或虎阵营）、策略移动、卡牌对战” 展开，玩家需通过翻牌获取己方阵营卡牌，利用卡牌数值克制关系规划移动与战斗，最终消灭对方阵营所有卡牌或达成平局，兼具策略性与即时互动性。

各位玩家好！

     《龙虎派对》是款超易上手的回合制卡牌对战游戏，主打 “龙”“虎” 两大阵营对抗，能单人跟 AI 玩，也能双人组队 PK，一局下来 5-10 分钟，轻松又有策略感！

      游戏棋盘是 4x4 的格子，总共 16 张牌 —— 龙、虎阵营各 8 张，每张牌都有 1-8 的数字。这里的数字规则超特别：1 号最大，8 号最小，大数字能 “吃掉” 小数字，但 8 号能反过来克制 1 号！比如 8 号龙牌能打赢 1 号虎牌，2 号龙牌能打赢 8 号虎牌，要是数字一样，两边的牌就一起消失。

开局所有牌都是扣着的，翻牌就能定 “归谁管”：

      单人玩：

     你第一次翻的牌是龙是虎，你就管这个阵营，剩下的阵营归 AI；

      双人玩：

     Player1 先翻，翻到的阵营归他，Player2 自动管对面阵营，翻完后牌就固定归谁，别人动不了。

      轮到你回合时，操作超简单：点自己阵营的牌，会弹出上下左右四个方向键，点方向就能移到空格子里。要是移的方向有敌人的牌，就会自动打架 —— 按 “1>2>…>8，8>1” 的规则算输赢，赢了就占敌人的格子，输了自己的牌会消失，平局就两边都没。要是不想动，点 “Skip” 就能跳过回合，换对面（AI 或另一个玩家）操作。

     单人玩时，AI 可聪明了：会专打你强的牌、提前躲危险、还会堵你的路；双人玩就纯靠你们俩的运气和想法，没 AI 捣乱，公平得很！

     等所有牌都翻过来，就看输赢：对面的牌全没了，你就赢了；两边都没牌，就是平局。结束后屏幕上方会显示结果（比如 “Game Over - Player1 Wins!”），点 “Restart” 就能重开一局～另外双人玩时，Player1 回合字是红色，Player2 是蓝色，一眼就能分清谁的回合，还有打架动画和音效，玩着超有代入感！

William's Wideblock is a minimalist take on the classic block puzzle games of yesteryear. 

-Gameplay Explained-

In Wideblock the goal is to clear blocks to fill a progress meter, each time the meter is filled, the game's pace is accelerated. There are two methods to clearing blocks. 

The first is following the classic formula of neatly stacking the shapes together to make a complete horizontal line, once a line is formed, the blocks in that line are cleared from the playing field and remaining blocks are shifted down.

Wide Blocks

Mirror Ability

The player has the ability to mirror an asymmetrical shape to fit different situations. Mirror is on a short cooldown.

Super Drop Ability

As stated above Super Drop slams down your current shape clearing blocks vertically along with clearing the controlled shape itself. Super Drop has two charges on a set cooldown.

summary:
Blooms of April is an experimental narrative game where poetry unfolds as you pluck petals from a sunflower. Each gesture reveals shifting fragments of verse, creating a contemplative, ever-changing poem through play

Blooms of April is an experimental narrative game where poetry emerges through the simple, timeless gesture of plucking petals from a flower. Inspired by the childhood game “loves me, loves me not,” each act of unveiling removes a piece of the sunflower, revealing fragments of verse that shift and transform in unexpected ways.

The game is not structured around pages or chapters, but around presence and rhythm. Each petal becomes a line, a fragment, or a pause in a procedural poem that rewrites itself every time you play. No two flowers are ever the same: the words they carry change depending on the order, the pace, and the choices you make as you move through the ritual of unveiling.

Blooms of April belongs to the genre of interactive experimental literature. It does not present a fixed story, but instead creates an open space for reflection—an environment where text, gesture, and chance intersect. The mechanic is simple yet evocative: pluck, reveal, reflect. Over time, the sunflower fades, the poem completes itself, and the act of reading becomes inseparable from the act of playing.

This is a game for players drawn to contemplative experiences, poetic experimentation, and alternative forms of storytelling. Blooms of April invites you to slow down, to engage with language as a living system, and to rediscover how even the smallest gesture—pulling a petal—can carry meaning.

summary:
You had a rough night. Use the cards you've been dealt to reveal secrets and uncover your story through conversations with compelling characters. When faced with a life-changing opportunity, will you repair relationships or fan new flames? Change your life...or don't.

Light Streams In is a story driven deck-building RPG where you collect cards to charm, intimidate, or deceive remarkable characters in an effort to reveal their secrets and uncover what really happened last night. Choices matter as you make decisions to repair relationships or cut ties with the life you know.

Talk With Friends, Old and New

There are many conversations to be had as you piece together your night. Seek out friends to find answers -- but you may find they are not too happy to hear from you. Branching choices and stat-locked dialogue keep conversations fresh and impactful.

Collect Cards to expand your voice

Cards are your voice -- they provide actions you can use in conversations to influence others. They also provide advantages, which boost your stats, provide defense, or even alter the rules of conversation. Cards are collected throughout your journey -- you'll need to balance your deck to give yourself the voice you want to play with. Build a deck heavy in Deceit and Intimidation, favor Charm and Empathy, or maybe find your voice somewhere in the middle.

Tell Your Story

As you have conversation, you'll collect Memories and Story Cards -- fragments of the story of your night. You'll have to piece these together to form a cohesive story. You decide what your truth will be -- but be careful -- your truth will play a role in the climax of your story.

Choices Matter

Be careful how your play your cards -- your friends will remember whether you approached them with Empathy -- or Deceit. The way you play, and interact with others, will contribute to the story you are writing.

STRIKE CHESS                                                                                             

Chess, but both players move at the same time.

  - FLASHBANG — stun one enemy piece for a round.

In WAVEBEAM, 2-4 local players navigate the darkness while battling one another to be the last ship left. Fire your BEAM to destroy other ships and stay hidden while navigating the arena. Your PING not only reflects enemy BEAMs, but also reveals your surroundings and your location to everyone, so use it wisely!

A Note from the Designer:

The concept behind this game was developed by myself and a few others during the 2017 Global Game Jam. Eight years later, I wanted to experiment with modern AI coding tools to assess their capability and limitations. I spent about an hour distilling the game's concept and writing a comprehensive game design document that aligned with my own vision, then I provided an AI coding agent with the design doc. Although it missed the mark in a few areas initially, the agent started out with something surprisingly playable that roughly reflected the design. After about 10 hours of additional tweaks, additions, and iterations, I ended up something that I was happy to share with the public - all without writing a single line of code.

The product of this experiment was well worth the time and money put into it, and while I could have developed this game entirely myself as a Software Engineer, I chose to do so with the use of AI and thus can't justify charging anyone for it.

HOWEVER - if you want to invest in the ongoing development of this game, I'll gladly accept donations via an upcoming "Dev Support DLC", or you can donate via Venmo (@RyanCollins86) or reach out to me directly via . I'll be sharing a roadmap in the Discord where you can also chat with other players, report bugs, and provide suggestions new features for the roadmap.

Battle against your enemies in a turn-based combat: Attack, block, heal, and evolve your skills as you grow. Build your Psyche to unleash devastating breakdowns, and master the Catch Bar, a rhythm-based timing mechanic that grants energy and shields.

But not every fight is against another robot. Some battles are within: bullet-hell survival encounters where doubt, regret, and guilt become your enemies.

Besides combat, explore The Wasteland, meet allies, and uncover haunting memory fragments that reveal the truth about your past. Dialogue choices shape your relationships and encounters, even as the story drives toward a single powerful conclusion.

Features

Turn-based combat with evolving skills and strategy.

Psyche & Catch Bar systems that reward timing and risk.

Emotional battles that shift into a bullet-hell survival experience.

Exploration & dialogue in a mysterious, broken world.

Memory fragments that piece together CULY’s past.

Atmospheric pixel art & original soundtrack.

CULY is a game about imperfection, loss, and hope. Reminds us that even in a broken world, trying to be better makes all the difference.

summary:
A short playable tech demo featuring photorealistic 3D scans of real world places as a third-person walking game. A demo of emerging tech that might see its way into more games in the near future.

Postcard is a short playable technical demo where you walk around photorealistic 3D scans of real world places.

Each environment in the game has been captured from the real world including its lighting, ambient sounds, and even the crunches of gravel and steps on concrete were recorded from the real location.

There's not a lot to actually do in the game, but if you love pretty environments and want a hands-on peek at how scanning tech can make something far more immersive than a 360-degree video, then you might enjoy Postcard.

Where are these places?

The places you can currently visit in Postcard are in Canberra, Australia.

We might be able to add some other locations in if there's interest :)

What can you do in the game?

Choose from a list of 10 different characters, then choose from a list of 7 locations.

Once you're in the location, you can walk, run, jump, and orbit the camera around. That's it. Nothing crazy on the controls or features, but some very stunning real-time visuals and reality capture going on.

Underlying technology

For the people who love behind the scenes tech details, the environments in Postcard are created from a mixture of traditional photogrammetry and mesh construction for the terrain shapes and shadow catching, as well as gaussian splats for the beautiful visual layer. 

About 15-30 minutes of continuous video of each location capturing as many angles and details as possible, then processing through mesh photogrammetry and gaussian splatting, plus a lot of manual alignment and turning into playable areas. Shadow areas are hand-masked to avoid casting a second shadow over what was already present and baked in from the source scan. To play, open a live video (e.g. YouTube) on the left half of your monitor, and run this game on the right half.

Align the frames carefully, then control Shibumaru using the WASD keys or your mouse.

- Game Mechanics 

Hit detection is based on color: everything except crosswalk white and road gray is considered a target.

In other words, Shibumaru might just slip right through people dressed in white or gray—oops!

Also, no AI is used for detection, so if you trip in an empty spot, it's not intentional (there’s no “falling” logic built in).

- Development Challenges

This game relies on color-based detection, which can behave very differently depending on your PC or display environment.

Older machines—and surprisingly, even some newer laptops—can reproduce colors in ways that drastically affect detection accuracy.

summary:
INFERIAE is a two-hour-long descent into a nightmare over 20 years in the making, an immersive experience blending unsettling soundscapes with hundreds of shifting scenes and a haunting narrative.

INFERIAE is a Visual Concept Album by the experimental one-piece ACCURST. Unlike Visual Novels, where the focus is on the story, here the emphasis is on the music.

This Visual Concept Album unfolds over 2 hours of new material of experimental, horror ambient music, with around 250 haunting backgrounds and roughly 10,000 words accompanying you deeper into darkness & despondency.

ACCURST has been a sound artist since the early 2000s, having been featured in the Blumhouse films Sinister (2012) and Sinister 2 (2015), among other projects and collaborations.

What started in 2003 as a trilogy of concept albums, has reached its final phase with a new, original experience, dubbed as a Visual Concept Album. This project is the culmination of over 20 years of work in the field of esoteric auditory paintings.

This is ACCURST's epilogue album — a final statement completing the circle.

Headphones recommended.

summary:
Graviton Flux is a fun action-packed puzzle game. Differently colored particles are constantly being attracted towards the center. Rotate the central core to match similarly-colored particles to make them explode and prevent them from reaching the outer ring. Try to reach the rank of Grandmaster!

Graviton Flux is a fun action-packed puzzle game. A strange anomaly has developed and it is attracting different types of particles. Rotate the central core to match similarly colored particles with each other. Connecting three or more similarly colored particles will make them explode and disappear. This prevents too many particles from accumulating and reaching the outer ring which will cause a catastrophic explosion and end the game.

Try the FREE demo! The demo has a score limit of 220000 points.

Try to last as long as possible. There are an unlimited number of levels, but they get progressively harder.

The black particles are special. They can only be destroyed by destroying a group of three or more particles of another color, while this group is attached to the black particles.

If things get too hectic, you can use a bomb, if you have one available, to destroy all of the particles at once. You won't get any points, but it can save you from losing the game.

You can also slow down time by using a time warp, if you have one available. This is useful for tricky or important maneuvers.

If you rarely mismatch the colors of the particles, a bonus mode will be triggered. White particles will begin to appear and these can destroy any particles they touch. White particles give bonus points when destroying other particles.

There are six ranks: Bronze, Silver, Gold, Platinum, Master and Grandmaster. Try to make it Grandmaster!

Try the FREE demo! The demo has a score limit of 220000 points.

summary:
These puzzles look like Rubik's cubes, but the stickers slide around instead of the normal twist movement, which changes how you approach the solves. ? Plus, the puzzles can be all different dimensions, and you can create and save mosaic designs in them! ?️??

Squared Straight's puzzles look like Rubik's cubes, but their movement is totally different.  The stickers slide around the cube (or rectangular prism), which creates a unique puzzle-solving challenge!

The animation below shows the classic Rubik's movement (left) vs the Squared Straight movement (right).

Due to this new movement style:

The twisty 3³ has 26 blocks, while the same-size Squared Straight cube has 54 tiles, allowing orders of magnitude more possibilities!

The twisty cube is limited to 90° turns, so the corner blocks are always at the corners, edges at the edges, and centers at the centers. But a Squared Straight puzzle can move in one-tile increments (1/12 rotation on a 3³), so any tile can go anywhere for ultimate chaos!

While the tiles on top move with the rotation on the twisty cube, they remain fixed on the Squared Straight cube, with the upper band of tiles moving independently. So, twisty cube algorithms won't work here. This calls for new solving methods...?

Beaded Puzzles

There are puzzles with tiles that have beads marking their respective positions and angles.  For example, in the image below, the indicated tile must be on the orange face at the green and white corner, oriented so that its green bead is adjacent to the green side and its white bead is adjacent to the white side.

Unmarked Puzzles

There are also unmarked puzzles, whose same-color tiles are interchangeable.  You can generate these to unlimited dimensions.  I used multithreading to generate the puzzles faster, made the reset function preserve the generated tiles, and made the camera rotate instead of the puzzles, so they run smoothly even at huge sizes!

summary:
Step into the world of Cubuleto, an isometric grid puzzle game where your goal is simple: find the path from start to finish. Easy to learn but challenging to master, each puzzle tests your logic and creativity. Can you find the way through?

Welcome to the world of floating platforms, stubborn cubes, and brain-bending puzzles!

In this game, every step matters: one wrong move and you’ll either fall, get caught by a cube with attitude, or watch the path literally explode beneath your feet.

Your mission is (apparently) simple: guide the player from the starting point all the way to the finish line!

Features

250 hand-crafted levels

A full level editor to design, play-test and share your own creations

An interactive tutorial, for all types of blocks

An overview of the game block types:

Base: The plain, trusty tile. Safe to walk on, no tricks here

Wall: Just what you’d expect. It's in the way, and you can’t pass through.

Teleporter: Instantly transport you from one spot to another.

Togglable: Either walkable, either not. Its state changes when you activate its linked switch.

Slider: Conveyor-style tile that pushes you in a fixed direction, as long as nothing blocks the path.

Checkpoint: Unlocks new parts of the map when stepped on.

Countdown: Every time you step on it, its “life” ticks down. When it hits zero, it vanishes.

Explosible: A more dangerous version of countdowns. Once triggered, it keeps ticking down with every step you take. When time’s up, it explodes, taking surrounding tiles (and maybe you) with it.

Goal: Reach this, and you’ve beaten the level!

You will also be able to join a Discord Community!

Random “Sketch Fragment” events that can burst into big one-off IP rewards

Cardistry is a small, loud “NO” to AI slop: a comfy idle game about silly animals, shiny cards and knowing every piece in your inventory was drawn by a human.

summary:
Fever Tilt is a fast 1v1 zero-G arena where you mine gems, weaponize drifting debris, and sabotage your opponent with lasers, forcefields, and explosives. Procedural arenas and physics-driven chaos make every 3–7 minute match a ruthless fight to score first.

FEVER TILT

A ruthless sport of exploitation & sabotage in zero-G.

HOW IT PLAYS

Two players face off in a zero-gravity arena filled with frozen blocks. Each player pilots a ship using a gamepad, aiming and thrusting through the arena. Your goal: mine gems from inside blocks and push them into your goal to score. First to 5 goals wins. Matches last 3–7 minutes depending on how aggressive you play.

CORE MECHANICS

Laser — Your primary tool. Hold to fire a cluster of 5 laser beams that apply heat to whatever they hit. Blocks thaw and activate after 0.3 seconds of heat, then shatter into halves at 0.5 seconds. Halves break into quarters, and quarters vaporize — each stage releasing any gem hidden inside. Your laser holds 3 seconds of charge and recharges slowly when not in use, so you must manage your energy carefully.

Forcefield — A tractor beam that pulls nearby objects toward your ship. Use it to drag gems toward your goal, reposition blocks as barriers, or steal objects your opponent is trying to control. It costs less energy than the laser, making it your go-to for maneuvering.

Projectile Explosives — Collectible missiles that spawn periodically on the board. Launch them to create massive explosions that scatter blocks, shatter fragments, and disable your opponent's ship. You can carry up to 2 at a time, and they accelerate after launch.

Heat & Disabling — Lasers and explosions apply heat to ships too. When your ship overheats (10 seconds of accumulated heat), you're disabled for 3 seconds — unable to move, shoot, or use items. As heat builds, your ship slows down, creating an escalating vulnerability. This is the sabotage: sustained laser fire on your opponent disables them, giving you a window to score

Background Story: 

Grepa was not a fan of parties, but she went to anyway because her coworker couldn't stop bothering her to go in one.  Upon arrival, she was lucky to come across a friend of hers who happens to be the host of the Halloween party to bear with the burdened chattering  around  her.  All things were fine and well, until she counters  a certain group of "old" friends that doesn't exactly remind her of pleasant memories.

That is when she snaps at her host friend,  creating a ruckus over the party. It didn't take long for Grepa to start dashing out the front door and throwing a middle finger at them.  She never wanted to go home so bad after that, but then remembered her car was busted. With that, Grepa had no choice but to walk herself back home.

She knew it wasn't going to be easy, but she didn't expect the way back to become so...

...spooky.

HUMEROUS is a reboot of my old game Humerous! It is a story-rich RPG adventure horror game with VISUAL-NOVEL/HORROR PUZZLE elements, about a gal who wants to go home after an unpleasant counter at the party. Sadly her car's busted, so she has no choice but to walk home! But little did she know that taking a break from walking in the middle of a forest has it's own...consequences.  How Grepa gets to home is all up to YOU to decide! 

Maybe also perhaps help uncover a...cold case? She was looking at something else during that break after all...

Enjoy the story, and Happy (Days Late) Halloween!

The game includes:  

11 endings!

Gameplay time varies depending which ending you end up with!

Fully-drawn CGS! (20+)

Thank you to my close friends, good pals, and inspirations that helped me feel motivated to make this reboot!

Guilt Trip is an exercise of restraint.

At the Heartburn Diner, under cold veil of moonlight, something important is stolen from inside.

NOTE: ROOTWOVEN is only on start of it's journey. We're developing the game with support of community. Your messages, game time and input allows us to make the game we dream about. Thank you for support and understanding. We hope our transparency through the whole development, will give you as much joy as we have. We're starting Kickstarter soon, join us early to get access to new content first! 

ROOTWOVEN is a dark-fantasy mystery visual novel built around natural-language investigation.

Instead of choosing from a fixed dialogue menu, you type what you actually want to ask, accuse, hide, confess, or provoke.

At the Academy, every conversation is a thread. Pull the right one and secrets loosen. Pull the wrong one and people close ranks.

You are not chatting into a void. ROOTWOVEN’s world is hand-authored: its characters, clues, loyalties, quests, and consequences are built to react to the way you investigate. Trust is earned. Suspicion spreads. What you learn — and what you reveal — changes how the story moves around you.

INVESTIGATE IN YOUR OWN WORDS

Question characters naturally instead of clicking pre-written lines. Press for detail. Test contradictions. Change the subject. Deflect. Charm. Threaten. Confess. Stay silent when silence is smarter.

REACTIVE CHARACTERS, NOT DIALOGUE DISPENSERS

The people around you remember what you ask, what you hide, how you push, and whether they should trust you. Relationships can deepen, fracture, or curdle into rivalry and fear.

A MYSTERY YOU UNRAVEL, NOT JUST WATCH

summary:
Freight Misconductor is a railroad switching train puzzle game, inspired by model railway shunting puzzle layouts like the Inglenook. You operate a modern steam engine on an alien planet, moving cars between sidings, navigating more & more convoluted railyards--all while keeping your conductor sane!

Freight Misconductor is a pixel art railroad switching puzzle game, inspired by model railway shunting puzzle layouts like A. Wright's Inglenook Sidings and J. Allen's Timesaver.

In Freight Misconductor, you operate SLYM #11513, a modern Advanced Steam Locomotive on the alien planet Gymnome, to shunt trains between siding tracks in increasingly convoluted rail yards, while minimizing your move count and time so as to hopefully keep your Engineer and Conductor-Brakegoo's spirits up.

Are you ready to be an alien railroader? Yes? Good.

Welcome to Planet Gymnome

Sorry about the mess. You see, a global oil crisis has just befallen the planet, and as a result diesel trains have had to be replaced by modernized steam engines. No matter; there's still work to be done, lots of freight to move. Big articulated steam engines shift thousands of tons of freight all across the planet's railways. 

But that's not your job. Your locomotive is a switcher, tasked with shunting cars within a single rail yard at a time. Sometimes you're building trains for other crews, sometimes you're servicing industries connected to the railroad, sometimes you're just cleaning up after the last train crew who didn't do their job right! Either way you've got your work cut out for you, many of these yards have rather tight and complex track plans which make maneuvering your cars across the yard quite the challenge!

Each level in Freight Misconductor is a new railyard at a different station on the South Lymer Railway (SLYM), a 3.04₆ glip (1096mm) narrow gauge line with interchanges for many other nearby railways and plenty of industries to serve. There's over 20 hours of gameplay across story mode

summary:
Warrens Of Random is a minimalistic horror game where you must survive 20 challenging mazes. Every time you do survive, there's a chance that you'll randomly spawn in a previous or future maze.

This game, with the exception of the Main Menu, the UI, and the pinging ability, contains complete silence and loud jumpscares!

Warrens Of Random is a minimalistic horror game where you must survive 20 challenging mazes.

Every time you do survive, there's a chance that you'll randomly spawn in a previous or future maze, so even though you'll survive more than 20 times, you must do it in chronological order, from Maze 1 to Maze 20.

The default mode is Normal mode, so if you want a challenge, go ahead and try Hardcore mode or Speedrunner mode:

In Normal mode, you have 3 lives, you can ping the exit every 5 minutes, and your game will save when you exit to the main menu.

In Hardcore mode, you have 1 life, a higher chance of random spawns, and the exit will randomly move locations when a random spawn happens. Your game will still save when you exit to the main menu, and you can still ping, but only during a random spawn.

In Speedrunner mode, you have 1 life, no saves, no pinging, and no random spawns, just finish the game as fast as you can.

When the Ninja reaches the end (or dies trying), their treasure is recorded. Then the roles rotate — P2 becomes the Ninja, and the cycle repeats.

Standard level

A chaotic Halftime twist

Standard level

A climactic Boss Fight

summary:
Set in a dystopian world, destroyed by greed, the last of their kind gather around the rumored island. This island is protected by a mysterious force. Only pure souls cleansed of greed may enter. Are you worthy to step foot on the Sanctuary of Giving?

GAMEPLAY

The game is all about giving. You may give a piece of yourself to plant it in soil. After you harvest your plant, you will then have the option to give it to someone else. As other players and wildlife do the same, they might also give something to you. 

MULTIPLAYER

The island is a multiplayer area and you may encounter other players that may accept your acts of generosity, or vice versa. We strongly recommend you invite your friends to join so you may share the joys of generosity together. An internet connection is not required to play as you can still complete the game offline by interacting with the wildlife instead of players. 

THEME

This game is designed for the 3-week TGC x COREBLAZER game jam and their given theme “generosity”. We used this project as an opportunity to explore the delicate balance between self-sacrifice, self-care, greed and generosity. During gameplay you will have to manage your own well-being, as well as spread the joys of generosity with other players and wildlife. Both visual and audio elements dynamically change to make the player feel the state of their character’s journey.

Boli was an unwanted and neglected child whose parents saw him as yet another mouth to feed.

When a rare disease befell their village and a hero was needed to venture into the wildernes to find a cure, his parents were quick to offer him as a volunteer.

Armed with only a rusty dagger and a supposedly-enchanted potato sack provided by his older brother, Boli must brave the monster-filled wilderness to retrieve a potion from the distant apothecary.

name: Ammonite
summary: Change or die. These are the only options available on the planet Jeep. Centuries earlier, a deadly virus shattered the original colony, killing the men and forever altering the few surviving women. Now, generations after the colony has lost touch with the rest of humanity, a company arrives to exploit Jeep–and its forces find themselves fighting for their lives. Terrified of spreading the virus, the company abandons its employees, leaving them afraid and isolated from the natives. In the face of this crisis, anthropologist Marghe Taishan arrives to test a new vaccine. As she risks death to uncover the women’s biological secret, she finds that she, too, is changing–and realizes that not only has she found a home on Jeep, but that she alone carries the seeds of its destruction. . . .

summary:
Palombia 发现了一片新的天地，欢迎回归 MARSUPILAMI – HOOBADVENTURE。踏上一段恐龙遍地、精彩纷呈的全新冒险，在神秘隐藏世界的中心发现 10 个新关卡……

Punch、Twister 和 Hope 是三只长尾豹，它们在 Palombia 过着平静的生活。当三个伙伴在海滩上玩碎片以打开一个被诅咒的石棺时，无意中释放出一个神秘的幽灵，幽灵对所有动物都施下了可怕的诅咒。幸运的是，这些诅咒对长尾豹无效。我们的三位英雄将不得不踏上冒险，追逐幽灵，由此来避开咒语。

这是一个早已被完全……遗忘的世界，如今得以重见天日。似曾相识的食肉强敌和焕然一新的游戏元素，构筑起这场惊心动魄的冒险之旅！ 到“恐龙世界”的这些侏罗纪关卡中，收集新物品，达成新成就……

In a kingdom where the tax collector is always watching, every coin is a gamble.

You are a humble merchant running a stall in a bustling medieval bazaar. Business is good - perhaps too good. The Crown demands its share of every sale, but gold in your pocket spends the same as gold on the books... if you can keep it hidden.

Logged sales are taxed and safe. Hidden sales spawn physical gold pouches - evidence, that must be stashed in hiding spots around the map before the next audit. Leave a pouch in the open, and Taximus will find it. Get caught with too much hidden wealth, and its game over.

But the more you hide, the more suspicious you become. And when that suspicion meter fills, countdown begins. You have 120 seconds to secure your stashes before the random spot inspection starts.

Physical Stashing

summary:
Arcade racing reborn: side-scrolling, pure zen, pure style. Much retro.

Arcade racing reborn: side-scrolling, pure zen, pure style

Side Whoop is an old-school arcade blast - they don’t make 'em like this anymore!

Easy to pick up, tough to master. Its unique zen flow will keep you hooked for hours.

Rip like a pro pilot and satisfy your nostalgia for the golden era of snowboarding and skating games.

Beat the clock or go unlimited and thread as many hoops as you can chain - all with pure effortless cool.

Various scenarios to explore, each run is a unique journey. Beautifully hand-crafted segments dynamically rearrange every go, offering endless variety.

Different speed classes let you lock into your sweet spot and perfect rhythm.

A word from the Dev

I made this game as a solo developer because I missed a certain kind of experience - games that draw you in with their easy accessibility, let you jump straight in, fully immersed from the first moment.

The motivation comes from pure nostalgia - the feeling from back then, when games were simple, perfectly handcrafted and with complete absence of today’s industry slop.

Side Whoop's core is all about flow. Controls being deliberately simple - smooth and slick movement that is perfectly complemented by the soundtrack.

Heavily inspired by 90s arcade, skating, and snowboarding titles, it blends style, attitude, and confidence into every run.

A game that’s meant to be felt, focused on the experience and without distractions or over-complications.

This is the realization of a long-held dream after having worked for a decade in AAA and teaching game development. A chance to make something entirely on my own terms, without outside pressure shaping the design.

Side Whoop is the culmination of a personal journey, finally creating a game exactly the way I’ve always imagined it.

I hope it feels like something you thought was lost - or never realized you were missing.

Gerrymap is a puzzle game about gerrymandering. Win congressional seats for your party by drawing districts, using US Census data!

In Gerrymap you practice gerrymandering: drawing maps to decide the outcome of elections.

A state has four districts. In most elections, its vote is split equally. Each party should have two districts, right?

NO! If we control redistricting, we pack the enemy party into just one district! This is the art of gerrymandering. 

It's not always so simple. A "dummymander" could give away all your seats in a bad election year. An overly conservative map could make further gains difficult. Also, some areas are very elastic, others are not!

summary:
A two-player turn-based strategy game where you place planets on orbits, rotate and move your galaxy, and win by making one of your planets collide with the opponent's star.

Akkor is a turn-based strategy game for two players. You and your opponent each control a star and a set of planets that move along orbits inside a 3D arena. You win by making one of your planets collide with the opponent’s star. Plan orbits, time your moves, use rotation and movement of your whole “galaxy” to set up the hit while blocking your opponent.

How It Works

Each player has a star and places planets on orbits around their star. Planets advance with their chosen step size along their orbit after each turn.

In the placement phase, each side places up to 3 planets and then confirms ready. After that, the main game begins.

On your turn you can: place a new planet (choose orbit position, direction, and step count), rotate your galaxy (X, Y, or Z), move your galaxy (translate it in space) or pass.

If one of your planets hits the opponent’s star, you win (with an exception: a planet you just placed that would hit the star on the very next check is destroyed instead of counting as a win). If multiple planets collide (regardless of which player they belong to), they are all destroyed.

Note: Hit detection is applied only when the turn ends and all planet movements are completed.

Local multiplayer — Two players on one PC.

Single player vs AI — Challenge an AI opponent. (Not too smart... Might improve it in the future.)

Online multiplayer (Steam) — Host a game or join a friend via Steam (friends-only lobbies, 2 players).

If you like short, tactical, turn-based games that you can play locally or online with a friend, this game is for you.

Big thanks to 'Deep-Fold' for the pixel art assets. Have fun!

summary:
Draw your knife and carve your way through the absurd world of archetypes. Overcome platforming stages, collect items, talk to unique characters and defeat powerful bosses.

Archetypes Festival is my first original project, a fully hand-drawn 2D game. The adventure focuses on battles against powerful bosses, but it also features platforming sections, plenty of collectible items and characters to interact with, all tied together by a unique and captivating story.

Setting 

The setting is absurd and surreal: an aseptic void embraces the domains of the archetypes, places that reflect the identity of their rulers. Along your path, you’ll encounter flames, spikes and chasms, but also balloons and trampolines. In these locations, Miss M. will have to solve a mysterious kidnapping case.

Gameplay

The gameplay is based on a linear sequence of platforming stages, each culminating in one or more boss fights. 
During the platforming sections, players need to carefully time their movement and jumps to avoid various obstacles, some following fixed patterns and others being hurled at the player. There are also elements that allow players to extend the reach of their jumps.

During boss fights, players can use a frontal attack and an upward attack to hit enemies at close range. These attacks can also redirect projectiles thrown by opponents, allowing the player to defend themselves and deal long-range damage.

There are three types of damage: wound, burn, and infection. 
Each attack received or inflicted causes one of these three types of damage until the lethal threshold is reached, resulting in the death of the player or the opponent.

Players can collect various items, some found on the map and others given by characters after a dialogue. 
Some items can be consumed to heal damage, while others grant passive effects. 

Key Features

5 unique boss fights

Challenging platforming stages

Various items with different abilities

Numerous dialogues with bizarre characters

summary:
原因不明の失踪事件、続出する変死体・・・世相を反映してか、近ごろそういった怪事件が続出している。そして、それらを人知れず解決しているのはナゾのヒーロー「神仮面ファラオン」である・・・そんな新たな都市伝説が誕生しつつあった・・・。時に1998年、夏。
　神あすか（吉井怜）は高校2年生の女の子。自分では可愛い方だと思っているが、まあ普通の女の子である。「神仮面ファラオン」の事なんか別に興味は無い。一番の関心事は親友工藤夏美（菅原晶子）の両親が離婚して、夏美が学校に来なくなった事だ。ウチのお父さんは大丈夫かなと母敦子（樋口しげり）に尋ねると「お父さんにそんな甲斐性があれば、もっと出世してるわよ」なんて言っている。あすかの父健一郎（潮哲也）は中流の商社に勤める万年係長の冴えないサラリーマン。いつも上司の大文字（佐々木剛）に小言を言われている。しかし健一郎はあすかに「人を蹴落として偉くなるより、人の悲しみ、苦しみが分かる人間になりなさい」といつも言っている。神健一郎こそ伝説のヒーロー「神仮面ファラオン（永井正浩）」であった！
　神一族は4000年の昔から代々、古代神ホルスの意志を継ぐものとして人間の天敵「デュアトス」と戦いを繰り広げて来た。しかし、健一郎はこんな宿命は自分の代で終わりにしようと考えていた。誰から称賛される事もない命懸けの秘密の戦いを、何も知らず、純粋無垢に育った娘に強要する事は出来なかったのだ。しかし、世紀末を迎え、歪んだ人の心に乗じて、次々にデュアトスが復活している。そして、遂にその毒牙が娘に及んでしまった。あすかは神家に伝わる不思議なお守り、アンクロスに祈りを捧げると、伝説の戦士ロゼッタの能力と姿を得て、「仮面天使ロゼッタ（永嶋美佐子）」となった。
　無我夢中でロゼッタになり、デュアトスの蝙蝠魔女（あいだもも）を倒したあすかだが、なかなか宿命を享受できないでいた。母親や親友藤崎みどり（本多彩子）にも相談出来ないでいた。しかし、父健一郎の壮絶な戦いぶりと生きざまを見て、ロゼッタとしてデュアトスと戦う決意を固めるあすか・・・。

Each match is a free for all of 2-4 players, the objective is to reach the point goal (read more below in match settings), you must break the other cups either through punching them or pushing them off the table, the last cup standing gets half a point and all cups reset their health and position to fight again, once a cup gets a second half point, it becomes a full point and all other cups lose their half point (if any) but choose 1 of 3 upgrades to help them make a comeback (these upgrades are chosen from a pool of various upgrades, making each cup have a different set of powers), the match ends once someone reaches the point goal. 

--Match Settings--

When setting up the match, you may set the point goal from 1-9 depending on how long you want the game to last, as well as customize both the table and the carpet, although the carpet is purely visual, the different tables' shape can drastically change the match.

Additionally, you can turn on 2v2 mode, in this mode you share points with another cup and must defeat the other two, meaning that even if your cup breaks, if your ally breaks the other cups, you gain a point aswell.

--Cup Customization--

Before the match, you can change your cup's color, face and hands to make your cup stand out.

Sail across the seas. Trim your sails, chase the wind, and race from the roaring Southern Ocean to the calm trade winds. Adventure awaits, all from home.

What is Offshore Sailor?

The game is currently in development, but here is the vision:

Offshore Sailor is a sailing simulation game that lets you experience the thrill of offshore racing and ocean exploration, all from home. Whether you’re exploring the open sea or competing in legendary races, every voyage unfolds on a 1/60 scaled Earth with its own weather system, unique for each game.

The goal is simple: sail fast, sail smart. Configure your sails, adjust your route, and use the wind to your advantage to cross the finish line before your rivals. The simulation captures the essence and strategy of real sailing while keeping the experience accessible and fun.

At its heart, Offshore Sailor is a tribute to the passion of sailing, designed both for sailors who want to relive the adventure at home and for newcomers eager to discover why this sport inspires so many.

What Offshore Sailor is not

Offshore Sailor doesn’t try to replace real sailing; nothing compares to the feeling of a real boat cutting through waves and the wind on your face. It’s not a hyper-realistic simulator, but an authentic yet simplified recreation designed for enjoyment. Some behaviors are intentionally tuned for fun and accessibility rather than strict realism.

The world is scaled at 1/60th of real Earth, so long ocean crossings remain immersive but never drag on for weeks. You’ll still feel the vastness of the sea, just condensed enough to fit into your schedule.

The Team

Offshore Sailor is developed by me, Marc-André Ploux, a passionate solo developer and sailor. Every aspect, from development to 3D models, is handcrafted with love and precision. As the project grows, new collaborators will join the adventure to help bring even more realism and depth to the experience.

• Add 1
• Subtract 1

Timing your division while keeping the value as an integer is the key.
If you end with 1 and divide it by 3, you achieve 0.33333333333 and clear the stage.

Game Over Conditions

If the player attempts to divide a number that is not a multiple of 3, a BURST occurs.
One battery cell is lost, and accumulating three mistakes ends the game.

On the verge of extinction, you must make your salmon jump up-stream to the spawning pool at the top of this remote island while avoiding the wide array of bear-like predators home to the island.

Salmon Jump is a game where you and your friends can be a salmon jumping upstream, but watch out for slips, falls, and hungry bears! Solo or co-op, make your way up to the salmon breeding grounds at the top of the steep mountain. 

SCHOOL UP

There's safety in numbers! Invite your salmon friends to school up with you to cooperatively jump upstream! (Or, to have them be extra distractions for any potential hungry predators.)

JUMP

Dash up out of the water to jump up out of the water to new heights or cross gaps through the air. Jumps can also help dodge dangerous predators or dash back to land before you get stuck out of water. It's a long way up... Will these salmon run, or will they jump?
